The magician takes the four kings. He states that the pack is a theater, where the kings have arranged a theater party. One
king went in the gallery here he places a king a few cards from the top; while another went in the stage door. Here he inserts a second king a few cards from the bottom. The other two kings went in the main entrance. Here the magician cuts the pack, drops on the two kings, and completes the cut. As a result, each king found his proper seat, with his wife waiting for him. Turning the pack faces up, the magician spreads it and shows all the kings and queens together in the center, the king of spades with the queen of spades, and so on. Method: Place the queen of diamonds on the pack with the queen of hearts above it. On the bottom place the queen of clubs with the queen of spades above it. This is arranged beforehand. The king of diamonds goes in the gallery. Put the card in the top of the pack, either second or third card down. The king of spades goes in the stage door. Push it in the bottom of the pack, either second or third card from the bottom. Then cut the pack, and on the upper portion place the king of hearts, and on that put the king of clubs. Complete the cut, putting the bottom half on the top, and the reunion will be completed.

effect_cn: 半副牌被压弯后，在桌上立起来，不收手也不倒，还慢慢围成一个圆环。
method_cn: 把半副牌的两端向内压弯，压得很实。
把另外半副牌的两端向外压弯。
把两种牌交替排好。
把牌堆竖着放到桌上，按住靠近自己的一端。
牌会自己弹出来，开始围成一个圆。
小心调整每张牌的位置，圆环就好看又稳当。
note_cn: 弯牌要弯得均匀，牌才能一张扣一张立成圆。
text_en: There is a very pretty pattern which may be formed with cards, by a very simple method. Take half the pack and bend the ends inward, very sharply. Bend the ends of the other half outward. Then sort the cards so that they are arranged alternately. Set the pack on its side, and hold the end closest to you. The cards will spring out and start to form a circle. By carefully arranging their position, you can make them form a neat and artistic circle, which when completed will balance perfecdy. This should be followed by another design, called:

effect_cn: 刚做好的纸牌圆环被一拍桌子，立刻散开成均匀的玫瑰花形。
method_cn: 按上一则的方法做好纸牌圆环。
在圆环平衡稳定时，告诉观众你要展示一个惊人的变化。
拍一下桌子。
牌均匀散开，落成漂亮的玫瑰花形。
note_cn: 拍桌子要拍得干脆，牌才会均匀散开。
text_en: This requires the formation of the circle in the manner just described. While the cards are in the balanced circle, state that you will show a transformation that is very surprising. circle Hit the table, and the cards will fall, evenly distributed, forming a neat rosette.

effect_cn: 观众把选牌插回牌堆中央，魔术师只切两次牌，再翻看一遍牌堆，就立刻指出了那张选牌。
method_cn: 事先快速翻一遍牌堆，把同一花色的许多张牌集中放到牌堆中间。
请一位观众随意抽一张牌记住。
把牌扇形展开，让他把牌插回靠近牌堆中央的位置，正好落进那组同花色牌里。
收齐牌堆，切牌两次。
浏览牌堆时，那组同花色牌就是标记区；选牌是从中央插回去的，位置与这组牌相邻又格格不入，一眼就能认出。
note_cn: 同花色牌要集中成一叠当标记，选牌插回中央后才会显出异常。
text_en: Here is an easy and effective method of discovering a chosen card. Run through the pack, and quickly place a number of cards of one suit in a group at the center. Let a person select a card. Then fan out the pack, and have him replace it near the center. After the pack is squared up and cut twice, you can immediately find the chosen card when you look through the pack. The card is not ta\en from the center but is put bac\ in the center.

effect_cn: 牌装进牌盒后上下摇动，盒盖掀开着，一张指定的牌竟然从盒里慢慢升了起来。
method_cn: 先选定一张显眼的牌，比如 joker、黑桃 A，或观众刚才选的牌。
把这牌放到牌堆里的某个特定位置，再把牌堆装进牌盒。
翻下盒盖，握住牌盒上下摇动。
停手后轻轻松开盒盖，那张牌就会从盒中升起来。
事先用同一只牌盒试验，弄清它会升起哪张：底牌、倒数第二张，还是顶牌；以后把目标牌放在相应位置即可。
note_cn: 每只牌盒会升起的位置不同，必须先试验再表演。
text_en:
By this method, the magician can make a playing card rise from the case. It can either be a joker, ace of spades, or some
outstanding card, or it can be a chosen card, which the magician has learned by the method just described. The pack is put in the case, and the case is shaken up and down, the cover being turned back. The desired card will rise. The trick is accomplished by simply shaking the pack up and down in the case. This action will cause a card to rise. The magician should experiment and discover which card rises in the particular case he uses. It may be the bottom card, the second from the bottom, or even the top card. He places the desired card at the proper position before he puts the pack in the case.

effect_cn: 五张牌摊开让观众心里选定一张，魔术师背过身再转回来，听完牌名就把牌堆切到那张牌上，并把它翻出来。
method_cn: 洗牌后牌面朝上发五张在桌上，请观众心里选定其中一张。
魔术师收起这五张牌，转身背对观众，趁机把这五张牌记牢。
把一张放在牌堆顶，一张放在牌堆底，两张夹在牌堆中间并留一个 break，第五张塞进自己口袋。
转回身，请观众当众说出选牌的名称，好让其他人见证。
若他说的是顶牌，就让他自己翻看顶牌；若是底牌，就把牌堆翻过来露出底牌。
若他说的是中间两张之一，就在 break 处切牌，展示切点上方或下方的牌。
若他说的是第五张，就从口袋里取出，证明这是自己唯一从牌堆拿走的牌。
note_cn: break 只是把上半叠略微倾斜地搁在下半叠上，收牌不要太整齐，切牌时才能一找就准。
text_en:
A pack of cards is shuffled, and five cards are dealt faces up on the table. A spectator is told to choose one mentally. Then the magician picks up the cards, turns his back for a moment, and studies the cards. He turns around, and states that he can reveal the chosen card. He asks the person to name it. "Five of hearts", is the reply. The magician instantly cuts the pack to the five of hearts. Method: When the magician turns around, he has memorized the five cards. He puts one on top of the pack, one on the bottom, two in the center, leaving the deck slightly broken between them, and he slips the fifth card into his pocket. He does not know the chosen card, but he tells the spectator to name it for the benefit of the other people, so that they can see the trick actually performed. If the chooser names the card that is on top of the pack, the magician tells him to look at the top card. If he names the card on the bottom, the magician turns up the pack revealing that card. If he names one of the two cards in the middle, the magician quickly cuts the pack at the break*, and shows the card * The break between the sections formed by simply laying the upper section at a slight angle upon the lower. This never noticed, as the pack not too well squared; but serves as a guide to the magician and enables him to cut there instantly.
above the cut or below the cut as the case may be. If he names the fifth card, the magician takes it from his pocket, and demonstrates that it is the only card he removed from the pack. In any event the discovery is effective.

effect_cn: 观众数清自己那叠牌，魔术师把自己的牌加进去，对方的总数立刻由奇数变偶数、或由偶数变奇数，与预言一致。
method_cn: 请观众从牌堆里拿一小叠牌。
魔术师自己也拿一小叠，并且事先数成奇数张。
声明：你的总数若是奇数，我的牌能把它变成偶数；若是偶数，我的牌能把它变成奇数。
让观众数清自己的牌数。
把魔术师那叠牌加进观众那叠里。
总数果然按预言互换了奇偶。
note_cn: 自己那叠必须始终是奇数张：奇数加奇数得偶数，偶数加奇数得奇数。
text_en: A person takes a small packet of cards, and the magician also takes a small packet. "Count your cards", says the magician. "If your total is odd, my cards will make it even; if your total is even, mine will make it odd". The person counts his cards, and the magician adds his packet. The spectator's total is immediately changed from odd to even, or from even to odd as the magician predicted! Simply deal yourself an odd number of cards, and the trick is sure to work. Odd plus odd will produce even; even plus odd will be odd. Thus you are sure to change his total!

props: 两副背纹相同的牌（一副光面、一副压纹）
effect_cn: 观众把牌洗乱，魔术师接过来分开发成两堆，翻开一看，一堆全是红牌，另一堆全是黑牌。
method_cn: 准备两副背纹完全相同的牌，一副表面有压纹（cushion finish），另一副光面。
把压纹那副里的黑牌取出，与光面那副里的红牌合成一副，外观看起来毫无异样。
把牌交给观众洗牌。
发牌时用手指触摸牌面：光面的是红牌，有细微压纹的是黑牌。
按手感把红牌和黑牌分别发成两堆，再把两堆翻开。
note_cn: 两副牌外观必须一模一样，差别只在牌面手感；发牌速度要匀，摸牌时不要停顿。
text_en: A pack of cards is shuffled by the audience. The magician takes it and deals it into two heaps. When they are turned up, the reds are in one pile, the blacks in the other! Method Obtain two packs of cards that have the same pattern, but one with cushion finish and the other without. The cards will look exactly alike. Make the red cards smooth ones, and the black cards rough ones. In dealing, you can tell which is which every time you touch a card.

props: 两副牌（蓝背、红背各一副）
方块 9 与红心 8 备用牌
effect_cn: 观众在桌上散开的蓝背牌里清楚看到自己的牌，魔术师把牌一收、再牌面朝上发开，那张牌却不见了，随后从他口袋里变了出来。
method_cn: 在桌上牌面朝上摆一张方块 9，再摆一张红心 8，让方块 9 的右下角压住红心 8 的左上角，角落的方块点与红心拼成一个「红心 6」的角标。
把其余蓝背牌围绕这两张牌叠压散开，巧妙遮住接缝，看上去就像红心 6 摆在桌上。
从红背牌里给每位观众发一张，请他们看自己的牌是否出现在蓝背牌里。
多数人会说没有而被淘汰，只有拿到红心 6 的人能看到自己的牌。
魔术师收起那叠蓝牌并捋乱，再牌面朝上发开——红心 6 消失了，只剩方块 9 和红心 8。
从口袋里取出真正的红心 6 交给观众。
note_cn: 红背牌顶上要放那些没在蓝牌里展示的牌，只留红心 6，才能保证只有一个人上钩。
text_en:
Two packs of cards are used in this trick. We will call one the blue pack, the other the red.
About a dozen cards of the blue pack are spread around the table, all mixed together, but each card being partly visible. Each person is given a card from the red pack, and is told to see if his card is in sight among the blue cards spread on the table. One or two persons will say "No", and they are eliminated; but finally a person sees his card in view, so he is chosen for the trick. He shows his card to other people, and they verify the fact that it is present in the blue cards mixed on the table. The magician picks up the dozen blue cards, and riffles them. He deals them faces up. The chosen card is gone! The magician immediately produces it from his pocket! Method: The chosen card is the six of hearts. The blue cards that are spread on the table are carefully arranged. A nine of diamonds is laid face up, and also an eight of hearts. The lower right corner of the nine overlaps the upper left corner of the eight. Thus the nine-spot in the corner and the heart in the corner of the eight make an index of the six of hearts. Other cards are spread all around these, overlapping in such a way that the join is cleverly covered. The pretended 6 shows, also the heart and the two side hearts of the eight. Anyone will suppose that the six of hearts is on display. The real six of hearts, however, is in the magician's pocket!
On top of the red pack, the magician places cards that are not on display among the blues, with the one exception of the six of hearts. Thus the only person who can possibly see his card on display is the person who holds the six of hearts! He sees his card there at least he thinks he does but as soon as the cards are picked up the elusive six of hearts dissolves. When the cards are dealt, the eight of hearts and the nine of diamonds appear; but no six of hearts. It is in the magician's pocket and is produced from there!

effect_cn: 魔术师发下几张牌，把剩下的牌一翻，竟变成一包香烟，还从中抖出了几支烟。
method_cn: 小心拆开一包 20 支装纸包香烟，把封口的盖片折起来。
剪掉烟包背面的一部分，把两张牌粘在剪口处，牌面朝向背面，剩余的背纸盖片夹在两张牌之间。
压平后得到一个扁平的开口烟包，一面看是牌，另一面看是烟包。
往烟包里放几支香烟。
表演时先发几张牌，把假烟包混在牌中，让观众看到的是牌面。
把牌一张张丢开，直到假烟包；右手挡在它前面，左手拇指迅速把它翻面。
移开右手，露出烟包，抖出几支香烟，然后把烟包放进口袋。
note_cn: 翻面那一下要用右手完全挡住；假烟包装上牌后，厚度要和真牌相称。
text_en: The magician takes some cards, and deals a few of them on the table. He takes those that remain and changes them to a pack of cigarettes, from which he extracts a cigarette! Open a paper pack of twenty cigarettes, very carefully, and bend the flaps up. Cut out part of the back of the pack, and paste two cards there, the flaps that remain of the back coming between them. The cards are pasted so that the faces are toward the back. Press this package flap, and the result will be a flat, opened pack of cigarettes, with the face of a card on the back. From one side it will look like a card; from the other, like a pack of cigarettes. Put a few cigarettes in the pack, and hold it so people can see the card side, but with several cards in front of it. Toss the cards off until you come to the fake. Hold your right hand in front of it, and quickly reverse it with your left thumb. Take your hand away, and there is the pack of cigarettes, from which you can shake a few cigarettes. Then put the package in your pocket.

effect_cn: 两位观众先后从牌堆顶数出同样张数的牌，第二次数到最后一张，正是一开始放在牌堆顶的那张牌。
method_cn: 把想要的牌放在牌堆顶。
请一位观众从牌堆顶一张一张数出若干张（比如十二张）放到桌上。
让他把这叠数过的牌放回牌堆顶上——这个动作会把顺序颠倒。
请第二位观众从牌堆顶数出同样的张数来复核。
数到最后一张正好是原来那张顶牌，让他记住。
魔术师把牌堆贴在额头，神秘地说出这张牌，就能结束表演；也可以接着演本章里的其他节目。
note_cn: 第一位观众必须把数过的牌原样放回牌堆顶，顺序颠倒后迫选才成立。
text_en:
Here is a simple and effective method of making a person take a desired card.
The pack is given to a person and he is told to count any number of cards one at a time. He does and off this is then told to replace the cards on the pack— say twelve. Another person is told to verify the count. He does and when he reaches twelve he so, is told to look at the card and remember it. When the first person counted the cards, he reversed order. So when the second person counted their them, he ended on the card that was originally the top card! So all the magician had to do was start with the desired card on the top, and he knew that that card would be the chosen one' The magician can hold the pack to his head and name the forced card in a mysterious manner, thus concluding an trick. Or he can perform one of the following effective tricks:

effect_cn: 打开双底盖金表，观众看到自己选的牌的影像隐隐映在表壳内侧。
method_cn: 准备一张不超过一英寸高的小牌，贴在外壳的内侧。
用前面讲过的迫选法，从普通牌堆里迫出这张牌。
打开表的外壳，以一定角度举起来。
选牌的影像会反射到内壳上，看上去像表壳本来就带着这张牌。
练熟之后，可以把小牌偷偷塞进借来的表；演完再用蘸湿的食指指尖把它取走。
note_cn: 成败在角度：要让小牌的反光正好落进内壳，可先在借来的表上试。
text_en: The magician opens a gold watch with a double back and a person who has asks selected a card to look at the inner back To his surprise the person sees the image of the card he chose, faintly shining on the case of the watch! Method: Prepare a tiny card not more than an inch high, and stick it on the inside of the outer case. Force that card from an ordinary pack in the manner previously explained. Then open the outer case of the watch and hold it at an angle. The image or the chosen card will be reflected on the inner case. With a little practice the magician can secretly introduce the tiny card into a borrowed watch, and deftly remove it with the tip of his moistened forefinger, after the trick has been concluded.

effect_cn: 观众选一张牌，魔术师看都不看，从两个裤袋里各抽一张，恰好凑出这张牌的点数与花色。
method_cn: 让观众洗牌，魔术师接过牌堆浏览一遍，记住顶牌。
另取两张牌：一张与顶牌点数相同，一张与顶牌花色相同。
把这两张牌分别放进左、右裤袋。
用本章前面讲的数牌法迫出那张顶牌。
观众说出选牌后，魔术师不看牌，从两个裤袋各取一张，正好一张是点数、一张是花色。
note_cn: 两张「拆分牌」要提前核对并分放左右口袋，取出时不要低头看。
text_en:
The magician takes two cards from the pack and puts one each trousers pocket. A in spectator chooses a card. Suppose the it is
nine of clubs. Without looking at the card, the magician draws the cards from his pockets. One is a nine, the other is a club. Method: Have the pack shuffled, and run through it noting the top card. Take two cards that correspond to it, as a jack and a diamond for the jack of diamonds, or whatever the case may be. Then force the top card by the counting method described previously in this chapter and the trick will work itself!
III Checkers are common objects that are suited to many impromptu tricks; yet somehow they have been neglected in the past. There are, however, quite a few good checker tricks in existence, and some of them are explained in this chapter. Every household has its checker-board and set of checkers. They are inexpensive articles that can furnish many minutes of diversion and entertainment.

effect_cn: 十枚棋子叠成一柱，魔术师用手指弹出另一枚棋子撞上去，从下数第四枚黑棋应声飞出，整柱棋子却纹丝不动。
method_cn: 把十枚棋子叠成一柱，只有从下往上数第四枚是黑棋，其余全是红棋。
另外拿一枚棋子竖立在桌面上，用一根手指压住它的上沿。
手指下压，使这枚棋子贴着桌面飞速弹射出去，撞向棋柱。
撞击之后，从下数第四枚的黑棋被弹出，其余棋子并不倒下。
黑棋的高度刚好迎上这记撞击，所以飞出去的是它。
note_cn: 若用的是特别厚的棋子，被弹出的可能是从下数第三枚，需先试验再确定黑棋位置。
text_en:
Ten checkers are stacked up, and all are red except the fourth from the bottom, which is black. The magician stands another checker on edge, and by pressing down with his finger, snaps it so that it shoots rapidly on edge against the stack of checkers. Instead of the stack falling, or the bottom checker going out, the one black checker, fourth from the bottom, flies from the stack, while the other checkers do not fall. This is a very surprising experiment, and it is hard to believe, even after one has seen it performed. It is becauses the black checker is just high enough to receive the blow from the edge of the checker. Note: If unusually thick checkers are used, it is possible that the third checker from the bottom may be the one ejected. This
can be determined by experiment, and the black checker should be placed at the proper position.

effect_cn: 三枚棋子红、黑、红排成一行，魔术师只拿起一枚红棋，就让两枚红棋把黑棋夹在中间，另一枚红棋和黑棋都没有被碰过。
method_cn: 在桌上把三枚棋子排成一行：红、黑、红。
声明条件：只移动一枚红棋，让它落到另一枚红棋和黑棋之间，不许碰第二枚红棋，也不许移动黑棋。
用食指按定黑棋，另一只手拿起第一枚红棋，用力向黑棋推撞。
撞击的震动会让第二枚红棋滑开一小段，黑棋因为被按住而不动。
把第一枚红棋放进滑开的红棋与黑棋之间。
note_cn: 推撞要短促有力，桌面要够滑；手指必须按定黑棋。
text_en: Lay three checkers in a row, a black between two reds. Then ask someone to move one red one so that it comes between the other red and the black; yet the second red checker must not be touched, and the black checker must not be moved! These conditions make the trick sound impossible; but the procedure is very simple. Place a forefinger on the black checker, and with the other hand slide the first red checker forcibly against the black. The blow will cause the second red checker to slide away, although the black checker is not moved. Then the first red checker may be placed between the second red and the black.

effect_cn: 十枚棋子排成一行，魔术师一枚一枚拿起、越过两枚放下，最后十枚棋子变成了整整齐齐的五叠。
method_cn: 把十枚棋子排成一行，从左到右在心里编号 1 到 10。
规则：每次拿起一枚棋子，越过两枚（无论它们还是单枚，还是已经叠成了叠），放到下一枚上面。
第一步：4 越过 3 和 2，放到 1 上。
第二步：6 越过 7 和 8，放到 9 上。
第三步：8 越过 7 和 5，放到 3 上。
第四步：2 越过 3 和 8，放到 5 上。
第五步：10 越过 9 和 6，放到 7 上，正好形成五叠。
note_cn: 每一步都必须真的越过两枚，次序和编号一旦记错，后面就叠不成。
text_en:
The magician lays ten checkers in a row, and starts to make kings in a peculiar fashion. He lifts one checker, passes it over two, and sets it on the next checker. He lifts another, passes it over two and sets it on the next checker, and continues thus until he has made five kings with ten checkers. He must always pass the lifted checker over two, whether those two are separate or have been made into a king. People who try to duplicate the quick and certain moves of the magician will generally make a mistake before they accomplish the trick. Here are the correct moves: Pick up 4 and pass it over 3 and 2 setting it on 1; 6 over 7 and 8, placed on 9; 8 over 7 and 5, placed on 3; 2 over the 3 and 8, placed on 5; 10 over the 9 and 6,
placed on 7. The numbers refer to the positions of the checkers in the row.

effect_cn: 观众心里想一个数，沿着摆成「9」字形的棋子数一圈再折返回来，最后停在哪枚棋子上，背过身的魔术师也能立刻指出来。
method_cn: 用至少十二枚棋子摆出一个阿拉伯数字「9」的形状。
请观众心里想一个数，这个数必须大于「9」字底部一条上的棋子数。
让他从「9」字末端那枚开始，沿底部一路数上去，再绕圆圈数到心里想的那个数。
然后从那枚棋子开始往回数，这次避开「9」的底部，继续绕圆，仍数到同一个数停下。
魔术师背对着，等他说数完，立刻指出最后停下的那枚棋子。
诀窍：数清「9」字底部有几枚棋子，再从底部与圆圈的交接处向左沿圆数出同样多枚，那就是落点。
note_cn: 改变「9」字底部的棋子数就能重复表演，每次落点都会变。
text_en:
With a number of checkers make a figure 9. At least a dozen checkers should be used. Tell a person to think of a number which must exceed the number of checkers in the bottom of the figure 9. Then, commencing at the end checker, he is to count mentally up the base of the 9, and around the circle until he reaches the number thought of. Then, starting with that checker, he must reverse his count, this time avoiding the bottom of the 9, and continuing around the circle, until he stops at the number chosen mentally. This is done while the magician's back is turned, but the magician can immediately point out the checker upon which the count is ended. Here is the system If the person counted up to his number, and then back again the way he came, he would end where he began. But instead he takes another course. So the magician simply notes the number of checkers in the bottom part of the 9, and counts that many around the circle to the left of its unction with
the base. The person's count will always end on that checker, no matter what number he selects. The trick may be repeated by changing the number of checkers in the base of the 9.

effect_cn: 魔术师把一枚棋子按在木门上，松手后棋子竟贴在门上不掉，好像木头有磁性一样。
method_cn: 选一枚有一面光滑的棋子。
把棋子贴在门或木器表面，一边向上用力，一边顺势滑动一小段距离。
摩擦产生的吸附让棋子粘在木面上，松手也不会掉。
需要取下时直接拿开即可。
note_cn: 不要在高度抛光的上漆木面上做，容易划伤表面。
text_en: The magician takes a checker and sets it against the door. The checker remains there, and does not fall. Apparently it is magnetized to the door, thus proving that wood is magnetic! Method: It is best to use a checker with a smooth side for this trick. In setting it against the door, or the wood-work, press it upward, sliding it a short distance. The friction will cause the checker to adhere to the wood. Do not work this trick on any highly polished wood-work, as it may scratch the surface.

effect_cn: 一叠七枚棋子中间夹着一枚黑棋，用纸筒罩住再提起，黑棋竟消失了，剩下的全是红棋。
method_cn: 准备七枚红色棋子。
用黑纸剪一个能松套在棋子上的纸圈，套在中间那枚红棋上，看上去就像一枚黑棋。
把棋子叠成一柱，套纸圈的那枚放在中间，整柱略微有些不齐。
用纸筒从上方罩住棋子柱，借罩下的动作把柱身扶正。
提起纸筒时，黑纸圈被筒的内壁一起带上去、藏进筒里，桌上只剩红棋。
note_cn: 纸圈要松到能被纸筒带走、又紧到能套住棋子；提起纸筒时要贴桌垂直上提。
text_en: A stack of about seven checkers is set up with a black checker in the midst of red ones. The stack is covered with a paper tube; when the tube is lifted, the black checker is gone, and only red ones remain! Method: Cut a loose ring of black paper that will fit around a checker. ALL of the checkers in the stack are red ones, but the center one has the ring around it, and appears to be black. The stack should be slightly uneven. The paper tube is used to straighten the stack, and the tube when lifted carries away the black ring inside, leaving all red checkers.

effect_cn: 八枚红黑相间的棋子排成一行，魔术师只移四次、每次两枚，就把红棋和黑棋各自归到了一起。
method_cn: 把八枚棋子红黑相间排成一行。
把位置从左到右编号 1 到 8，并在右侧另设 9、10 两个空位。
第一次：把 2、3 两枚整体移到 9、10。
第二次：把 5、6 两枚移到 2、3。
第三次：把 8、9 两枚移到 5、6。
第四次：把 1、2 两枚移到 8、9。
四次移动做完，所有红棋都在一起，所有黑棋也都在一起。
note_cn: 每次必须连拿相邻的两枚整体平移，编号或空位错一个就排不回来。
text_en:
The magician places eight checkers in a row, alternating red and black. He makes four quick moves, moving two checkers
at a time, and at the finish, all the reds are together and so are all the blacks! To learn this quick little trick, number the checkers from I to 8, and assume that there are two other spaces, o and 10, which are not filled with checkers. Then move the checkers thus: 2 and 3 to 9 and 10; 5 and 6 to 2 and 3; 8 and 9 to 5 and 6; 1 and 2 to 8 and 9. All the reds will then be together; and so will all the blacks.

effect_cn: 三枚棋子反复拿起、放下，明明数到了十二，再数一遍却只能数到十一，谁也看不出少在哪里。
method_cn: 把三枚棋子放在桌上。
拿起棋子，数「一、二、三」，再一枚一枚放下，数「四、五、六」。
再次拿起棋子数「七、八」，但在拿起最后一枚时立刻把它放回桌上，同时数「九」。
接着放下手里剩下的两枚，数「十、十一」。
总数就这样变成了十一，而不是十二。
note_cn: 观众自己试时会先把棋子一枚枚放上桌再数，所以必然失败；想再演一遍容易露底，最好接着演下一个节目。
text_en: Lay three checkers on the table. Pick them up, counting "one, two, three", and lay them down, one at a time, counting "four, five, six". Pick them up, counting "seven, eight, nine", and lay them down counting "ten, eleven, twelve". This appears quite fair; but when the count is repeated, it ends at eleven instead of twelve, and no one can tell why! Method: Picking up the checkers, count "one, two, three", and laying them down count — "four, five, six". Then pick them up, counting "seven, eight " but as you pick up the last checker, immediately lay it down as you say "nine". Then follow with the two checkers in your hand, counting "ten, eleven". This is very deceptive, and it will completely baffle people. When they want to try it, give them the checkers, and they will start the count by laying the checkers one at a time on the table. This means failure, as the checkers must be on the table at the start. Of course everyone will want to see this trick repeated. To repeat it might give away the secret; so instead, the following trick should be performed

effect_cn: 同样三枚棋子，观众数来数去只有九，魔术师却能数出十枚。
method_cn: 把三枚棋子放在桌上。
请观众拿起数「一、二、三」，放下数「四、五、六」，再拿起数「七、八、九」。
轮到魔术师时，先把三枚棋子全部拿在手里。
一枚一枚放下，数「一、二、三」；然后指着末端那枚棋子数「四」。
把其余两枚拿起来数「五、六」，随即把桌上剩下那枚也拿起来数「七」。
再把手里三枚一枚枚放下，数「八、九、十」。
note_cn: 嘴里数「四」时只用手指点、不拿起棋子，动作要连贯自然。
text_en:
Three checkers are laid on the table. A person is told to pick them up counting "one, two, three", and to lay them down count-
ing "four, five, six", and then to pick them up counting "seven, eight, nine'*. But when the magician counts the checkers, his total is ten! Method: The magician starts with the checkers in his hand, and lays them down counting "one, two, three". He points at an end checker and says "four", then picks up the other two counting "five six". He immediately picks up the checker still on the table, saying "seven", and lays down the checkers from his hand, one at a time, counting "eight, nine, ten".

effect_cn: 三枚黑棋在左、三枚红棋在右，中间空一格；按规则一步步移动，最后红黑两队互换了位置，看似根本做不到。
method_cn: 在纸上画一排七个方格。
左边三格放黑棋，右边三格放红棋，中间一格空着。
规则：黑棋只能向右走，红棋只能向左走，每次只能走一格，可以跳过一枚相邻的棋子。
第一条秘诀：先用一种颜色走一格，再用另一种颜色跳一次；跳完之后，仍由刚跳的那色继续走。
看空位决定下一步是跳还是走一格；第九步之后规则不再适用，但后面的走法都很直观。
note_cn: 这个换位至少要十五步才能完成，先按口诀慢练，熟了再加快。
text_en: Take a piece of paper and on it mark seven squares in a row. Place three black checkers in the three squares at the left, and three red checkers in the squares at the right. The trick is to transpose the checkers, putting red on the left and black on the right, in accordance with the following rules: black can move only to the right, red only to the left; each checker can be moved only one square at a time; single jumps are allowed. This is a very perplexing problem, which cannot be performed in less than fifteen moves. There is a system to it, and the magician can execute it quickly and perfectly by following two simple rules: First: Start with any color checker and move it, but after every single move by one color, make a jump with the other color. After a jump, advance with the same color that made the jump. The positions will indicate whether you must make another jump or just a single move. After the ninth move, the rules do not apply, but from that point on the moves are easy and obvious.

effect_cn: 魔术师数出十二枚棋子，请观众再数一遍却只有十一枚，第十二枚随后从他口袋里变了出来。
method_cn: 把十二枚棋子摆在桌上，数给观众看。
收拢棋子叠起来时，偷偷把一枚握在右手掌心里；右手只伸出拇指和食指来数棋子。
既然已经数到十二，现在倒着数：把棋子一枚枚放进新的一叠，边放边数「十二、十一、十、九、八、七」。
左手拿起剩下的几枚，展示给观众，同时说「再加五枚就是十二」。
把这剩下的棋子和新叠合在一起交给观众；这样一数，十一枚就冒充成了十二枚。
右手把暗藏的棋子放进口袋，再假装从口袋里取出第十二枚。
观众数自己手里的棋子，发现只有十一枚。
note_cn: 倒数的节奏和「再加五枚」那句话要说得自然，观众才不会跟着重数。
text_en: The magician takes twelve checkers and counts them. He counts them a second time, and asks a person them. The magician then produces one of the checkers from his pocket, and when the spectator counts the checkers, he finds that he has only eleven! Method: This is done by a clever method of counting. First count the twelve checkers on the table. In stacking them up, secretly hold one in the right hand, which is closed, only the right thumb and forefinger being extended, to count the stack of checkers. As the checkers have been counted up to twelve, the counting is now reversed. As each checker is laid in a new stack, it is counted thus: "twelve eleven ten nine eight seven ". Then the — left hand picks up the remaining checkers, shows them and says "and five makes twelve". Those checkers are then added to the stack which is held by the spectator. By this count, eleven checkers have been made to appear a* twelve. The magician puts his right hand in his pocket and brings out the odd checker. When the holder counts his checkers he will be surprised to find only eleven.

effect_cn: 在棋盘上摆八枚棋子，使任意两枚都不在同一横线、竖线或斜线上，别人怎么试都摆不成。
method_cn: 记住这串数字：5、2、4、6、8、3、1、7，注意偶数在轮转出现。
把棋盘放在面前，第一枚棋子放在第一行的第 5 格。
第二枚放在第二行第 2 格，第三枚放在第三行第 4 格，依此类推。
八枚按这串数字摆完，任何两枚都不在同一横行、竖列或斜线上。
note_cn: 背熟 5-2-4-6-8-3-1-7 这串数字，就能瞬间摆出答案。
text_en:
Eight checkers and the checker-board are used in this trick. The object is to lay eight checkers on the board in such a way that no two will be in the same line, vertical, horizontal or diagonal. People will try this puzzler for a long time with no success; but one who knows the secret can do it in an instant. Simply remember the following numbers: 5, 2, 4, 6, 8, 3, 1, 7. Note how the even numbers run in rotation. Place the checker-board in front of you and lay the first checker on the fifth square of the top row; the next on the second square
of the second row, and so on, according to your formula. Then the conditions of the trick will be fulfilled.

effect_cn: 观众把红棋和一枚黑棋丢进帽子里，魔术师把手背到身后伸进帽中，一下就摸出了那枚黑棋。
method_cn: 让观众任选一枚黑棋，连同所有红棋一起丢进帽子里。
魔术师事先已把另一枚同样的黑棋藏在手指下面，捏在帽檐内侧，或塞进帽子的内圈带里。
把帽子端到背后，换手时取出那枚暗藏的黑棋。
装作刚从帽子里摸出黑棋，随即把帽子倒扣在桌上。
红棋倒出来时盖住桌上原有的那枚黑棋，真黑棋混入其中，没人怀疑它不是从帽子里拿出来的。
note_cn: 两枚黑棋要看起来一模一样；倒帽子时别让观众看清里面。
text_en: All the red checkers are thrown into a hat, along with a black checker the spectators selecting any black checker that they wish. The magician shakes the hat, and holds it behind his back. Then reaching in, he immediately draws out the black checker from among the red ones. Method: The magician secretry obtains possession of a black checker. This he holds beneath his fingers which are holding the inside of the hat brim or the checker can be put beneath the inside band of the hat. When the hat is behind his back, the magician shifts hands and brings out the duplicate black checker. He immediately turns over the hat on the table, and lets the red checkers fall out upon the remaining black checkers which are lying there. Thus the original black checker joins its companions, and no one suspects that it was not taken from the hat at all!

props: 两枚一面异色的特制棋子
effect_cn: 红、黑两叠棋子各用纸筒罩住，相隔数尺放好；魔术师一声令下，掀起纸筒，两叠棋子的位置竟然互换了。
method_cn: 在两叠棋子的最底下各放一枚特制棋子：一枚上面是红色、底面涂黑；另一枚上面是黑色、底面涂红。
把两叠棋子分别用纸卷成的圆筒罩住，筒口上端拧紧，从上方看不见棋子。
把红叠和黑叠相隔数尺放在桌上。
把两个纸筒混着转一圈，再借掀筒的动作歪起筒口，让人瞥见最底下那枚棋子的底面。
这样黑叠看上去是红的、红叠看上去是黑的。
假装下令让两叠互换，再掀起纸筒，观众看到的就是两叠棋子换了位置。
note_cn: 特制棋子的底面颜色要涂得像真棋子；歪筒亮底的那一下要快而自然。
text_en:
Two stacks of checkers are used in this trick one stack red, the other black. Each stack is wrapped up in a piece of paper, the paper being made into a cylinder which surrounds the stack, and the top being twisted over to hide the checkers from above. The red stack is placed several feet away from the black, and the magician commands them to change places. When he lifts the paper cylinders, the checkers have obeyed the order, the black being where the red were supposed to be, and vice versa. Two special checkers are required for this trick. One is red,
but with black on the bottom; the other is black, with the bottom colored red. It is best to have the bottoms painted the opposite color, but a circular piece of paper may be glued beneath each checker, instead. The prepared checkers are the bottom ones of the stacks. After each stack is surrounded with a cylinder, the magician closes the tops of the cylinders and mixes them around. Then, to learn which color is in a cylinder, he tilts up the cylinder and lets people glimpse the bottom of the lowermost checker. In this manner, the black stack is identified as red, and the red stack is supposed to be the black. The magician merely commands, lifts the paper cylinders, and shows the marvelous transposition.

effect_cn: 雪茄上的烟标突然消失，魔术师把雪茄再转半圈，烟标又回到了原处。
method_cn: 把一枚雪茄烟标剪成两半，只留下带徽记的那一半。
用胶水把这半枚烟标粘在雪茄上。
展示雪茄时，它看起来和普通的带标雪茄没有两样。
用拇指和食指捏住雪茄，挥一下并转半圈，把带烟标的一面转到看不见的角度。
烟标便「消失」了；再转半圈，它又出现。
note_cn: 转动要一次完成、别停顿，练到观众看不出前后是同一面。
text_en: This is a smart little trick that is not difficult. A cigar band suddenly disappears from a cigar, and then comes back again. Cut a cigar band in half so that only the emblem remains. Glue the half band to a cigar. When the cigar is shown, the band appears to be quite ordinary. Wave the cigar and give it a half turn between the thumb and forefinger, thus turning the banded side away from view. The band apparently disappears. Another half turn will bring it back. A little practise will make this an effective trick.

effect_cn: 魔术师把雪茄稳稳地立在帽顶上，看上去像全凭平衡功夫，其实藏着机关。
method_cn: 从帽子内侧把一根针穿过帽顶，让针尖朝上露出一点。
把雪茄的一端架在针尖上，雪茄就立住了。
表演时做出小心寻找平衡的样子，让观众以为这是真功夫。
收场时把手伸进帽子内侧拔掉针，雪茄自然落下，可随手接住。
note_cn: 针要短而细，露出帽顶的部分不要太多，免得被看出。
text_en: Balancing a cigar on a hat is not a difficult trick when you know the secret! A derby hat is the best to use; but another hat will do. Simply push a pin through the crown of the hat from the inside. Then set the end of the cigar on the pin, and the cigar will balance perfectly on the hat. In doing this trick, the magician should pretend that it is quite difficult a feat of genuine balancing. By reaching up inside the hat the magician can remove the pin and release the cigar.

effect_cn: 雪茄横放在帽顶上，魔术师拨一下它的一端，雪茄就绕着看不见的轴一圈圈转起来。
method_cn: 和上一个节目一样，从帽子内侧把一根短针穿过帽顶。
把雪茄中部的侧面压在针尖上。
拨动雪茄的一端，它就围着针尖这个看不见的支点旋转。
转速慢下来时再拨一下，就能一直转。
note_cn: 针尖要顶在雪茄重心附近，否则雪茄会掉下来。
text_en:
The magician sets a cigar on its side on the crown of a hat, and flips one end of the cigar. The cigar immediately revolves on the hat, spinning around and around.
As in the last trick a short pin, through the crown of the hat, is responsible. In this case, the side of the cigar, at the center, is pressed on the pin. Hit the end of the cigar and it will revolve Dn the unseen pivot.

props: 一支带软木烟嘴的香烟
effect_cn: 香烟从左拳穿进去，软木烟嘴先进；等它从另一边出来，烟嘴却跑到了后面。
method_cn: 把一支香烟的软木烟嘴切下来，套到一支更细的香烟上，让烟嘴能在烟身上自由滑动。
把烟嘴那头朝前推进左拳，手指暗暗夹住烟嘴。
让香烟在指间滑过去，直到滑到烟身的末端。
这时松开烟嘴，它就从烟身的另一端露了出来。
note_cn: 两支香烟的粗细要配合得刚好，烟嘴滑动顺畅但不松脱。
text_en: cork-tipped cigarette is pushed through the left fist, the cork tip going in first. When the cigarette comes out the other side, the cork tip comes last. This is accomplished by cutting the cork-tip from a cigarette, and putting it on a smaller cigarette. Thus the cork-tip will slide freely along the cigarette. When the cork-tip end is pushed into the fist, the fingers retain the tip, and let the cigarette slide through until the end of the cigarette is reached; then the tip is released, so it comes out on the other end of the cigarette.

effect_cn: 雪茄放在左手指尖上，手掌慢慢翻转，雪茄却像被磁铁吸住一样不掉下来。
method_cn: 把小针的针尖朝内、针头夹在左手两根手指的指节之间。
把雪茄轻轻扎在针尖上，它就会「粘」在指尖。
手掌可以任意翻转，雪茄都不会掉。
取下雪茄时，手指略微张开，让小针悄悄落到地上。
note_cn: 针要夹稳，取雪茄的动作要自然，别让观众看见针。
text_en: A cigar is laid upon the finger tips of the left hand. The hand is slowly turned over, and the cigar remains there as though magnetized. The hand may be held in any position, but the cigar does not fall until it is removed and laid on the table. A small pin does the trick. The pin is set with the head between the knuckles of two fingers on the left hand. The cigar is set on the pin point, which projects straight inwards, and it will adhere there. When the cigar is removed, the fingers are opened slightly, allowing the pin to fall unobserved to the floor.

effect_cn: 魔术师凭空卷了一支看不见的香烟，用火柴点上，最后竟真的抽起了一支烟。
method_cn: 准备一盒火柴，抽出内盒，在一端剪一个小口，大小刚好能通过一支香烟。
把一支香烟从剪口塞进内盒靠里的一端，再把内盒推出半截，用真火柴盖住香烟。
表演时先做一整套哑剧：假装从口袋取出烟纸、打开烟袋、装烟丝、卷烟、叼在嘴里。
划着一根火柴，双手捂向嘴边像在挡风，同时用左手把内盒推合。
内盒一合，香烟就从靠里的那端顶出来；双手送到嘴边，嘴唇正好衔住它。
手稍稍前移，香烟从盒中完全抽出，立刻用火柴点燃；放下手时，已叼着一支点着的烟。
右手甩灭火柴，左手把火柴盒收进口袋。
note_cn: 左手推盒与嘴唇衔烟必须同时完成；哑剧演得越像，最后越惊人。
text_en:
This is an interesting pantomime which ends with a trick as the climax. The magician lays a partly opened box of matches on the
table. Then he pretends to take a cigarette paper from his pocket. He opens an imaginary tobacco pouch and loads the invisible cigarette paper. Then he goes through the actions of rolling a cigarette, which he pretends to place in his mouth. As if to add a bit of realism to the pantomime, the magician lights a match and holding his hands cupped on account of a pretended wind, he proceeds to light the imaginary cigarette. When he finishes the action, he is smoking a real cigarette, which has appeared from nowhere! Method: Take a box of safety matches and cut a piece out of one end of the drawer, just large enough to admit a cigarette. Insert a cigarette in the drawer. Push the drawer part way open at the other end and take care that the cigarette is covered with real matches. Everything is pantomime up until the match is lighted. The box is held in the left hand, and the right strikes the match. As if to avoid a wind, both hands are raised, cupped to the mouth. The left hand pushes the drawer shut, which causes the cigarette to project from the inner end. As the hands reach the mouth, the lips grasp the cigarette. The hands are brought forward a bit so that the cigarette is drawn clear from the box, and the cigarette is immediately lighted from the match. When the hands are lowered, there is the lighted cigarette! The right hand shakes out the match while the left hand pockets the match box.

effect_cn: 魔术师对着左手的烟包下令，一支香烟竟自己从烟包里升了起来，可那支烟根本不在包里。
method_cn: 左手拿一包烟，烟包不要装得太满。
把一支烟藏在烟包后面，由左拇指按住；其余手指在烟包前面、指尖朝上。
右手指在烟包上方做几个 pass 动作，装作施法。
左拇指把暗藏的烟一点点往上推，远看就像烟从包里升起。
右手指在烟完全露出时把它取走，随后可把烟包交给观众检查。
note_cn: 烟包背面要微微内压，拇指推烟的速度要均匀，别一截一截地跳。
text_en:
A pack of cigarettes is held in the left hand. At the magician's command, one of the cigarettes rises out of the pack, of its own accord. The cigarette is not in the pack at all. It is in back, where it is held by the thumb, which is in the rear of the pack, the fingers being in front, pointing upward.
The back of the pack is pressed in slightly, as the pack is not entirely full of cigarettes. The right hand makes passes above the pack, and the left thumb pushes the hidden cigarette upwards. From two feet away, it appears as though the cigarette is rising from within the pack. The right hand takes the cigarette when it has emerged and the pack may then be examined. This is a very effective little illusion.

effect_cn: 两手捏住一支香烟往两边拉，香烟竟被一点点拉长，最后变成原来两倍长。
method_cn: 准备一支同品牌的长支香烟，横着藏在左手掌里。
双手拿起普通香烟，做把它往中间推挤的动作，好像它是可伸缩的。
推挤时把短烟推进右手，由右拇指夹住；两手手背朝观众，指尖相触。
左拇指把长支香烟往前推，两手改捏住长烟，慢慢向两边拉开。
长烟一点点被拉出，看上去就像原来那支被拉长了。
拉出全长后把烟换到左手，右手顺便伸进外套口袋，把原来那支短烟留在口袋里，取出火柴盒。
note_cn: 两支烟必须同品牌、粗细颜色一致；拉开的速度要稳，别让人看见接缝。
text_en: This is a trick that requires a bit of skill. cork-tipped cigarette is taken between the hands, which draw upon it and stretch it to twice its usual length! Certain brands of cigarettes are made in long sizes, and the magician must obtain one of these long cigarettes. The long cigarette is hidden in the left hand, lengthways, just as the cigar was held in the cigar and pocketbook trick. The hands then take a normal cigarette of the same brand, and pretend to push it together, as though it were telescopic. In doing this, the cigarette is pushed into the right hand, where it is held by the thumb. The backs of both hands are towards the audience and the finger tips are touching. The left thumb pushes forward the long cigarette, and the hands begin to draw upon it, instead of the other cigarette. As the hands are gradually pulled apart, the cigarette appears to stretch. When it has finally developed to its full length, it is transferred to the left hand, while the right hand quietly goes to the coat pocket and brings out a box of matches leaving the original cigarette in the pocket. As a great many persons are not familiar with the long cigarettes, this trick often creates more than ordinary surprise.

effect_cn: 一支烟架在桌沿上，魔术师拿另一支在下方慢慢移动，桌上那支像被磁力吸引般朝它倾斜，最后掉进他手里。
method_cn: 把一支香烟放在桌沿，一部分悬空。
另一支香烟拿在桌面下方几英寸处，缓缓移动。
桌上那支香烟会朝它慢慢倾斜，最后从桌边掉下，落进伸出的手里。
所谓磁力只是幌子：魔术师俯身靠向桌沿时，轻轻朝悬空的香烟吹气，它就先倾斜、再掉落。
note_cn: 吹气要轻，靠俯身动作掩护；嘴里继续讲磁力的说辞，观众不会注意呼吸。
text_en: cigarette is placed on the edge of the table so that part of it overhangs. The magician holds another cigarette a few inches below it. As he moves the lower cigarette, the one on the table begins to tip towards it, as though magnetized; and finally it falls off the table, into the outstretched hand. Magnetism has nothing to do with the trick. It is simply offered as the reason to draw attention from the real method. As the magician leans over the table, he breathes lightly on the extended cigarette, thus causing it first to tip, and finally to fall from the table.

effect_cn: 魔术师把点着的香烟塞进左拳，用力一捏把烟掐灭，摊开手却毫发无伤，烟也不见了。
method_cn: 事先把一枚 thimble 藏在左拳里。
把燃着的香烟点着端朝前插进左拳，正好插进 thimble。
右手压住左拳，借挤压把烟掐灭。
右手掌在左拳下方托一下，装作接住火星；实际是让左手把 thimble 落进右手。
摊开左手，烟和 thimble 都不见了，手上也没有烧伤。
note_cn: 拔烟或捏拳之前先让 thimble 就位；「接火星」那一下要做得像真有必要。
text_en: cigarette is thrust into the left fist lighted end first. The magician squeezes his hand until the cigarette is extinguished. Then he opens his fist and shows that his hand has not suffered! thimble is held in the closed hand, and it receives the lighted end of the cigarette, which is extinguished when the right hand presses it into the thimble. As soon as the cigarette is removed or before the right hand squeezes the left fist, the right palm being held below the left hand. This is done to "extinguish any sparks". In reality it allows the left hand to drop the thimble into the right, so the left hand can be shown empty, and uninjured.

effect_cn: 魔术师打开烟盒，里面空空如也；合上再打开，却从盒里取出了两支香烟。
method_cn: 事先把香烟藏在烟盒里，位置很巧妙。
表演时打开烟盒，向观众展示里面是空的。
合上烟盒，再重新打开。
从盒中取出两支香烟。
note_cn: 原文在说明藏法时截断（只写到 artfully），具体做法未给出，此处按可见效果整理（原文此处不全）。
text_en: The magician opens a cigarette case and finds it empty. He closes the case, and opening it again, produces two cigarettes from the interior. The cigarettes are in the case all the time; but they are artfully

effect_cn: 硬币放进火柴盒、合上抽屉摇一摇还有响声，再打开时硬币却不见了。
method_cn: 事先在火柴盒内盒的一端剪一道小缝，大小刚好能让硬币通过。
把硬币从缝隙塞进内盒，平时看不出来。
把硬币放进盒里，合上抽屉，横向摇动，让观众听到硬币在里面响。
把盒子朝自己这边倾斜、让剪缝那一头朝内，硬币就滑出来落进手里。
另一只手接过盒子放到一边，稍后再打开给观众看。
note_cn: 剪缝要开在盒角不显眼处；摇盒时只能横向摇，否则硬币会提前滑出。
text_en: coin is placed in a match box; the drawer is closed and the box is shaken to show that the coin is still there. When the box is opened the coin has disappeared. The box is prepared by cutting in one end of the drawer a slit just large enough to admit a coin. The opening will not be noticed. When the box is shaken sideways, the coin will ratde; but as soon as you tilt the box towards yourself, with the trick end inwards, the coin will slide out into your hand. The other hand should then take the box and lay it aside, to be opened later.

props: 一个能让硬币滑过的硬筒
effect_cn: 刚才从火柴盒里消失的硬币，最后从一团羊毛球中间被拆出来，当啷一声落进玻璃杯。
method_cn: 用金属或硬纸做一个扁筒，让硬币能从里面滑过。
把羊毛绕着这个筒卷成一个球。
你已经把火柴盒里的硬币藏到手后，转身去拿羊毛球，把硬币从筒里放进去。
抽出筒，把羊毛球拿到观众面前，放进一只玻璃杯。
请人把羊毛球拆开，硬币就落进杯里。
note_cn: 要用做过记号的硬币；若用松散的羊毛球，也可以直接把硬币塞进羊毛再揉紧，不必用筒。
text_en: After "vanishing" the coin in the manner explained, you can reproduce it from the center of a ball of wool. To do this, make a flat, stiff tube, of metal or cardboard, through which the coin can slide, and wind the wool around it. When you have secredy gained possession of the coin that was in the match box, turn to get the ball of wool. Drop the coin through the tube, pull out the tube and bring on the ball of wool. Put the wool in a glass; let someone unwind it, and the coin will drop "clink" into the glass. A marked coin should be used. By using a loose ball of wool, you can work the trick without the tube. The coin is merely pushed through the wool and the ball squeezed around it.

props: 直径约一英寸半的戒指
effect_cn: 戒指放在纸上，用纸板一盖；把戒指罩到硬币上再掀开纸板，硬币不见了；再盖一下，硬币又回来了。
method_cn: 在戒指底部粘一片与桌面垫纸同色、和戒指一样大的圆纸片。
把戒指放在纸上，圆纸片看起来就是纸的一部分，没人会发现。
用一小块方形硬纸板把戒指盖住。
把戒指罩到硬币上，再掀起纸板，硬币被圆纸片挡住，看起来消失了。
再把戒指盖住、拿开，硬币就又出现。
note_cn: 圆纸片的颜色必须和垫纸完全一致；这招太有名，最好只当作下一招的引子。
text_en: For this trick you require a ring about an inch and a half in diameter. The ring is laid on a piece of paper and is covered with a small square of cardboard. When the ring is set over a coin and the cardboard square is lifted, the coin will be gone. It will come back as soon as the ring is covered and lifted away. circle of paper, the size of the ring and the same color as the paper upon which the ring is laid, is pasted to the bottom of the ring. No one observes this, as the disc appears to be part of the sheet of paper. When the ring is placed over a coin, of course the coin will be out of sight. This trick is rather well-known, so it should be used only as a forerunner to the next trick:

props: 一条与纸板同宽的硬纸板
effect_cn: 纸板一盖一掀，硬币又消失了；但自称懂行的人拿起戒指检查，却发现戒指底下根本没有粘纸片。
method_cn: 准备一条和方形纸板一样宽的硬纸板，在其末端粘一小块木头，做成能随纸板一起掀起的托盘。
在木头底面抹一点蜡或铅膏。
把纸板盖到戒指上，再连戒指一起罩到硬币上，让木头粘住硬币。
掀起纸板，硬币被木头带走，顺手把它放进自己口袋。
「懂行」的人拿起戒指检查，发现没有纸片，反而更加困惑。
note_cn: 木头底面要够粘又不留痕；掀纸板时保持水平，别让硬币晃动出声。
text_en: The effect of this trick is identical to that of the last. A cardboard is set over a ring; the ring is set over a coin; when the cardboard is lifted, the coin is gone. Some "wise" person picks up the ring but finds that there is no paper pasted to it, after all! Hidden underneath the cardboard you have a little piece of wood, pasted to a strip of cardboard that is as wide as the cardboard square. Thus the little wooden affair can be lifted up with the square of cardboard. The bottom of the wooden piece is dabbed with wax or lead plaster. When the cardboard square is set over the ring, and both are put over the coin, the wooden piece picks up the coin. When the cardboard square is lifted, the coin is taken away and is calmly dropped in the pocket. The person who "knows all about it" picks up the ring and is surprised.

effect_cn: 一只手捏着三枚硬币，正反两面各看一遍都是三枚；把手一抖再摊开，三枚竟变成了六枚。
method_cn: 六枚硬币一直夹在手里，靠叠放方式让人看起来只有三枚。
一面叠三个正面、向外错开；另一面再叠两枚反面、朝相反方向错开，中间刚好给第六枚留出空间。
拇指和食指捏住硬币边缘，先展示一面，说「这边三枚正面」。
把手转过来展示另一面，说「这边三枚反面」，观众会以为前后是同样的三枚。
抖一抖手，再把硬币摊开，六枚全部出现。
note_cn: 叠放角度要精确；正反两面各看一次就收，别让观众盯着找破绽。
text_en: Three coins are held edgewise between the thumb and forefinger of one hand. The coins are overlapping and they are shown on one side— three heads— and on the other side— three The tails. hand shakes the coins, and when it is opened, the three have multiplied to six. The six coins are there all the time, but the method of holding makes them look like three. On one side are three heads, overlapping outward; on the other two more coins— tails overlap outward in the opposite direction. This allows space in between for the sixth coin. When you show one side, and remark, "Three coins heads on this side, and" (turning the hand around) "three tails on this side," every person will believe that he saw the same three coins each time.

effect_cn: 硬币按在膝盖上方的裤腿上，用布一盖，再把布拉直，硬币竟然凭空消失了。
method_cn: 准备一枚小金属圆片，边缘打一个孔，抹上蜡或铅膏，把松紧绳系在孔上。
松紧绳沿右袖往上，末端用安全别针固定；金属片平时挂在袖口上方、外套袖子里。
表演时把金属片从袖中拉出，粘在半美元硬币上；硬币夹在指尖，手背朝观众。
右手把硬币按在膝盖上方的裤腿上，左手把一些裤布折起来盖住硬币。
保持站姿；硬币一被盖住，右手就松压，硬币被松紧绳弹回袖子。
双手抓住翻起的裤布往下折，再把布拉直，硬币已经不见了。
note_cn: 松紧绳的弹力要够；盖布与松手必须在同一瞬间完成。
text_en:
This is a very clever vanishing coin trick. A half dollar is used; and beside the coin you require a small disc of metal, with a hole punched near one edge. The disc is smeared with wax or lead plaster and a piece of cord elastic is hitched to the hole in the disc. The elastic runs up the right sleeve and terminates in a safety-pin. The metal disc should hang just above the cuff, inside the coat sleeve. To perform the trick, draw the disc from the sleeve and affix it to the half dollar, which is held at the tips of the fingers. The back of the hand is turned to the audience. The right hand places the coin on the trouser leg, just above the knee, and holds it there, while the left hand folds some of the cloth up over the coin. A standing position must be assumed. As soon as the coin is covered, the right hand releases pressure and the coin flies up the sleeve. Then both hands take hold of the
upturned cloth and bend it downwards. Then the cloth is pulled out straight, and the coin is gone.

effect_cn: 硬币在空中一旋被右手接住，拍在左手手背上；等观众猜完正反，抬手一看，硬币根本不在。
method_cn: 把硬币在空中旋转抛起，右手去接。
接的时候手指伸直、手背朝观众，其实并不接，让硬币落进外套袖子里。
立刻握拳，装作已经接住，并把「硬币」拍在左手手背上。
问观众：是正面还是反面。
等对方猜完，抬起右手，展示硬币根本不在手里。
note_cn: 袖子要宽一点；拍手背的力度要和真的拍着硬币一样。
text_en: This is a quick little trick that requires some practice. coin is whirled in the air and is caught in the right hand, which slaps it on the back of the left. "Which is it," you ask, "heads or tails?" As soon as the guess has been made you lift your hand and show that the coin is not there at all. In "catching" the coin in the right hand, you must hold your fingers straight up, with the back of the hand towards the audience. As the coin apparently falls into your hand, you do not catch it, but let it drop into your coat sleeve. You close your fist, however, and pretend to slap the imaginary coin on the back of your left hand. This is a very effective illusion that is not difficult to perform after a time.

effect_cn: 观众把二角五分硬币摊在掌心，魔术师用指尖一击，他立刻握拳，摊开时掌心的硬币却变成了五分镍币。
method_cn: 事先把五分镍币夹在右手小指弯曲处。
请观众摊开手，把二角五分硬币放在他掌心。
你用指尖用力击打他的掌心，同时伸直小指，让五分镍币落下。
这一击会把二角五分震得弹起，你顺手把它带走并收回手。
观众以为自己握住了硬币，摊开却发现是五分镍币。
note_cn: 击掌、松币、收手要在瞬间完成；只求快和准，不必用力过猛。
text_en:
This is a feat of dexterity that will require careful practice, until the knack is acquired. A person is invited to hold out his hand, flat, with a quarter on the palm. When you strike his palm with your finger tips, he must close his fist immediately, so that you cannot get the coin. You strike his hand; he closes his fist, and he thinks he has the quarter safe but when he opens his hand, he finds a fivecent piece instead! Method: Hold the five cent piece in the crook of your little finger. As you strike his hand sharply with your finger-tips, extend your little finger, letting the nickel fall. The force of the blow will make the quarter bounce, and you may easily catch it as you withdraw your hand from his closing fist.
This must be done very quickly and adroitly but it is not a difficult trick. It simply requires care, speed and precision.

effect_cn: 双手摊开是空的，右手把桌上三枚铜币扫进左手，左手摊开却有四枚。
method_cn: 事先用一点肥皂把第四枚铜币粘在桌子底面。
把三枚铜币放在桌上，摊开双手示意是空的。
右手把三枚铜币扫向左手。
左手接币时，手指顺势把桌下那枚暗币一并抠下来。
摊开左手：四枚铜币。
note_cn: 肥皂只要一点，粘住即可；扫币动作要连贯，别让手在桌下停留。
text_en: Three pennies are laid on the table. Both hands are shown empty. The right hand sweeps the pennies off the table into the left. When the left hand is opened it contains four coins instead of three. The fourth coin is attached to the underside of the table by a dab of soap. While the left hand is receiving the three coins the left fingers secure the hidden coin and take it along with the others.

effect_cn: 观众手握一些硬币，魔术师把自己的硬币加进去，总数立刻按他的预言从奇数变偶数或从偶数变奇数。
method_cn: 请观众抓几枚硬币握在拳里。
魔术师自己也拿一些硬币，数量必须是奇数。
当众宣布：你手里若是奇数，我加上后就变偶数；若是偶数，我加上后就变奇数。
让观众数清自己的硬币，报出奇偶。
把魔术师的硬币加进去，总数果然按预言互换了奇偶。
note_cn: 自己必须始终拿奇数枚：奇数加奇数得偶数，偶数加奇数得奇数。
text_en: This is more of a catch than a trick; yet it is quite bewildering. person is asked to take several coins in his hand, and close his fist. Then the magician takes some coins in his hand. "I will add my coins to yours," announces the magician, "and if you now hold an odd number you will then have an even total. But if you now hold an even number, I will make your total odd." The person counts his coins, and finds that he has an odd number. The magician adds his, and the total is even, just as the magician stated it would be. The method is so absurdly simple that very few persons catch on to it. The magician merely has to take an odd number of coins. Then when they are added to the spectator's coins, they will surely make an even total odd, or an odd total even.

props: 一枚二角五分或半美元硬币
effect_cn: 魔术师把硬币往门上一按，松手后硬币竟贴在门上不掉，好像木头有磁性。
method_cn: 取一枚二角五分或半美元硬币，在边缘并排锉出两个小缺口，中间留下一个微小的凸点。
把凸点按在门上，硬币就平贴在木面上。
缺口几乎看不出来；把硬币碰落到地上，捡起时换成另一枚普通硬币交给观众检查。
也可以一开始就借观众的硬币，转身走向门口时把做好缺口的硬币换上去。
note_cn: 凸点要小、按正，别在漆面上划出痕迹。
text_en:
The magician takes a coin and sets it against the door, where it remains, as though magnetized.
Take a quarter or a half dollar and make two small nicks in the edge, side by side, thus raising a tiny projecting point. When the point is pressed against the door, the coin will stick flat against the woodwork. The little notch will hardly be noticed, but you can knock the coin on the floor, and in picking it up substitute another coin to give for examination. coin can be borrowed in the first place, and the notched coin substituted for it while you turn to walk to the door.

effect_cn: 小盒装满硬币，放在左手背上，右手一盖，硬币消失了；右手和盒子都是空的，硬币却全在左手里。
method_cn: 盒底用一枚硬币楔紧封住，盒内再垫一张圆纸片，让内底看起来是平的。
把六枚硬币装进盒子，放在左掌上，暗中把盒子倒过来。
观众看见的是盒底那枚硬币，以为在看整叠硬币的顶面。
右手提起盒子，硬币自然留在左手里；左手立刻握拳并翻过来。
右手把盒子放到左手手背上，观众仍以为盒子是满的。
右手掠过盒子时把它翻过来，盒子就显得空了。
右手拿起盒子放到桌上，左手摊开，露出六枚硬币。
note_cn: 原文末尾另附「三只小盖找硬币」的节目（用头发定位），本卡只整理硬币盒部分。
text_en:
There are various appliances called "Coin Boxes." This one is easily constructed. It may be made from a piece of a cardboard cylinder, or a wooden or metal tube. A little cylindrical box is shown and is filled with half a dozen coins of the same size. The box, still filled with coins, is set on the back of the left hand. The right hand covers the box, and presto, the coins disappear. The right hand and the box are both shown empty. The left fist is opened, and there are the coins. They have apparently passed through the back of the hand. Method: The box is nothing but a cylinder. The bottom is a coin which is wedged in place. On the inside of the box, the coin is covered with a disc of paper to make it appear as the inside of the box. The box is filled with coins. It is set on the palm of the left hand, and is secretly turned over. The spectators see the coin that forms the bottom of the box, and so they think they are seeing the top coin of the stack. The right hand lifts the box and of course the coins remain in the left hand, which is immediately formed into a fist and is turned back up. The box is set on the back of the hand, and the people still think it is filled with coins. In passing over the box, the right hand inverts it, so the box appears to be empty. The right hand picks up the box and sets
it on the table, and the left hand opens to reveal the missing coins. Three little covers, such as the tops of pill boxes, are needed in this trick. A half dollar is laid on the table, and anyone is invited to cover it with one of the covers, the other two covers being laid beside it so that the magician cannot tell which cover is over the coin. Yet when he passes his hand over the covers, he immediately names the one that conceals the coin. Method: On the underside of the half dollar a short hair is affixed by means of a piece of wax. No one will observe the hair, because no one is looking for it. The hair protrudes from under the cover which is over the coin, and by looking closely, the magician can discover the location of the coin.

effect_cn: 三枚硬币放在右手背上一起抛起，落下时竟被一枚一枚分别接住。
method_cn: 把三枚硬币放在右手背上：第一枚在指尖、第二枚在掌中、第三枚在手腕处。
抛起时手指向上倾斜，三枚硬币会错开落下，不会同时到达。
用手向上兜的动作，一枚一枚分别接住。
先只用两枚练习，熟练后再加第三枚。
note_cn: 没掌握诀窍的人连两枚都无法分开接住；关键是抛币时手指上倾。
text_en: This is a feat of jugglery, but there is a trick to it. Three coins are laid on the back of the right hand. They are tossed in the air, and the hand catches the falling coins, one by one. Spread out the coins, the first at the finger tips, the second at the middle of the hand, the third at the wrist. Tilt the fingers upwards, in tossing the coins, and they will come down separately, not all at once, and by quick work each coin may be caught individually, with a throwing motion of the hand. Practise with two coins at first. Persons who do not know the secret will be unable to catch two coins separately.

effect_cn: 硬币夹在两掌之间搓几下就消失了，两掌摊开也能给人看，再搓一次硬币又回来了。
method_cn: 在硬币底面抹一点软肥皂。
把硬币放在左掌上，右掌横着盖上去。
右手手指把硬币推到左手手背后面，压贴在手背上。
两掌摊开展示，硬币被手背挡住，看不见。
要让它回来时，再把双手合上，右手手指把硬币从藏处勾回掌心。
note_cn: 软肥皂要少抹，刚好粘住即可；推币时手掌朝里，别让观众看见。
text_en: A coin is laid between the palms of the hands, which are rubbed together. The coin disappears, but comes back when the hands are rubbed once more. Fix a dab of soft soap to the bottom of the coin. Lay it on the left palm. The right palm is laid crosswise upon the left, and the right fingers push the coin over in back of the left hand. The fingers hide the coin, and they press it firmly against the back of the hand so the palms of both hands may be shown. To bring the coin back, put the hands together, and this time the fingers of the right hand draw the coin back from its hiding place.

effect_cn: 八枚硬币正反相间排成一行，魔术师只动四次、每次挪两枚相邻的硬币，最后四个正面在一起、四个反面也在一起。
method_cn: 把八枚硬币按正、反、正、反排成一行。
第一次：从左数，把第 1 和第 3 枚移到队伍右端。
第二次：从右数，把第 5 和第 6 枚移到第一次移动留下的空位。
第三次：从右数，把第 2 和第 3 枚移到新的空位。
第四次：把左端两枚滑进最新的空档。
此时四个正面全在一起，四个反面也全在一起。
note_cn: 每次都要先数清是从左还是从右；顺序错一步就归不了类。
text_en: Lay eight coins in a row, alternately heads and tails. The trick is to move two coins that are side by side to a new position in the row. This maneuver may be done four times, after which the four heads must be together, and so must the four tails. Method: Counting from the left, move coins i and 3 to right end of the line. Then count from the right and move coins 5 and 6 to the vacancy created by the first move. Counting from the right, move coins 2 and 3 to the new vacancy. Then take the two coins from the left end of the line and slide them into the latest gap. The four heads will be together; likewise the four tails. Practise these moves and no one will be able to duplicate them.

effect_cn: 观众用铅笔在硬币上做记号，丢进装满同值硬币的帽子；魔术师背过身伸手一摸，就把它拿了出来。
method_cn: 请观众用铅笔在一枚硬币上做记号，并传给几个人看一看。
让大家把这枚硬币连同其他同值硬币一起丢进帽子里。
众人传看时，做记号的那枚被手的温度捂热，其他硬币还是凉的。
魔术师把帽子端到背后，伸手进去，凭温度一下就摸出那枚温热的硬币。
note_cn: 必须让多人传看，硬币才有足够温度；表演前别让帽子里的硬币被捂热。
text_en:
A coin is marked with a pencil and is dropped in a hat along with a number of other coins of the same value. When you reach in the hat, you immediately bring out the chosen coin, although the hat is held behind your back.
When the coin is being marked, you ask that a number of people examine it. As they do so, their hands make the coin warm. The other coins will be cold so it is a simple matter to pick out the chosen coin.

effect_cn: 硬币被两张牌盖住，魔术师用圆环把牌和环一起滑走；掀开这组，硬币不见了，再掀开另一组，硬币却在那里。
method_cn: 把一根头发系在一个圆环上，另一端用一点铅膏粘在硬币底面；硬币和这个环在桌上靠近放好。
把两张牌盖在硬币上，牌的中部要拱起。
把系头发的环放在牌上，头发就从牌下穿过、连到硬币上。
捏住上面那张牌往一边滑，借头发把硬币一起拖走，硬币藏在牌下看不见。
把另一个环盖在下面那张牌上，完成节目：硬币像是换到了另一组下面。
note_cn: 头发要短而结实，牌面拱起才不会压住头发；滑牌时动作要平。
text_en: coin is laid on the table and two cards are dropped upon Two it. metal rings of the merry-go-round type are also lying on the table. The magician puts one ring on top of the two cards and slides the card and ring across the table, leaving the coin beneath the other card. He sets the other ring upon that card. But when he lifts the card and ring that cover the coin, the coin is gone; and when the other card and ring are lifted, there is the coin! Method: A hair is attached to one ring and runs to the coin, being affixed to the under side by a dab of lead plaster. The coin and ring lie close together on the table. The two cards are laid over the coin. (The cards are humped up in the center). The attached ring is placed on top, and the hair thus runs under the cards to the end and over to the ring. Take hold of the upper card and slide it away, pushing it against the hair. The coin will slide along, unseen beneath the upper card. Cover the lower card with the loose ring and finish the trick.

effect_cn: 左手拿一枚硬币伸到桌下，右手盖住桌上剩下三枚；左手再上来时放下两枚，右手抬起，桌上却只剩两枚。
method_cn: 事先多准备一枚硬币，暗藏在左手，或用一点肥皂粘在桌子背面。
把四枚硬币放在桌上，左手拿起一枚，伸到桌子下面。
右手盖住桌上剩下的三枚硬币；借向前推的动作把其中一枚松开，让它落到手腕下面。
左手从桌下上来，放下两枚硬币，其中一枚是暗藏的。
抬起右手，桌上只剩两枚，第三枚被手腕挡住。
手腕贴着桌面慢慢往回拖，让那枚硬币落进腿上的手帕或餐巾里。
note_cn: 腿上要铺好手帕接币，免得硬币落地发出声音。
text_en:
Four coins are laid on the table. The left hand picks up one and goes beneath the table. The right hand covers the three remaining coins. Then the left hand comes up and drops two coins on the table. The right hand is lifted, and there are only Ivvo coins beneath it! Method: An extra coin is used, held concealed in the left hand or stuck under the table with a bit of soap. That accounts
for the appearance of the extra coin in the left hand. To make one of the right-hand coins vanish is simple, but clever. The right hand pushes the three coins forward on the table, but in so doing, releases one coin, so that it lies under the wrist. When the right hand is lifted, only two coins remain. The wrist is held flat on the table, hiding the third coin, and by drawing the wrist slowly backwards the coin is allowed to fall in the lap, which should contain a handkerchief or a napkin to catch the coin.

effect_cn: 硬币先正面朝上，拍到左手背上就翻成反面；再演一次，无论起手哪面朝上，拍上去都是同一面，观众看不出门道。
method_cn: 把硬币正面朝上放在右掌，拍在左手手背上；自然翻手时，硬币会跟着手一起翻面。
若想让硬币保持原来那面，就在翻手前给硬币一个极小的上抛。
手快速翻转时，手翻了而硬币没跟着翻，落在手背上仍是原面。
这个小抛要在开始翻手的一瞬间完成，快到看不出来。
note_cn: 抛得越小越好；诀窍多半试一两次就能找到手感。
text_en: A coin is laid heads up in the palm of the right hand, which slaps the coin on the back of the left hand. Of course the coin is turned over and now lies tails. But the next time you start with the coin heads up, it still lies heads when slapped on the left hand. In fact, you can start it with either side up and make it come up anyway you choose. The trick is undetectable. If you turn the hand over naturally, the coin will always turn over with the hand. But if you give the coin a tiny toss and then turn the hand quickly, the hand alone will turn. The slight toss given the coin is impossible to see, as you do it while starting to turn the hand. The trick is very easy to learn and the knack is often acquired the first time a person tries it.

effect_cn: 手帕搓成绳状、中央打结，交给观众拿着；魔术师让一枚硬币消失，解开手帕，硬币竟出现在结里。
method_cn: 右手手指暗藏一枚复制硬币。
把手帕搓成绳状，中间会自然形成一个下垂的「管」。
松手让硬币顺着这个管滑下去，藏到帕子中央，正好落在要打结的位置。
在帕子中央打结，交给观众拿好；硬币就藏在结里。
另取一枚硬币表演消失：可把硬币压进虎口处绷着的橡皮筋，橡皮筋收紧成小袋，抖手帕也不会露。
解开手帕的结，硬币出现在结中。
note_cn: 复制币要同款同色；手帕的「管」要够松，硬币才能顺利滑到中央。
text_en:
A handkerchief is twisted in a rope-wise fashion. The center is then tied in a knot, and the handkerchief is given to someone to hold. The magician makes a coin disappear; when the handkerchief is untied, the coin is discovered in the knot! Method The coin is a duplicate, which is held in the fingers of the right hand. When the handkerchief is twisted rope-wise, it forms a sort of tube, sagging in the middle. The magician releases
f slide: the coin and lets it slide down inside this tube so that it secretly comes to the center of the handkerchief, where when the knot it is is tied. This is a good method by which a coin may be "vanished" in connection with the trick just described. A coin pushed down into the center of a handkerchief; when the handkerchief shaken, the coin has disappeared. The magician holds one hand beneath the center of the handkerchief. Around the thumb and forefinger of that hand he has a stout rubber band. The coin is pushed down into the rubber band, which is released so that it grips the cloth and forms a pocket. The handkerchief may be shaken but no trace of the coin will remain. The magician holds out his left hand. He takes a coin in the right hand and slaps it against the left hand two or three times. Finally both hands are shown empty. In raising the right hand for the last slap, the coin is dropped
in the hair. Or, if the magician is wearing a hat, the coin can be left on the brim of the hat. If this little trick is practised a few times it will be found to be a capital mystery.

effect_cn: 硬币从纸筒顶端投入，落在倒扣的玻璃杯上叮当作响；可抬起纸筒，硬币却不见了。再掀起杯子和盘子，硬币竟出现在盘子底下。
method_cn: 事先把一枚同样的硬币藏在盘子底下。
把玻璃杯倒扣在盘子上。
纸筒内装一层纸隔板，中央开个小孔，让铅笔能穿过。
把纸筒罩在杯子上，大小正好，纸隔层贴住杯顶。
从筒顶投下一枚硬币，观众听到它与杯顶相碰的声音。
拿起纸筒，硬币已随筒消失；再掀起杯子和盘子，露出盘下的那枚硬币。
note_cn: 纸筒要做得朴素无奇，纸隔层须正好卡在杯口，投币时才能发出清脆的碰撞声。
text_en: A glass is inverted on a plate. The magician takes a paper or cardboard cylinder, drops a pencil through it, and puts the cylinder over the glass, which it just fits. Then a half dollar is dropped in the top of the cylinder. It falls on the glass. But when the cylinder is lifted the coin is gone. The glass and plate are raised, and there is the coin, beneath the plate! A duplicate coin is used, and is previously hidden under the plate. The trick lies in the cylinder, which has a partition of paper, with a small hole in the center which lets the pencil fall through. When the glass is covered with the cylinder, the paper partition fits against the top of the glass so that the coin, when dropped in, is heard to strike the glass. When the cylinder is removed, the coin goes away with The cylinder may be made very easily, and should be very plain in appearance.

effect_cn: 魔术师把硬币在两手间倒来倒去，最后伸出右手说“拿走硬币”，同时把硬币往桌上一敲。对方伸手去拿，硬币却不见了。
method_cn: 左手暗中留住硬币，放在桌上远离右手的位置。
右手做出拿币的动作，再把“硬币”在两手之间反复倒换。
最后伸出右手，装作把硬币按在桌面上。
右手假按的同时，搁在桌上的左手用硬币敲一下桌面。
观众听到声响，以为硬币在右手，伸手去拿却扑空。
note_cn: 敲桌的时机要与右手按币的动作严丝合缝，声音才像是从右手发出来的。
text_en: This little trick should be performed on a wooden table or window sill. The magician has a coin which he is changing from hand to hand. Finally he extends his right hand and says, "take the coin," at the same time clicking it down on the wooden table. When the person reaches to take the coin, it has disappeared! The coin is simply retained in the left hand, which rests on the table away from the extended right hand. When the right hand pretends to lay down the coin, the left hand clicks it against the table. The sound is illusive and the coin seems to be in the right hand.

props: 带钩金属夹（文具店可购）
effect_cn: 借来一枚硬币拿在右手中，右手做向上抛掷的动作，硬币随即消失，摊开手空空如也。
method_cn: 借一枚硬币，把带钩金属夹夹在硬币上。
侧身站立，让右侧避开观众视线。
右手做出向上抛掷的动作。
抛掷的瞬间右手垂到身侧，把连夹的硬币挂在外套上。
再抬手作抛掷状，摊开右手：空的。
note_cn: 挂钩要在垂手的一瞬间完成，动作必须像自然的抛接，不可停顿或张望。
text_en: A coin is borrowed and taken in the right hand, which makes a throwing motion. The coin immediately disappears. For this trick, you require a hooked metal clip; several types of these clips are made, and they are sold in stationery stores for hanging up cards etc. The clip has a clamp which will hold the coin, and the hook is on the side. Borrow a coin, clamp the clip on it, and stand with your right side away from the audience. When you make the tossing motion, drop your hand to your side for an instant, and you can hook the coin on your coat without the least bit of hesitation. Then make the tossing motion and show the hand empty.

effect_cn: 硬币丢进玻璃杯后，灯光转暗，硬币在杯中跳动“说话”：跳一下表示“是”，两下表示“否”。回答几个问题后，硬币突然跳出杯子，随后所有道具都可检查。
method_cn: 用一点粘膏把黑丝线的一端粘在硬币上。
硬币放入玻璃杯，丝线另一端从桌下引到你手中。
调暗灯光，每次拉线，硬币便在杯中跳动。
约定跳一下为“是”、两下为“否”，与观众问答。
结束时猛地一拉，硬币跳出杯子，同时脱开丝线。
note_cn: 丝线要细而黑，拉线幅度小而匀；最后猛拉必须干脆，让硬币带着惯性脱线飞出。
text_en: A coin is dropped in a glass; the lights are dimmed, and the coin begins to "talk" by jumping in the glass. One jump means "yes;" two mean "no." After the coin answers some questions, it suddenly leaps out of the glass. Everything may then be examined. Method: Attach a fine black silk thread to the coin by a dab of le^d plaster. You have the other end of the thread beneath the table, and every time you pull the thread the coin jumps. At the finish, give the thread a hard sudden pull; the coin will jump out of the glass and will fly clear of the thread.

props: 圆筒纸盒（直径与硬币相仿、稍深）
effect_cn: 硬币丢进圆筒盒，摇一摇能听见响声；打开盒子，硬币却不见了。
method_cn: 找一个直径与硬币相同、稍深的圆筒盒，内壁涂成黑色。
在硬币的一面贴上同色的纸。
先给观众看硬币普通的一面。
往盒中投币时暗中把硬币翻面，让贴纸那面朝上。
打开盒口：硬币看去只是盒底的一部分，像是消失了。
note_cn: 贴纸颜色要与盒内壁完全一致，投币时的翻面动作要藏在盒口的阴影里。
text_en:
A coin is dropped into a cylindrical box. The coin is shaken to show that it is there, but when the box is opened the coin has disappeared. The box is just the diameter of the coin, and it should be rather deep. It may be made of cardboard or metal. Adhesive tape boxes
will answer the purpose. The box is colored on the inside preferably black; and a piece of paper of the same color is pasted to one side of the coin. The other side of the coin is shown, but when the coin is dropped in the box, it is turned over, so the box will appear empty, the coin seeming to be part of the bottom,

effect_cn: 硬币从左袖口丢进袖子，魔术师却从手肘处把它拉了出来——袖子完好，没有任何破洞。
method_cn: 事先把一枚同样的硬币塞在袖口纽扣后面。
左手捏着另一枚硬币，从袖口上方向袖中丢下。
手绕到袖子后面，把藏着的硬币往下推到肘部。
从手肘处把硬币“拉”出来，展示袖子完好无损。
note_cn: 两枚硬币必须一模一样；取币时手要自然地从袖后绕出，别让观众瞥见袖里的硬币。
text_en: The magician drops a coin down his left sleeve, and pulls the coin through the sleeve at the elbow. There is no hole in the sleeve, so the coin has apparently passed through the cloth. Two coins are used. One is hidden behind the sleeve by being wedged between the button at the cuff. The hand drops the first coin, and then, reaching behind the sleeve, draws the duplicate down to the elbow.

effect_cn: 右手把硬币在左肘上反复揉搓，硬币渐渐消失；再揉几下，硬币竟又从肘部被拉了出来。
method_cn: 右手拿硬币在左肘上反复揉搓。
装作失手，让硬币“掉”下；拾取时左手把硬币接住。
右手空着继续揉肘，做出硬币还在的样子。
左臂竖直上举、手腕外翻，右手用手掌根部压住肘部，手指伸到左臂后方。
左手手指微松，硬币落到左臂后方，正好落进右手。
右手指慢慢从肘部把硬币“拉”出来。
note_cn: 硬币落进右手时右手不要有接的动作，仍要保持揉肘的姿态。
text_en:
There is an old trick of rubbing a coin into the left elbow, with the right hand. After considerable rubbing the coin disappears, This is done by dropping the coin "accidentally;" in picking it up, the left hand takes the coin, and the right hand pretends to hold it and rubs the imaginary coin into the elbow. Here is a new addition to the older trick. After the coin has been rubbed away, the right hand rubs the elbow once more. The left arm is held straight upwards, and is twisted so the back of the wrist is toward the audience. The right hand keeps rubbing the left elbow, until only the heel of the hand is touching it. The fingers and palm are extended off in back of the left arm. At that point, the fingers of the left hand open slightly and let the coin slip out. It drops in back of the left arm and falls into the right hand. Then the right fingers slowly draw the coin out from the elbow. Worked in combination, this forms an excellent finish to the
old trick; for the coin is first "vanished" at the elbow, and is then caused to reappear.

effect_cn: 展示一条空手帕，揉成一团交给观众拿着，手帕中央随即出现一枚硬币。
method_cn: 选一条边缘很宽的手帕，从边缝拆开几针，做出能藏硬币的暗袋。
展示手帕时，让暗袋那一面朝下。
把手帕卷成一团，硬币便从暗袋滑到手帕中央。
把团好的手帕交给观众，让他打开：中央出现硬币。
note_cn: 暗袋要缝得平整，硬币滑出时别被手帕的褶子卡住。
text_en: This is a very clever little coin trick. A handkerchief is shown absolutely empty. It is rolled into a ball and given to a person to hold. A dime immediately appears in the center of the handkerchief. Use a handkerchief with a very broad border. Take a few stitches out of the border and there will be a pocket to hold the coin. This side of the cloth is downward when the handkerchief is shown. When the handkerchief is rolled up, the coin slides out of the pocket and into the center of the handkerchief.

effect_cn: 硬币竖着稳稳地平衡在魔术师的额头上，看上去像是极难完成的绝活。
method_cn: 表演前取一点蜡或肥皂，粘在前额附近一根头发的发梢。
把硬币竖着放到额头正中时，让蜡粘住硬币。
头发像一根看不见的线牵住硬币，让它可以微微前倾而不倒。
note_cn: 头发要选靠近前额、不易被察觉的一根，蜡只需极少量。
text_en: coin is balanced on the magician's forehead apparently a very difficult feat. Before the trick is shown, take a dab of wax or soap and attach it to the end of a hair near the front of the head. In setting the coin on edge on the forehead, attach the wax to it. The hair will serve as an invisible line which makes it possible to balance the coin by tilting it slightly forward.

effect_cn: 硬币贴在魔术师的额头上，像被磁铁吸住一样，怎么也不掉下来。
method_cn: 把硬币贴在前额上。
用力把硬币向上推约一英寸。
松手，硬币便自己留在额头上。
note_cn: 上推时压力要足，推到位后不要再碰硬币，否则会滑落。
text_en: This is an amusing trick. The magician places a coin against his forehead, and it remains there, as though magnetized. Simply place the coin against the forehead and push it upward about an inch, using plenty of pressure. The coin will remain there of its own accord.

effect_cn: 硬币被扔到地上，立刻自己弹起来，回到魔术师手中。
method_cn: 用手指把硬币像车轮一样旋转着扔出。
让硬币的边缘平正地撞在地面上。
硬币便会直直弹起，落回手中。
note_cn: 必须用相当大的力，扔在石质地面上效果最好。
text_en:
A coin is thrown on the floor. It immediately bounces up to the magician's hand.
This is accomplished by throwing the coin so that it revolves like a wheel and strikes squarely on its edge. It will then bounce right up, especially if thrown on a stone floor. The coin must be thrown with considerable force.

effect_cn: 玻璃杯倒扣，由两枚半美元垫起，一角硬币塞在杯下。魔术师只说了一声，在杯旁的桌布上刮了刮，硬币便自己滑了出来。
method_cn: 把玻璃杯倒扣，用两枚半美元把杯口垫起。
把一角硬币从杯边推到杯下。
声明要让硬币自己出来。
用手指在杯旁的桌布上刮动。
刮桌布的动作带动硬币，使它从杯下滑出。
note_cn: 刮桌布时手指要贴着布面用力，靠布纹的移动把硬币带出来。
text_en: A glass is set upside down with two half dollars supporting it, and a dime is pushed beneath it. The magician states that he will cause the coin to come out from beneath the glass. He does this by scratching the table-cloth near the glass, the action causing the coin to slide out from beneath the tumbler.

effect_cn: 借来的硬币放在左脚底下，抬脚一看硬币不见了，竟出现在右脚底下。
method_cn: 坐着表演，事先把一枚同样的硬币藏在右脚鞋跟下。
抬起右脚稍微向后收，不让人看见鞋跟下的硬币。
左手接过观众的硬币，装作放到左脚底下。
途中悄悄让硬币落进裤脚的翻边里。
先抬左脚：空的；再抬右脚：硬币出现在鞋跟下。
note_cn: 转移硬币要在抬脚、收脚的遮掩下完成；两脚展示的顺序不能乱。
text_en: The magician borrows a coin, which he places beneath his left foot. When he raises his foot, the coin has disappeared, and it appears beneath the magician's right foot. This trick should be performed when seated. Two coins are used. One is secretly placed beneath the right heel. The magician may lift his right foot slightly and draw it backwards without revealing the coin. When he takes the first coin, he pretends to place it beneath his left foot, but drops it in his trousers cuff en route a very simple yet effective action. Then the coin passes from the left foot to the right, both feet being raised to show the accomplishment.

effect_cn: 两根针的针尖顶住硬币边缘，竟能把硬币提起来；再对着硬币吹气，它就在两针之间旋转。
method_cn: 把硬币平放在桌上。
两根针的针尖分别顶住硬币两侧的边缘。
两针同时夹紧用力，把硬币提起来。
对着硬币吹气，它便在针尖间旋转。
note_cn: 硬币一定要带滚花边缘，光滑的硬币夹不住，几乎无法完成。
text_en:
This is a very clever little trick that requires practice. A coin is laid on the table, and the magician, taking two pins, lifts the coin with them, the points pressing against the edge of the coin.
Then the magician blows upon the coin and it revolves between the pin points. Be sure to use a coin with a milled edge; otherwise the trick will be nearly impossible. With the proper coin, it can be readily learned.

effect_cn: 一摞硬币放在右肘上，右手向下一挥，硬币全部被接在手中，看上去非常难。
method_cn: 右前臂向后弯，右手碰到脖子，使肘部保持水平。
左手把一摞硬币放在右肘上。
右手向下直挥，同时把下落的硬币接住。
note_cn: 先用一枚硬币试，找到挥臂与接币的节奏后，整摞就很容易。
text_en: Bend the right forearm back until the hand touches the neck, the elbow being quite level. With the left hand, place a stack of coins upon the right elbow. Then swing the right hand straight down, and catch the coins as you do so. This looks very difficult— but it is quite easy. Try it with one coin, and the method will be obvious.

effect_cn: 前一个节目之后，用单枚硬币再演一次：右手明明接住了硬币，张开手却不见踪影。
method_cn: 把右袖口翻折起来，让右手活动自如。
把硬币放在比肘部稍低的位置，紧贴翻折的袖口。
前臂向下挥，速度不要太快。
硬币会滑进袖口的折缝里，而不是落进右手。
张开右手：空的。
note_cn: 挥臂不能太快，否则硬币会直接落进手里；袖口折边要够深，才接得住硬币。
text_en:
This trick should follow the one just described. Having shown how coins are caught from the elbow, the magician offers to demonstrate the effect with a single coin. He does so, apparently catching the coin in the right hand, but when the hand is opened, the coin has disappeared!
Method: Bend back at the right coat sleeve, to leave the hand free. Place the coin somewhat below the elbow, so it is close to the turned back sleeve. Swing the forearm downward but not too rapidly. The coin will slide into the fold of the sleeve instead of going into the right hand.

effect_cn: 要求把五枚硬币摆成每一枚都碰到其余四枚，观众几乎解不出来。
method_cn: 先平放一枚硬币在桌上。
并排放两枚硬币在它上面。
剩下两枚斜着架起来，像小帐篷或倒 V 字。
这两枚骑在另两枚上、顶端相碰，于是每枚都碰到其他所有硬币。
note_cn: 关键是最后两枚要斜搭成倒 V 并压住前两枚；摆好后逐一点数，确认每枚都与其他四枚相接。
text_en: Take five pennies, and propose the following condition: The coins must be placed in such a way that each coin touches all the remaining coins This is a real puzzler, and few persons will be able to solve it. Here is the way: Lay a coin on the table, and two coins side by side upon it. Take two more coins and arrange them so they form a sort of tent, or inverted V, upon the first coin. These two coins ride over the other two, and touch at the top, and it will be seen that every coin touches all the others.

effect_cn: 一角硬币装在杯里，上面压着一枚半美元。魔术师不碰半美元，只吹一口气，就把一角硬币从杯里取了出来。
method_cn: 把一角硬币丢进高脚杯。
再把一枚半美元盖在一角硬币上方。
要求在不碰到半美元的情况下取出一角硬币。
沿杯内壁边缘向下吹气，把半美元吹得立起来。
气流同时把一角硬币吹得越过半美元，从杯子另一侧飞出。
note_cn: 杯子必须是那种杯口收窄的高脚杯，两枚硬币相距约半英寸，吹气要贴紧杯壁。
text_en:
A tapering, goblet type of glass is needed in this trick. A dime is dropped in the glass, and a half dollar is placed above it. The object is to remove the dime without touching the half dollar. The trick is only possible with a glass of the type described; for
the dime must be a half-inch below the half dollar. Simply blow down the edge of the inside of the glass; that will cause the half dollar to tilt upright, and the force of the blow will make the dime fly up past the half dollar and out of the opposite side of the glass.

effect_cn: 桌上摆三枚硬币，中间一枚略偏一侧；请观众说出哪两枚相距最远，众人多半答错，答案是最外侧的两枚。
method_cn: 把两枚硬币摆在桌上，相隔一段距离。
第三枚放在两者之间，故意略微偏离正中。
请观众判断哪两枚硬币相距最远。
观众的注意力会被中间那枚引偏，纷纷答错。
揭晓：最外侧的两枚才是相距最远的。
note_cn: 中间那枚只稍微偏一点就够了，偏得太多反而会让人看出答案。
text_en: Two coins are laid on the table, some distance apart; and a third coin is laid almost midway between them. The magician then asks people to estimate which two coins are the farthest apart. People will look at the middle coin, and some will say the middle and the left end, while others will say the middle and the right end. The magician tells them that they are all wrong the two end coins are the farthest apart!

effect_cn: 魔术师右手握币，摇得叮当响，还让人抓住右腕防止钱从袖子溜走；张开右手，钱却不见了。
method_cn: 硬币其实一直握在左手里。
右手握拳摇晃时，左手松松地握住自己的右腕，硬币夹在左掌与右腕之间。
请观众抓住右腕，说“就像我刚才那样抓住，免得硬币从袖口跑掉”。
趁他抓住时，左手带着硬币自然撤离。
张开右手：空的。
note_cn: 左手握腕的姿势要自然，让硬币贴在腕内侧，摇动时才能响得像在右手里。
text_en: In doing this it is necessary for the magician to extend his right hand, shaking it so that everyone can hear coins jingle within the fist. He tells someone to hold his right wrist, so that the money cannot escape up his sleeve. But when the right hand is opened, the money has disappeared! The money is never in the right hand; instead it is in the left. When the magician shakes his right fist, he holds his right wrist loosely with his left hand, and the coins jingle between his left palm and his right wrist. It sounds exactly as though they were in the right hand. The excuse for the left hand being there is this: the magician says: "Hold my right wrist — just as I am holding it, so the coins can't get up my sleeve." That gives him the opportunity to remove the left hand, with the coins, the right being shown empty later.

effect_cn: 硬币放在桌上，用倒扣的平底杯一滑过去，硬币立刻不见了。
method_cn: 把一张与桌布同色的白纸粘在杯口。
硬币平放在桌上。
快速把倒扣的杯子滑向硬币。
硬币被杯口的纸遮住，看上去像凭空消失。
note_cn: 纸的颜色必须与桌布完全一致，滑杯动作要快，不能停顿。
text_en: The magician lays a coin on the table, and slides an inverted tumbler over it. The coin immediately disappears. This is an old trick, but an effective one, if properly shown. piece of white paper is pasted to the mouth of the tumbler. It matches the table-cloth, and is not seen. When the tumbler is slid quickly over the coin, the coin is obscured by the paper, and immediately disappears. In itself, this trick is hardly worth while; but used as a means of vanishing in the following trick, it is very good.

effect_cn: 硬币放在桌上，空杯放到桌下；用玻璃杯在桌面上一滑，硬币立刻消失，并听见它落进桌下的杯子，杯子拿出来里面真有一枚硬币。
method_cn: 用一点软肥皂或蜡把一枚硬币粘在桌子背面。
把玻璃杯放到桌下，杯口正好圈住那枚暗币。
桌面上的硬币用贴纸的平底杯滑过，令其“消失”。
桌面硬币消失的瞬间，把桌下的杯子一推，刮落暗币。
硬币叮当落进杯中，再把杯子取出来展示。
note_cn: 两次动作要同步：桌面硬币一消失，桌下就刮币，声音才接得上。
text_en: A coin is placed upon the table. The magician shows an empty glass and puts it beneath the table. Then he slides a glass over the coin on the table.* The coin immediately vanishes and is heard to drop into the glass beneath the table. The glass is immediately brought out, containing the coin. Method: A coin is attached beneath the table by a dab of soft soap or wax. The glass is placed beneath the table and is held so that it encircles the coin. The instant that the coin disappears from the table, the magician slides the glass so that it dislodges the coin under the table, and the coin audibly falls into the glass.

effect_cn: 魔术师走到点燃的蜡烛前，把手伸进火焰里，一下就取出一枚小硬币。
method_cn: 取一根普通蜡烛，在烛芯旁竖着划开一道缝。
把一枚一角硬币塞进缝里。
点燃蜡烛，让藏币那一面背对观众。
硬币藏在火光后面，观众看不见。
手迅速探入火焰，把硬币取出来。
note_cn: 藏币的一面必须背光，蜡烛要够粗，缝口在取币时才不会露馅。
text_en:
This is a quick and effective coin trick. The magician goes to a lighted candle, and reaching into the flame, quickly produces a small coin. *This with the aid of the glass just described. Any other method of vanishing may be used, however.
Take an ordinary candle and cut a slit vertically, alongside of the wick. Insert a dime or a penny in the slit. When the candle is lighted, and the coin side is away from view, the coin cannot be seen, as it is behind the light, and well imbedded in the candle. A quick motion into the candle flame enables the magician to instantly produce the coin.

effect_cn: 观众摊开手掌托着硬币，魔术师把手覆上去，说能在对方合指之前把硬币拿走；喊“开始”后对方一合手，硬币已在魔术师手中。
method_cn: 让观众把手掌摊平，放一枚硬币在上面。
魔术师手掌朝下覆在观众手上，拇指指向对方手指。
说好在他喊“开始”之后，对方才能合指护币。
喊“开始”时，手掌竖起，用小指一侧敲击对方手指根部。
硬币被弹起，魔术师顺势抽手把硬币带走。
note_cn: 敲击要落在手指根部、短促有力，抽手的动作与硬币弹起同时完成。
text_en: A person holds a coin on his outstretched palm. The magician lays his hand palm up upon the spectator's hand, with his thumb pointing toward the person's fingers. Then the magician states that he can remove his hand and take away the coin before the spectator has time to close his fingers over Of course the spectator doubts this but when the magician says "Go", and the spectator -closes his fingers, he finds that the coin is in the magician's possession. Method: The magician must be quick; but everything is in his favor; for the spectator cannot close his fingers while the magician's hand is there. At the word "Go", the magician turns his hand vertically, and with the side of his hand (by the little finger) strikes the spectator's hand at the base of the fingers. This makes the coin bounce, and as the magician draws his hand away he easily catches the coin and takes it along. The whole operation takes but the fraction of a second, and the spectator is dumbfounded.

effect_cn: 硬币夹在拇指与中指之间，手一抛硬币就消失了；空中一抓，它又回到手中。
method_cn: 把硬币放在中指上节的侧面，用拇指指尖按住。
其余手指弯曲，只伸出食指，让观众看清硬币。
消失时，把食指盖到拇指尖上向下压，再把拇指撤走。
随即伸直手指、亮出手掌：硬币藏在指缝间，伸到手背后面。
反向做同样的动作，硬币便重新出现。
note_cn: 整套动作要在手快速抛挥的同时完成，结束时手指伸直、硬币已不见。
text_en:
