This is an excellent method of vanishing a dime or a penny; it requires a slight bit of skill. The coin is held between the thumb and second finger. A toss
of the hand and the coin is gone! A clutch in the air and it is back again. Set the coin on the side of the second finger, on the upper knuckle, and hold it in position with the tip of the thumb. The fingers are bent in except the forefinger, which is extended so the coin may be seen. To vanish the coin, place the forefinger over the tip of the thumb; press down, and remove the thumb. Then straighten the fingers showing the palm of the hand. The coin is hidden between the fingers, and it extends in back of the hand. This must be done very quickly, while the hand makes a quick tossing sweep, ending with the fingers extended and the coin gone. A reversal of the movement brings back the coin.

effect_cn: 桌上放一小片纸，硬币悬在纸上方；用纸筒对着硬币一吹，纸片竟自己跳上去贴在硬币上，停留数秒才落下。
method_cn: 把一小片纸放在桌上。
左手把硬币水平捏在纸片上方。
右手拿纸筒凑到嘴边，筒口朝下对准硬币。
向筒里吹气，而不是吸气。
纸片被气流托起，跳上去贴住硬币。
note_cn: 关键是往筒里吹气而不是吸气，大多数人第一反应都会去吸。
text_en:
The magician lays a small piece of paper on the table. Above it he holds a coin, horizontally, with his left hand. With his right hand he holds a paper tube to his mouth, the tube pointing straight down on the coin. Suddenly the paper leaps up and attaches itself to the coin, remaining there for several seconds! People who try this trick will invariably draw through the paper
tube, trying to raise the paper but the interposed coin will prevent. The real method is to blow through the tube, and the paper will jump up to the coin.

effect_cn: 硬币和纸片同时松手落下，纸片竟和硬币一样快，一起落到桌面上。
method_cn: 把纸片盖在硬币上。
让硬币保持水平落下。
纸片随硬币一起下落，速度与硬币相同。
note_cn: 纸片一定要比硬币小，落下时硬币必须保持水平。
text_en: The magician shows a half dollar and a small piece of paper. He states that he will drop both the coin and the paper, and that the paper will fall as rapidly as the coin! Most people will think this is impossible; but it can be done quite easily. Lay the paper upon the coin and drop the coin flat. The paper will fall with the coin. The paper, however, should be smaller than the coin.

effect_cn: 硬币被纸片盖住，魔术师不掀纸，却把硬币上刻的年份读了出来。
method_cn: 硬币放在桌上，让观众用纸片盖住。
说明硬币须年份一面朝上。
请观众保证不让自己看到硬币。
用铅笔在纸上对着硬币的位置来回涂擦。
硬币的凸纹印到纸上，年份随之显现。
note_cn: 铅笔要侧着轻轻涂，纸不能太厚，拓印时硬币不能移动。
text_en: This is a tricky problem that is very entertaining. coin is laid on the table, and the magician allows someone to lay a piece of paper over it. The magician does not see the coin, but he specifies that it must be date side up, as he intends to read the date through the piece of paper. He states that he will not lift the paper from the coin, but that he will learn the date! Method Take a pencil, and rub the paper direcdy over the coin. This causes an impression of the coin to appear upon the paper, and the date comes into view.

effect_cn: 硬币被抛向空中，每次落回手中都是正面朝上，连抛十几次仍然如此。
method_cn: 事先用一点蜡或双面胶把一角硬币粘在半美元的背面。
把硬币抛向空中，小硬币不会被人看见。
接住硬币后，有暗币的一面偏重，多半会正面朝上落下。
若落成反面，开手时立即察觉，顺势翻过来。
连抛十几次正面后，暗中取下暗币留在手里，把硬币交给别人试。
note_cn: 暗币要粘在背面中央并贴牢，抛接时手指才感觉不出异样。
text_en:
half dollar is spun in the air. Every time it falls in the magician's hand, he opens his hand, and the coin is head up. The coin may be a borrowed one. Method: Have a dime with a dab of wax or double-sided adhesive tape upon it. Secretly attach this dime to the tail side of the
half dollar. Spin the coin in the air, and the dime will not be seen. The coin is caught in the hand, and it will generally fall head up; if it does not, the magician can instantly detect it, and turn it over as he opens his hand. After tossing ten or twelve heads, the magician can secretly detach the dime, leaving it in his hand, while he gives the coin to someone else to try.

effect_cn: 硬币隔着手帕显出轮廓，握在观众拳中；再盖上第二条手帕，取下时硬币竟在上面的手帕里，下面那条空了。
method_cn: 假装把硬币放进手帕中央，其实硬币留在手里，改放一个弯成圆圈的细铁丝进去。
隔布捏出硬币大小的圆轮廓，让观众以为硬币在里面。
把包好的手帕交人握住，再把第二条手帕盖上去：硬币已在第二条手帕下面。
隔着布捏住铁丝，把一端顶穿手帕，将整根铁丝抽走。
掀开上面的手帕，硬币随之露出，铁丝被手帕带走。
note_cn: 铁丝越细越好，穿出的孔只有针尖大小，才不会被看出来。
text_en: A coin is placed in the center of a handkerchief, and its shape is plainly visible. The handkerchief is held in a person's fist, with just the coin showing at the top. Another handkerchief is thrown over it, and when it is removed, there is the coin, while the lower handkerchief is empty. Method: In putting the coin under the handkerchief, the coin is retained in the hand, and a piece of wire, twisted in a circle, is placed there instead. This is the shape that shows through. When the second handkerchief is placed over the first, the coin is under it. Then the magician grips the thin wire through the cloth, and pushes one end of it right through the handkerchief, thus drawing the wire through. He lifts the upper handkerchief, revealing the coin, and takes away the wire with the handkerchief. As very thin wire is used, only a tiny hole is in the handkerchief, and that will never be noticed. A marked coin may be used in the trick.

effect_cn: 图钉被随手往天花板上一扔，竟稳稳钉进了天花板。
method_cn: 取一张很薄的棉纸。
把图钉尖朝上放在半美元硬币上。
用棉纸包住硬币，并把纸裹紧。
把纸包用力朝天花板抛上去，保持钉尖朝上。
图钉钉进天花板，硬币的重量随后坠破纸，连纸一起落下。
note_cn: 抛掷要直上直下，钉尖必须朝上，棉纸要薄到能被硬币坠破。
text_en:
This does not start out as a coin trick but a coin plays the most important part in it. A thumb-tack is to be driven in the ceiling, simply by tossing it in the air. Everyone wants to see that done, so the magician obliges.
He takes a piece of very thin tissue paper. He lays the tack point up upon a half dollar; then he places the paper over the point of the tack and wraps the paper around the coin. The package is tossed forcibly against the ceiling, holding the point of the tack upward. The tack is thus driven into the ceiling; then the weight of the coin tears the paper loose and down drops the coin with the paper, leaving the tack up there.

props: 几枚硬币（含一枚 25 美分）
effect_cn: 借来几枚硬币，其中一枚 25 美分落到盘子上，竟穿过瓷盘，当啷一声落进下面的玻璃杯里。
method_cn: 事先用一点肥皂或蜡把一枚同样的 25 美分粘在盘子底面，略偏离中心。
盘子架在玻璃杯上，让暗币贴着杯口内沿。
把借来的硬币从左手倒进右手，暗中把 25 美分留在左手。
左手握住暗币，只伸出拇指和食指扶住盘子，说“把盘子扶稳”。
右手把硬币撒到盘上时，左手顺势把盘子轻轻一扳，让盘底的暗币脱落。
暗币落进杯中，盘上没有 25 美分、右手又是空的，看上去就像硬币穿盘而过。
note_cn: 左手扳盘的方向要正好让暗币落进杯里，撒币与扳盘的动作要同时发生。
text_en: Here is a trick that involves the visible penetration of a coin through a china plate. The magician borrows several coins, a quarter being among them. He sets a plate on a glass, and taking the coins in his right hand, drops them on the plate. The quarter continues right through the plate and falls into the glass. Method A duplicate quarter is affixed to the bottom of the plate with a dab of soap or wax. The coin is slightly away from the center of the plate. The coins are taken in the left hand and dropped into the right, but the quarter is retained in the left hand. This is quite easy to do with so many coins being used. The left hand closes over the quarter, and just the thumb and forefinger are extended. They take hold of the plate "to steady it", the plate having been placed over the glass, so that the coin touches the inner edge of the tumbler. As the right hand drops the coins on the plate, the left hand draws the plate slightly in the proper direction, releasing the duplicate quarter, which falls visibly into the glass. As no quarter is on the plate and the right hand is shown empty, it appears as though the coin has penetrated the plate.

effect_cn: 魔术师离场，观众把一枚硬币扣在杯下；他回来只碰一下杯子，就说出了硬币的面额。
method_cn: 杯柄像钟表指针一样可以转到任意方向。
暗桩看清杯下的硬币。
按约定把杯柄转到对应钟点：1 点=1 分，2 点=5 分，3 点=1 角，4 点=25 美分。
继续：5 点=半美元，6 点=1 美元，7 点=2.5 美元金币，8 点=5 美元，9 点=10 美元，10 点=20 美元。
11 点=外国币或仿制品，12 点=杯下没有硬币。
魔术师回来碰一下杯子，看杯柄方向即可报出面额。
note_cn: 暗桩转杯柄的动作要自然，最好借整理桌面的机会完成。
text_en: coin is placed beneath a cup, while the magician is not present. The magician comes back, touches the cup, and immediately names the denomination of the coin. confederate helps in the trick. It will be noticed that the handle of the cup can be turned to point in any direction, like the hand on a clock. The confederate looks at the coin beneath the cup, and sets the handle properly, in accordance with the following system: i o'clock, a cent; 2, nickel; 3, dime; 4, quarter; 5, half; 6, dollar; 7, $2.50 gold piece; 8, $5; 9, f 10; 10, $20; 11, a foreign coin, or imitation; 12, no coin at all. In this way the magician can name the denomination of the coin, tell whether or not something other than a United States coin is beneath the cup, or whether the cup covers nothing.

effect_cn: 硬币放在手腕上，魔术师打个响指，硬币不用碰就自己翻了个身。
method_cn: 手掌朝上，把手腕放平。
把硬币平放在手腕内侧。
对着硬币打个响指，靠手指弹动带起的震动。
硬币被震得翻一个跟头。
note_cn: 用一角硬币最容易翻；响指的力道和角度要练熟，让硬币翻转而不是滑落。
text_en:
The magician holds his hand palm up and lays a coin on his wrist. He says that he can make the coin turn over without touching it. This he does by snapping his fingers. If a dime is used, it will
turn a neat somersault when the fingers are snapped. With a little practice the knack can be easily acquired.

effect_cn: 魔术师让人猜手里的钱是奇数还是偶数，无论对方猜什么，他都能证明对方猜错。
method_cn: 手里握一角、五分和五枚一分硬币。
请观众猜“奇数”还是“偶数”。
若对方说偶数，就张开手数硬币：共七枚，是奇数。
若对方说奇数，就数金额：1 角加 5 分加 5 分，共 20 分，是偶数。
note_cn: 问“奇数还是偶数”时不要把“币数还是钱数”说清，等对方开口后再选对他不利的算法。
text_en: The magician holds several coins in his hand and asks a person to guess whether the money is odd or even. The person is certain to make the wrong guess. No skill is required. The magician merely uses a dime, a nickel, and five pennies. If the person says "even", the magician opens his hand, and counts the coins, showing that he has seven an odd number. If the person says "odd", the magician counts the amount; ten cents for the dime, five for the nickel, and five for the pennies, a total of twenty cents, which is even.

effect_cn: 四枚硬币摆成方块，两张牌各盖一枚；剩下的硬币一次次神秘地“穿”到牌下，最后四枚硬币全跑到同一张牌底下。
method_cn: 四枚硬币摆成正方形，先用两张牌在不同的硬币上试盖，做足犹豫的样子。
趁试盖时，右手暗取牌下的一枚硬币。
左手揭起一张牌时，右手把那张牌移到原来左手牌的位置，让人看不出少了一枚。
右手把牌盖到另一枚硬币上，注意别让硬币碰响：于是一张牌下两枚，另一张牌下无币。
拾起没盖住的硬币，假装放到桌下或桌布下，实际把它换到左手。
右手空着伸出来，揭起牌露出两枚硬币；牌交给左手，硬币落在左手指上。
左手把牌盖回那两枚硬币上，顺手加上第三枚。
用同样的办法把最后一枚也“穿”到牌下；最后做个神秘的手势，两牌一起揭开，四枚硬币都在一处。
note_cn: 关键是不让硬币碰响，换牌、加币都要在同一动作里完成，必须反复排练。
text_en:
Four coins all alike are laid on the table, forming a square. Two playing cards are used, and a coin is covered with each card. Taking an uncovered coin, the magician puts it under the table, or the table-cloth, and when a card is lifted, two coins are there. The two coins are covered, and the other uncovered coin is passed under the card in the same mysterious manner. Then the three coins are covered. The other card is lifted, and the coin has passed from beneath it, all four coins being found beneath one card. This trick must be carefully rehearsed; but it is not difficult to perform. At the outset, the magician is undecided which coins to cover with the cards. He tries the cards over different coins, and this gives him the opportunity to take hold of a coin beneath the card in his right hand. He lifts the left hand card from a coin, and just as he draws the right hand card away, he drops the left hand card where the right
one was, so that nobody notices the absence of the coin. Then he lays the right hand card over another coin, taking care that the coins do not clink. He now has two coins under one card and no coin under the other. He picks up an uncovered coin, and in putting it under the table or the cloth transfers it to his left hand. He brings out his right hand, empty, and with it lifts the card, disclosing two coins. The card is transferred to the left hand which is below the level of the table, the coin resting on the left fingers. Then the left hand lays the card on the two coins, adding the third coin to the group. In the same way the other uncovered coin is "passed" beneath the card, and is added to the group when the card is replaced. That brings four coins beneath one card, while the other card covers none. So the magician makes a mysterious pass, lifts both cards, and shows all the coins together.

effect_cn: 让软木塞落下后立直不倒；别人怎么试，软木塞都会弹开倒下。
method_cn: 捏住软木塞，让它在落下时侧身着地。
松手让软木塞下落。
软木塞侧面着地后弹起，正好立直。
note_cn: 软木塞要侧着落下，不是竖着落；从一英尺以上高度落下，弹起后更容易立正。
text_en: This is a clever little trick that is quite perplexing. The object is to drop a large cork so that it will stand upright. Different people try it, but whenever the cork strikes on end, it bounces at an angle and falls over. The magician, however, can make the cork fall so that it stands on end, even when dropped a foot or more. The secret lies in the position in which the cork is held. It is dropped so that it falls on its side; then, when it bounces, it will stand upright.

effect_cn: 好几枚软木塞在水面上笔直地竖立浮着，怎么也不倒。
method_cn: 把几枚软木塞一起放进碗里。
让它们紧挨着，围成一圈，全部竖立。
软木塞侧壁被水浸湿后彼此粘住，便一起直立浮着。
note_cn: 软木塞要选干燥、表面略粗糙的，湿了才粘得住；排成圆圈越挤越稳。
text_en: The object of this trick is to make several corks float upright in a bowl of water. The corks naturally float on their sides, and it seems impossible to make them float vertically. Yet the magician can accomplish the feat very easily. He does this by placing several corks in the bowl together, all upright, in a circular group. The sides of the corks become wet, and they stick together and float upright.

effect_cn: 两手各用拇指和手指夹住一个软木塞，看上去两个塞子勾在一起，可两手一分就轻松拉开了。
method_cn: 两枚软木塞分别夹在两手拇指根部。
右手食指压住左手软木塞的上端，右手拇指顶住它的下端。
左手拇指伸进右手掌心，顶住右手软木塞的下端；左手食指弯过去压住它的上端。
摆成这个姿势时，两个软木塞看起来像勾死了。
两手一分，软木塞其实并未勾住，自然脱开。
note_cn: 一定要用大软木塞，姿势摆对后两手反而最容易拉开。
text_en:
This trick is always good. Two corks are used and they are set as shown in Fig. i, one cork at the base of each thumb. Then the
fingers and thumbs grip the ends of the corks, and when the hands are taken apart, the corks come away freely, although one would suppose that they would hook together. In fact, when people try the trick, they will invariably fail, as they make the corks interlock. See Fig. 2. The magician accomplishes the separation thus: He holds his hands back up and places his right forefinger on top of the left hand cork. His right thumb goes on the bottom of the cork. The left thumb extends into the right palm and presses against the bottom of the right hand cork, while the left forefinger bends around and presses the upper end of the right hand cork. In this position (which is shown in Fig. 3), the corks will apparently interlock and make it impossible to draw the hands apart. But actually the corks are separated, and the hands can be easily taken apart. Large corks should be used.

effect_cn: 小软木塞被一口气吹进了大瓶口的瓶子里。
method_cn: 把小软木塞放在瓶口前。
把瓶子横着拿平。
对着瓶口用力吹气，靠气流把小软木塞送进瓶内。
note_cn: 瓶子必须横持，气流方向才与小软木塞一致，否则永远吹不进去。
text_en: In this trick, a small cork is to be blown into a large necked bottle. This seems very easy, as the cork will slide through the neck of the bottle but the bottle must be held horizontally, so that the force of a blow will send the cork in.

effect_cn: 一枚骰子叠在另一枚上，提起上面那枚时，下面那枚像被磁化了一样跟着一起起来。
method_cn: 事先把食指指尖沾湿。
把水抹在上面那枚骰子的底面。
把两枚骰子叠压在一起，让水把骰面粘住。
提起上面的骰子：下面那枚被一起带起。
note_cn: 水只要一点点，骰面压实时不要太用力，免得水被挤出来。
text_en: A pair of dice are placed on the table, and one die is set upon the other. When the upper die is lifted, the lower one clings to it;s though magnetized. a ^Method: Previously moisten the tip of your forefinger, and to the under side of the upper die. When the dice are CO "ply it essed together, they will stick, and they may be lifted as one.

effect_cn: 观众背对魔术师掷两枚骰子、加总、翻一枚加底面、再掷一枚加顶面，魔术师回头看一眼就能说出他算出的总数。
method_cn: 请观众背对你掷两枚骰子，把两枚顶面的点数相加。
让他拿起一枚骰子翻个面，把底面的点数加进去。
让他再掷那一枚骰子，把新出现的顶面点数加进去。
你转过身，只看桌上两枚骰子的顶面点数，相加后再加 7，就是他的总数。
note_cn: 骰子相对两面的点数之和恒为 7，这是全部秘密；加 7 的时候别算错。
text_en: Tell a person to roll a pair of dice on the table, while your back turned. He must add the total made by the dice. Then he should pick up one die and, turning it over, should add the number on the bottom of the die. Having done this, he must roll the single die and add the number that appears on the top side. When you look at the dice as they lie on the table, you can immediately name the total that the spectator has reached! Method: Simply count the spots on the dice as they lie on the table, and add seven to the total. You will then have the grand Here the reason why: The opposite sides of a die always total. is total seven. The roller let one die remain on the table. But when he picked up the second die and added both the top and bottom into his total, he was merely adding on seven. When he rolled the die again, new number lay there for you to see, along with that its of the first die.

effect_cn: 两三个人把多米诺骨牌接龙排成一列，排完时两端的点数，正好和魔术师事先写在纸上的数字一样。
method_cn: 游戏开始前，暗中拿走一张不是对子（double）的骨牌。
把这张骨牌两端的点数写在纸上，折好放在大家都看得到的地方。
请人把剩下的骨牌接龙排成一列，排到接不上为止。
展开纸条：上面写的正是这一列两端的点数。
note_cn: 被拿走那张牌的两端数字就是最后两端的数字；拿牌时别让人发现牌少了一张。
text_en: Place a set of dominoes on the table, and invite two or three persons to line up the dominoes, as though playing a game; but as the dominoes are all face up, the game can be finished in a few minutes. Before they start, you write something on a piece of paper and lay it where all can see. When the game is finished, there will be two ends to the row of dominoes. Suppose the end number on one row is five; on the other row, three. When the piece of paper is unfolded, it will bear the numbers five and three. You have foretold what the end numbers will be! Method: Secretly remove one of the dominoes (not a double) before the game begins. The numbers on the domino (in this case 3 and 5) will tell you what the end numbers will be.

effect_cn: 两人用骨牌接龙，怎么也排不完，总会剩几张接不上；等魔术师把牌混一混，他们再玩就顺利排完了。
method_cn: 事先拿走两张骨牌，两张牌上共四个不同的点数，例如 3 与 5、6 与 1。
请两人用剩下的骨牌玩接龙，他们会发现排不下去，总有牌剩着。
等他们意识到排不完，把骨牌混一混，趁机把拿走的两张放回去。
宣布魔法解除，请他们重新玩，这次就能顺利排完。
note_cn: 若这一招接在上一招之后表演，只需再多拿一张牌；放回时要自然，别让人盯着你的手。
text_en: In this case, two people are invited to play a game of dominoes, but somehow or other they cannot finish it. Several dominoes will be left over. For this trick, you take away two dominoes, bearing four different numbers, say 3 5 and 6 1. If this trick follows the last, simply take away one domino besides the one you already have. The game cannot be completed. As soon as the players have realized this, mix up the dominoes and slip back the two you have taken. Then tell them that the magic spell has been lifted and that they can go ahead without interruption.

effect_cn: 观众背对魔术师，把若干张骨牌从右端逐张移到左端；魔术师回来翻一张牌，牌面点数就说出移了几张。
method_cn: 把 16 张骨牌从左到右排好，让牌面点数依次为 12、11、10、9……直到 0（双空白），最右边三张另放。
背对观众，请他把若干张骨牌从右端一张一张移到左端，最多移十二张。
转回来后，翻起从右数第四张骨牌。
这张牌牌面的点数，就是观众移动的张数。
note_cn: 排列时点数必须严格递减，翻第四张时按牌面点数直接报数即可。
text_en:
Lay sixteen dominoes in a row on the table. While your back is turned, any person may move as many dominoes as he chooses
from the right to the left of the line. The dominoes must be moved one by one, and not more than a dozen may be moved. When you come back, you immediately turn a domino with the spots up, and the spots on the domino tell how many have been moved! Method: Arrange the dominoes from left to right so that the spots total 12, ii, 10, 9, etc., down to o (the double blank). The three dominoes on the right of the row are odd ones. Now, if no dominoes are moved, and you turn up the fourth domino from the right, it will register zero double blank. If one domino is moved, the fourth from the right will be i if two are moved it will be 2, etc. Simply turn up the fourth domino from the right of the row.

effect_cn: 魔术师把三枚骰子装在平底杯里摇动，请观众从杯侧数出杯底的点数；他看不见杯底，却能立刻报出底面点数之和。
method_cn: 把三枚骰子放进平底杯，双手夹住杯身，掌心盖住杯口。
走到坐着的观众面前摇杯，请他从杯侧看杯底，数出三枚骰子底面的点数。
趁他低头看时，记住三枚骰子的顶面点数。
顶面三个点数相加，再用 21 去减，差就是底面三个点数之和。
note_cn: 骰子顶面与底面之和恒为 7，三枚合计 21；记住顶面再减，动作要快。
text_en: Place three dice in a tumbler and put your hand over the open end, holding the glass between your palms. Approach a person who is seated, and shake the glass so the dice jump about; then ask him to look up through the side of the glass and count the spots on the bottom of the dice. He has hardly done so before you tell him the total; although you cannot see the bottom sides of the dice. Method Add the top sides of the dice, which you can see, and subtract your total from 21. That will give you the total of the bottoms.

effect_cn: 骰子装进杯中倒出来，几次之后骰子却像被吸住一样留在杯里；再翻一次，骰子又掉出来。
method_cn: 事先把一根木火柴横卡在杯子内壁靠近底部的一侧。
骰子放入杯中，手掌盖住杯口；翻杯时朝卡火柴那一侧倾斜，骰子便滑到火柴上方卡住不掉。
把杯子朝另一侧倾斜，骰子越过火柴掉落出来。
前几次故意让它“失败”，效果更可信；演完后用掌侧压杯壁松开火柴，让它悄悄落地。
note_cn: 火柴卡在近杯底的一侧，倾斜方向决定骰子卡住还是掉落；动作要自然，别让火柴露出来。
text_en:
This trick requires a pair of dice and a "shaker" or dice-cup, either the large leather type used with standard size dice, or one of the small cardboard dice-cups that come with parlor games utilizing small dice. If no dice-cup is available, a paper drinking cup can be used.
A pair of dice are dropped into the cup and the magician puts his hand over the mouth of the cup, turning it to create a vacuum. He then inverts the cup and the dice fall out. He tries again and after about the third try, to everyone's wonderment, the dice do not fall, but for some unexplainable reason remain up in the cup. Pressing his hand to the cup's mouth, the magician turns his hand the other way; this time, when the cup is inverted, the dice drop. The "vacuum" has nothing to do with it. Beforehand, the magician wedges a wooden match-stick or a portion of one if a small cup is used across the interior of the cup, near the bottom and toward one side. By simply tilting the cup that direction when inverting the cup, the dice will slide above the wedge and stay there, only to drop later when the cup is tilted the other way. A few "failures" make the trick more convincing and afterward, pressure on the side of the cup will release the match so it can be dropped unnoticed on the floor.
Inasmuch as Christopher Columbus has been given credit for performing the first known trick with an egg, this chapter will begin with an explanation of how that famous feat might have been accomplished. According to the story, Columbus balanced an egg on end. The trick is a very interesting dinner table experiment, so here are three methods of performing it

effect_cn: 一枚鸡蛋在桌上笔直地立稳，怎么也不倒。
method_cn: 方法一：先用力摇晃鸡蛋，让蛋黄沉到下部，再小心地把它竖在桌上。
方法二：在桌布上撒一小撮盐，把鸡蛋立在小盐堆上。
方法三：桌布下藏一枚系着线的小戒指，把鸡蛋立在小戒指上。
移走鸡蛋时，另一只手拉动线，把小戒指抽走。
note_cn: 三种方法都要轻手轻脚；用盐堆最省事，演完记得把盐擦干净。
text_en: Method i. Shake the egg so that the yolk will settle. Then set the egg carefully upon the table, and as the bottom of the egg is heavier than the top, it will be possible to balance the egg on end. Method 2: Before performing the trick, spill a little salt on the tablecloth and gather it up into a tiny mound. Press the egg carefully on the pile of salt, and it will balance there. Method 3 Have a tiny ring under the table cloth with a thread attached. Balance the egg by setting it on the ring. When you lift the egg away, pull the thread with your other hand so that the ring will be withdrawn.

effect_cn: 观众怎么转鸡蛋都转不稳，魔术师拿起一枚轻轻一旋，鸡蛋就像陀螺一样转个不停。
method_cn: 先把几枚生鸡蛋摆到桌上，请大家轮流试着转。
趁众人忙着转蛋，把事先藏好的熟鸡蛋换到手里。
拿起熟鸡蛋轻轻一旋，它就能平稳地转起来。
note_cn: 熟鸡蛋内部是固体，才能稳定旋转；换蛋的动作要自然，别让人看到你换了一枚。
text_en:
Two or three eggs are laid on the table, and people are asked to spin them. They find that the task is next to impossible. The eggs
start to spin, but topple and fall on their sides. But when the magician twirls an egg, it spins like a top. One of the eggs is hard-boiled. It is kept out of sight until different people are busy spinning eggs; then the magician picks up one of the eggs and takes an opportunity to replace the hardboiled egg in its stead. The hard-boiled egg may be twirled with ease.

effect_cn: 鸡蛋放进水壶，不沉底也不浮到水面，而是悬在水中间。
method_cn: 壶里先装半壶水，加盐搅到盐完全化开。
沿壶壁缓缓加入清水，让上层是淡水、下层是盐水。
把鸡蛋放进去，它就停在水中间浮着。
note_cn: 加清水一定要沿壁慢慢倒，别把盐水层冲混；盐要加到足够浓。
text_en: An egg is dropped into a pitcher of water and it mysteriously floats halfway down, neither coming to the surface nor sinking to the bottom! This is due to the water in the pitcher. The pitcher is half filled with water, which is then salted. More water is poured in, down the sides of the pitcher, so that the bottom half of the pitcher contains salt water and the top half fresh. The egg will then float halfway up.

effect_cn: 三只水杯排成一排，木板上立着线轴与鸡蛋；魔术师猛然抽走中间的倒扣杯，木板和线轴飞落，三枚鸡蛋却刚好落进三杯水里。
method_cn: 三只水杯排成一排，上面横搁一块薄木板。
两边杯口各放一个线轴，线轴上各立一枚鸡蛋。
中间杯口倒扣一只杯子，杯底再放一个线轴和一枚鸡蛋。
薄木板靠近倒扣杯的一端，暗藏两个很小的钉尖，卡住那只杯子的杯沿。
突然抓住倒扣杯往上抽：木板和线轴被带飞，鸡蛋却直落进杯中。
note_cn: 两个钉尖要小到看不出来，却能吃住倒扣杯的边；抽杯时要直、要快。
text_en:
This is a very elaborate trick, which can, however, be easily prepared. Three goblets of water are stood in a row and a thin piece of wood is set upon them. Over each of the two end goblets, a spool is set, and an egg is balanced on each spool. Over the center goblet, another goblet is inverted; a spool is placed on it, and an egg is balanced on the spool. The magician suddenly grasps the inverted goblet and pulls it away. The board and the spools fly to the floor; but the three eggs drop squarely into the goblets of water! On the thin piece of board, there are two tiny projecting nail points, which engage the edge of the inverted goblet in back. These are so tiny that they are not noticeable, but they are very
important in the trick. For when the inverted goblet pulled away, it carries the board also, and the light spools will fly away. The eggs, however, will fall directly down, of their own accord, into the goblets.

effect_cn: 魔术师手里拿着一个鸡蛋，用力一捏，蛋壳碎裂，落下来的却是满把彩色纸屑。
method_cn: 在鸡蛋两端各扎一个小孔，把蛋液吹进杯子里。
把小孔弄大一点，把彩色纸屑灌进空蛋壳。
表演时用拇指和食指指尖捏住鸡蛋，正好盖住两个小孔。
用力一捏，蛋壳碎裂，纸屑随壳一起落下，落进盒里。
note_cn: 两个小孔要藏在指尖之下；纸屑别塞太满，捏碎时才会撒得漂亮。
text_en:
The magician shows an ordinary egg, and squeezes in his hand, while he fans it with the other hand. A shower of confetti pours forth, instead of the egg. The egg is a real one, but it is prepared for the trick. Punch a tiny hole in each end of the egg, and you can blow the contents of the egg out into a cup. Enlarge one of the holes so that confetti may be poured into the egg. In performing the trick, hold the egg between the tips of the thumb and forefinger, which cover the holes. When the egg squeezed, the shell is broken, and falls with the confetti, which should be dropped into a box. Note: See also the "Ring in the Egg," page 186.
There are several tricks in which the hands play a principal part without serving merely as agencies in the manipulation of other objects. Such tricks are sufficiently numerous to require this separate chapter.

effect_cn: 魔术师打开小纸盒，里面棉花包着一根“木乃伊手指”；有人凑近细看时，手指突然动了起来。
method_cn: 在纸盒底部开一个手指宽的孔。
把左手的中指从孔里伸进盒中，用棉花把手指包住遮好。
盒盖看似搁在左手掌上，其实手指藏在盒内。
等观众凑近，手指突然抽动；抹些滑石粉或粉笔灰，效果更吓人。
note_cn: 盒子要挡住指根，棉花要塞满；动作别太频繁，一次抽动就够。
text_en:
The magician exhibits a small cardboard box. He removes the lid, and shows a finger inside, the finger being packed in cotton. He states that it is a mummified finger; and when someone starts to inspect it closely, the finger suddenly moves. The finger is the second finger of the magician's left hand.
There is a hole in the bottom of the box, through which the finger is thrust. The box appears to be set on the palm of the left hand. If the finger is covered with talcum powder or chalk, the surprise will be great.

effect_cn: 魔术师捏住右手食指一拉，食指突然变长到原来的两倍，随后又恢复原状。
method_cn: 先把右手食指横搭在左手第一、第三根手指的指节上，左手第二指压在它上面。
转动右手食指尖，让它搭到左手食指的指节上，两根食指朝同一方向。
同时把左手第二指弯过去，横压在右手食指的指甲上。
这样左手食指看起来就像右手食指的延长段；表演时双手不停微动。
最后把手指悄悄收回原位。
note_cn: 关键是两根食指对齐、左手第二指遮住接缝；双手不停移动，接缝才看不出来。
text_en: The magician pulls on the forefinger of his right hand, and it suddenly stretches to twice its original length. Then it is restored to its normal size. r^~ *Wr../first jq,^ The finger is first placed across the knuckles of the first and third fingers of the left hand, with the left second finger over it, resting on the knuckle of the right forefinger. Then the tip of the right forefinger is turned so that it rests on the knuckle of the left forefinger, both forefingers pointing in the same direction. At the same instant, the left second finger is bent across the nail of the right forefinger. Thus the left forefinger appears to be an extension of the right forefinger. The hands should be kept in motion during this procedure, and finally the fingers are brought back to their original position. This is a very surprising illusion.

effect_cn: 魔术师把右手拇指从手上“取下来”，停一下又装回去，右手看起来完好无损。
method_cn: 两手按图示摆好：右手拇指弯进掌心。
左手拇指伸过去，充当右手拇指的“延长段”。
用左手食指和中指挡在“关节”前面，右手拇指看起来就像正常伸直着。
右手其余部分上下微动，然后把“拇指”取下、再装回去。
装回时左手手指自然落下遮一下，趁机把右手拇指伸出来，左手移开，整根拇指便“复归”。
note_cn: 左手两指要正好挡住关节接缝，动作连贯；取下那一刻手要保持原来的朝向。
text_en: There are variations of the following trick, but the method about to be described is by far the most effective. It consists of the apparent removal of the right thumb from the hand. The hands are held as shown in Fig. i. Then the thumb is "taken off" as shown in Fig. 2, and immediately replaced again. The secret is shown in Fig. 3. The right thumb is bent in, and the left thumb is arranged to form an extension of it. The drawing shows how the hands appear from above. As soon as the left forefinger and second finger are placed in front of the "joint", the illusion is complete. The right thumb appears to be naturally extended. (See Fig. 1.) The rest of the right hand may be moved up and down to assist in the illusion. Then the thumb is "removed", and "replaced". The left fingers immediately come down in front of the thumbs, and during the temporary concealment, the right thumb is extended, and the left hand moves away, showing the entire right thumb. The right thumb may be extended at the beginning of the trick, the left fingers momentarily "covering up" while the thumbs assume the proper positions.

effect_cn: 魔术师抓住自己的左手无名指，像拧螺丝一样把它掰弯、取下来移开，随后手指又完好无损地接了回去。
method_cn: 左手无名指向掌心弯曲，用左拇指从前面按住，保持这个姿势。
右手无名指贴到左手上，右手的前两指在它前面弯起，形成遮挡。
右手缓慢向侧面移动，看起来就像抓着左手无名指把它掰弯、往旁边拉。
右手移开的瞬间，左手无名指迅速伸直，这个动作藏在右手后面。
随后右手快速翻过来，左手手指顺势恢复原状，看上去手指被完整接了回去。
note_cn: 左右手可以互换，选自己顺手的一侧练熟即可。
text_en: A similar trick may be performed with the third finger of the left hand. The finger is held as shown in Fig. i bent in and held by the left thumb. The third finger of the right hand takes the position shown, and when the first two fingers of the right hand are bent in front, the appearance is shown in Fig. 2. The right hand moves sideways, and it appears as though it is bending the left third finger. Then the hand is moved away, carrying the finger, which is immediately replaced. The right hand is quickly turned over, and at the same instant, the left finger is extended, under cover of the right hand. In both of these tricks, as well as in others requiring movements of the hands, the reader may work the tricks with the other hands, if he finds it more convenient. The usual procedure is to "remove" the right thumb, or the left third finger; but some may find it easier to use the left thumb or the right third finger.

effect_cn: 魔术师把左手拇指慢慢往旁边拉，拇指竟被拉长到原来的两倍，随后一松手又恢复原样。
method_cn: 右手拇指弯进掌心，右手手背朝向观众。
左手拇指伸直，左手手背同样朝向观众。
右手四指包住左手拇指，把它夹在右手手指与右手拇指之间。
让右手拇指的指尖从右手小指旁边露出来，看起来就像左手拇指的指尖。
右手慢慢向右移动，造成左手拇指被拉长一倍的错觉。
右手再移回左边，松开时左手拇指完好如初。
note_cn: 右手拇指指尖要刚好露在小指旁边，位置差一点就会穿帮。
text_en:
This is a variation of the "Removable Thumb" trick. In this case the magician apparently stretches his thumb to twice its natural length.
The right thumb is bent into the palm and the back of *e hand is turned toward the audience. The left thumb is extended, and the back of the hand is also toward the audience. The right fingers cover the left thumb, which is pushed between them and the right thumb, but the tip of the right thumb is allowed to protrude alongside the right little finger. It appears to be the tip of the left thumb. The right hand is moved slowly to the right, and the illusion is created of stretching the left thumb to twice its length. Then the right hand goes back to the left, and the left thumb is shown as good as ever.

effect_cn: 魔术师声称自己有十一根手指，先数出十根，再倒着数一遍，最后举起左手说再加上这五根正好是十一根。
method_cn: 魔术师声称自己把两个拇指也算上，一共有十一根手指。
用右手食指依次点左手五指，数一、二、三、四、五。
再用左手食指点右手五指，数六、七、八、九、十。
故作疑惑地说自己以为有十一根，提出再数一次。
从右手开始倒着数：十、九、八、七、六。
停住，举起左手说再加上这五根，就是十一根。
note_cn: 数得要快而连贯，观众来不及算清就已经被绕进去了。
text_en:
This is more of a joke than a trick; yet it really mystifies many people. The magician states that he has eleven fingers, counting his thumbs. Using his right forefinger as a pointer he touches each finger of the left hand, counting "One, two, three, four, five'*. Then his left forefinger counts the right fingers: "Six, seven, eight, nine, ten".
"Strange", remarks the magician. "I thought I had eleven. Let's try again". He starts counting backwards, pointing to the fingers of the right hand. "Ten, nine, eight, seven, six". Then he stops, holds up his left hand, and says: "And five are eleven!" Executed rapidly, this clever method of counting is very deceptive.

effect_cn: 魔术师双掌合拢、手指伸直，忽然两手像折断一样向后弯到接近手腕，仿佛关节能反折。
method_cn: 双掌合拢，手指伸直，来回前后弯折几次，假装在活动关节。
突然把双手由右向左一转，右手手背转过来遮住左手。
与此同时左手手指微微弯起，让右手手指能压着它继续弯下。
两个拇指始终并拢，看起来就像是左手手指向后折断了。
迅速反向一转，换成右手手指弯起、左手指压上去，重复同样的错觉。
note_cn: 关键是两手转动时拇指始终并拢，速度要快，别让观众看清手指的替换。
text_en: This is something of an optical illusion. The palms are placed together, and are bent back and forth, the fingers being extended. Suddenly each hand seems to bend back almost to the wrist, as though the magician possessed remarkable double joints. This is accomplished by turning the hands from right to left. As the back of the right hand comes into view, hiding the left hand, the left fingers are doubled slightly, allowing the right fingers to bend over them. As both thumbs are together, the effect is that the left fingers have bent back. quick turn the other way, and the right fingers double up, letting the left fingers bend over them. This is done after several pretended attempts to bend the fingers back, and it is quite surprising.

effect_cn: 魔术师十指交叉扣在一起，双手并不分开，却能拍出响亮清脆的掌声。
method_cn: 十指交叉扣紧，向观众证明两手没有分开。
把两手掌根微微分开，再快速合拢。
同时让双手上下移动，用这个动作掩盖掌根相碰的小动作。
反复练习，直到双手只分开不到一英寸也能拍出响亮的声音。
note_cn: 上下晃动的幅度要盖过掌根的开合，声音才像真的拍手。
text_en: Here is a method of clapping the hands without taking them apart. To convince everyone that the hands are not separated, the fingers are locked together. Yet when the hands are moved up and down rapidly, they clap very audibly. To do this, separate the heels of the hands and bring them together very rapidly, while the hands move up and down to hide the slight motion of them. With a little practice, loud applause may be produced although the hands move less than an inch or so apart.

effect_cn: 魔术师用指关节猛敲桌沿，声音响亮，手和桌子却都毫发无伤。
method_cn: 先用指关节在桌沿轻敲几下，让观众以为接下来要用力砸。
再次抬手作势猛砸，手在挥动过程中把手指伸开。
让指尖而不是指关节先碰到木头。
在挥动结束前迅速把手指收回弯起。
响声让人以为是指关节重重砸在了桌沿上。
note_cn: 砸下去时手要真的快，靠速度和声音骗过眼睛。
text_en: A blow on the knuckles is usually quite painful. Yet the magician can strike his knuckles forcibly against the edge of a table without either hurting his hands or the furniture. Needless to say, there is a trick to it. The knuckles do not touch the table at all. The magician taps them against the edge of the table a few times; then he makes a hard swing, and as his hand is in motion, he extends his fingers, so that the tips and not the knuckles, strike the wood. The hand is immediately doubled up before the swing is completed. To all appearances, the knuckles have been struck forcibly against the table edge, as everyone can hear the blow.

effect_cn: 把一个小球或一支铅笔同时碰到两根交叉手指的指尖，闭眼去摸，会觉得手里有两件东西。
method_cn: 把中指交叉到食指上，形成交叉手指的姿势。
让小球或铅笔同时接触两根手指的指尖。
请观众闭上眼睛或转头不看手，只用触觉去感受。
由于手指位置反常，大脑会记录成两次不同的触感，仿佛有两个物体。
note_cn: 一定要让观众别看手、只凭触觉判断，错觉才成立。
text_en:
By a very simple expedient, it is possible to make a single object, such as a small ball, or a pencil, appear as two. This is done by crossing two fingers. Then place the ball or the pencil so that it touches the tips of both fingers. Due to the unnatural position of the fingers, two distinct touch impressions are recorded. If the eyes are shut, or are turned away from the hand, it is difficult to believe that the fingers are touching a single object only.
There are three types of handkerchiefs used in the performance of tricks: First, ordinary linen handkerchiefs, which serve the purpose in most impromptu tricks; second, large thick silk pocket handkerchiefs, which are used in tying knots, as they slide more easily than linen; and third, thin, small silk handkerchiefs which are used in connection with various pieces of magical apparatus. The impromptu magician would do well to carry a large silk handkerchief in his pocket, as it is useful in many tricks. The sole advantage in the linen handkerchief lies in the fact that it is not so transparent as silk; and sometimes something takes place underneath a handkerchief which the spectators are not supposed to see.

effect_cn: 一块手帕折成斜角、卷成长筒，竟能直立在食指指尖上，左右摇晃却不倒。
method_cn: 手帕沿对角线折好，再卷成长筒。
把一段鲸须或可弯曲的铁丝事先藏在折叠的手帕里。
将手帕绕着铁丝卷紧，让铁丝成为中间的骨架。
把卷好的手帕立在食指指尖上，手帕会摇晃但不会倒。
演完立刻把手帕收进口袋，之后再拿出来时已经取掉铁丝。
note_cn: 手帕要卷得紧、铁丝要留在中心，才立得稳。
text_en: A handkerchief is folded diagonally and is rolled into a long cylinder. It is then balanced upright on the tip of the forefinger. The handkerchief sways but does not fall. This is accomplished by having a piece of whalebone or pliable wire hidden in the folded handkerchief. The handkerchief is rolled around the wire, and it may then be easily balanced on the tip of the finger. The handkerchief should be pocketed immediately after the trick, and brought out later on, minus the wire or whalebone.

effect_cn: 手帕中央明明只打了一个大结，轻轻一抖，却变成相距数英寸的两个结。
method_cn: 左手捏住手帕一角，右手掌心向上托在手帕中央下方。
右手向左侧翻转，让手背朝上，同时抓住手帕形成一个绳圈。
把左手无名指从下方伸进绳圈，再抽出右手；右手往手帕下方移动，再做一个同样的绳圈。
把第二个绳圈叠在第一个上面，用右手把两个圈捏住。
左手把左手一侧的手帕端从两个圈中向上推过去，形成上下两个结。
把上面的结撑开，让它包住下面的结，然后抓住左端让手帕垂下，看起来只有一个大结。
抓住手帕猛地一抖，一个结就变成相距几英寸的两个结。
note_cn: 两个圈叠放的方向要对，推的时候别让结提前散开。
text_en: Hold a corner of a silk handkerchief in the left hand. Place the right hand, palm up, under the center of the handkerchief. Then roll the right hand over toward the left so that the back of the right hand is up. In so doing the right hand clutches the handkerchief so that a loop is formed. Insert the third finger of the left hand in that loop, from beneath, and withdraw the right hand. Move the right hand further down the handkerchief and form another similar loop. Place it on top of the first loop and hold the two loops pressed together by the right hand. Then the left hand pushes the left end of the handkerchief up through the two loops, forming two knots, one upon the other. Spread the upper knot so that it surrounds the lower. Then take hold of the left end of the handkerchief and let the handkerchief dangle. To all appearances there is a large single knot in the center of the cloth. Give the silk handkerchief a sudden snap, and instead of the one knot, there will be two knots, a few inches apart.

effect_cn: 手帕一角在右手，另一角垂着；右手几次提起又抖落垂角之后，垂角上忽然出现一个结。
method_cn: 右手捏住手帕的一角，让另一角自然垂下。
事先在右手捏住的那一角上打好一个结，用手指把结藏住。
把垂下的角提起交给右手、再抖落，如此重复两三次，吸引注意。
右手趁机把两个角对调，留住下面那个角，让打好结的那个角垂下去。
结随着垂角落下，看上去就像刚刚在垂角上突然出现了一个结。
note_cn: 换角的动作要藏在提、抖的节奏里，别让观众盯着手指。
text_en:
A handkerchief (linen or silk) is held in the right hand by one corner. Attention is called to the loose hanging corner. The loose corner is raised to the right hand, which drops it with a shake, still retaining the upper corner. This is repeated several times, and suddenly a knot appears in the hanging corner. Method: The corner originally held in the right hand is previously knotted but the knot is hidden by the fingers. After raising and shaking out the hanging corner two or three times, the right hand exchanges the corners, retaining the lower one, and letting the knotted one drop. This is a perfect little illusion and it seems as though a knot suddenly appears in the loose corner.

effect_cn: 魔术师把手帕从蜡烛火焰中慢慢拉过，手帕却一点都没有烧着。
method_cn: 把手帕浸入硼砂和水的溶液里，取出后晾干。
将手帕卷成圆筒。
捏住手帕上端两角，把下缘从烛焰中慢慢拉过。
中途不要停顿，匀速移动即可安然通过火焰。
note_cn: 溶液浸泡后必须完全晾干，否则手帕仍会被烧焦。
text_en: Drawing a handkerchief through a candle flame is a very mysterious trick. It may be done by simply rolling the handkerchief into a cylinder and drawing it through the flame slowly, but without stopping at any point. If, however, the handkerchief has been previously soaked in a solution of borax and water, it will be rendered nearly fireproof, and the trick can be performed with more deliberation. The handkerchief should be allowed to dry before it is used. The handkerchief can be held by the upper corners while the lower edge is drawn through the flame.

effect_cn: 手帕看上去被打成了一个结，可两手一拉两端，结竟凭空消失。
method_cn: 双手各捏住手帕对角的两端。
右手把自己这一端拉离身体，并从左手手腕上方绕过去，形成一个环。
把右手这一端从环的外侧、也就是远离身体的一侧穿进环里。
拉紧后看起来像打了一个结；但两手一拉两端，结就会散开消失。
按步骤反复练习，直到拉结与散结都能快速完成。
note_cn: 穿环的方向必须是从外侧穿入，方向反了就拉不散。
text_en:
This is one of the most deceptive of all handkerchief tricks. handkerchief is apparently tied in a knot, but the knot dissolves when the ends of the handkerchief are pulled. The method of tying the knot is not difficult. Hold the handkerchief by diagonally opposite corners. The right hand then carries its end away from the body and over the left wrist. The right hand end is then thrust through the loop thus formed from
the outer side (i.e. from the side of the loop away from the body). Then when the ends are pulled, the knot will disappear. Simple though this procedure is, it is not always easy to learn. The only way is to try it, following the directions carefully, until you finally succeed, which may be on the first attempt. Once acquired, the trick can be performed very rapidly.

effect_cn: 手帕中央打了一个松松的结，魔术师右手握拳从上面往下撸两三次，最后一次竟把结整个从手帕里抽了出来。
method_cn: 在手帕中央打一个松松的结，左手捏住手帕上角。
右手握拳，从结的上方往下撸两三次，做足要抓走结的样子。
最后一次下撸时，右拳并不真的握住结，而是把一根手指勾进结里。
手指顺势把结往下拉，直接从布中抽出来。
note_cn: 必须用丝质手帕，结不能打太紧，否则拉不出来。
text_en:
A loose knot is tied in the center of a handkerchief. The left hand holds the upper corner of the handkerchief, and the right fist is drawn down over the knot two or three times. On the last attempt, the hand draws the knot right out of the handkerchief! Persons who attempt to duplicate this trick will find that their efforts only serve to tighten the knot. That is because there is a very clever trick to it. When the right hand is finally drawn over the handkerchief, the fist does not grip the knot at all. Instead, one of the fingers of the right hand is hooked into the knot, as the hand sweeps downward.
The finger will pull the knot right down and out of the cloth. Use a silk handkerchief and do not tie the knot too tightly.

effect_cn: 两条手帕分别展示后抛向空中，落下时竟连在一起打了个结；手一撸，它们又分开落下。
method_cn: 右手拇指和食指指尖事先套一根橡皮筋。
两条手帕分别展示，然后一起抛向空中。
抛起时把橡皮筋套到两条手帕各一端上。
手帕落下时看起来就像被结在了一起。
右手从上往下撸过手帕，同时拉走下面那条，结便消失；橡皮筋悄悄掉在地上。
note_cn: 抛手帕和套橡皮筋要在同一个动作里完成，别让观众看清手部细节。
text_en: Two handkerchiefs are shown separately. They are tossed up in the air and they come down tied together. The left hand holds the upper handkerchief with the lower one dangling. The right hand sweeps down over the handkerchiefs and they fall apart. Method Have a rubber band on the tips of the right thumb and forefinger. In tossing the handkerchiefs into the air, slip the elastic over one end of each handkerchief and when they come down they will seem to be tied. When the right hand sweeps down it simply pulls the lower handkerchief and the "knot" is gone. The elastic is secretly dropped on the floor.

effect_cn: 一根火柴放在手帕中央，隔着布把它折断，再打开手帕，火柴却完好地掉了出来。
method_cn: 在手帕的折边里藏一根备用火柴。
把另一根火柴放在手帕中央，折起手帕包住它。
隔着布用力折断，被折断的其实是折边里那根备用火柴。
打开手帕，原本那根火柴完好地掉出来。
如果在另一处折边里也藏有火柴，这个魔术还可以重复。
note_cn: 藏火柴的位置要靠近手帕角，折起后正好落在捏断的地方。
text_en: A match is placed in the center of a handkerchief. The match is broken through the cloth, but when the handkerchief is unrolled, the match drops out, uninjured. A duplicate match is concealed in the hem of the handkerchief. This is the match which is broken through the folded cloth not the original match. By having a second match concealed in another part of the hem, the trick may be repeated. The hidden matches should be near corners of the cloth.

effect_cn: 魔术师在观众鼻子底下把一小块手帕揉成团，双手一拍再摊开，手帕已消失得无影无踪。
method_cn: 用一块很小的手帕，把它紧紧揉成一个小球。
双手合握，把手帕球举到观众鼻尖正前方。
右手抓住球，双手略微抬高到观众眼睛上方，同时把右手腕拍在左手上。
右手掌心正对观众，利用这一瞬间把手帕从观众头顶上方抛出去。
立刻双手一拍，再摊开，两手空空。
尽量把手帕抛到椅子或桌子后面，免得落在地上被看见。
note_cn: 必须一次只给一个观众表演，距离越近越容易成功。
text_en:
This is a most mystifying trick which can, however, be shown to only one person at a time. Use a very small handkerchief. This you roll into a tight ball, and hold between your hands right in front of your spectator's nose. Suddenly you clap your hands,
and show them absolutely empty. The handkerchief has completely disappeared, right beneath his very eyes! The closeness of the trick is what makes it possible. The advantage is not with the spectator, but with you. When you are holding the handkerchief right in front of his face, take hold of it with the right hand, and raising your hands slighdy, just above his eyes, slap your right wrist against your left hand. The palm of the right hand is directly towards the spectator, and thus you project the handkerchief over his head so suddenly and so rapidly that he does not catch sight of it. Then you clap your hands and show them empty. If possible, throw the handkerchief so that it falls behind a chair or a table.

effect_cn: 手帕在膝盖上被勒出一个看似结实的结，两手猛地一拉两端，结却瞬间散开消失。
method_cn: 双手用食指和中指捏住手帕对角的两端。
右手从身体一侧把手帕中央绕到拇指上，形成一个环。
右手把右手这一端从外侧、朝身体方向穿过左手那一端下方。
把手帕中央紧紧压在抬起的膝盖上，两手同时向下拉两端。
膝盖的压力让中央勒出好像真正的结；两手猛地一拉，结便瞬间消失。
note_cn: 结的假象全靠膝盖顶住的压力，拉之前别松开膝盖。
text_en:
This is a very pretty disappearing knot trick. Hold the handkerchief by corners diagonally opposite, between
the second fingers and forefingerf of both hands. The right hand, starting from the body, loops the center of the handkerchief over the thumb. Then the right hand pushes the right end of the left handkerchief under the left end of the handkerchief, from the outer side, in towards the body. The center of the handkerchief is pressed firmly against the upraised knee, and the hands pull the ends downwards. As a rethe center of the handkerchief tightens on the knee into what sult, appears to be a genuine knot; but that is due entirely to the pressure of the knee. When the ends are jerked suddenly, the tight "knot" dissolves in an instant.

effect_cn: 魔术师把一块熨好的手帕摊在桌上，捏住中心慢慢提起，松手后手帕竟立住不倒，检查手帕里什么也没有。
method_cn: 从口袋里取出一块折好并熨平的手帕。
把手帕摊在桌上，捏住中心慢慢往上提。
提到手帕几乎立起来时，松开手。
做一个神秘的手势，手帕仍立在那里。
随后拿起来摊开给观众看，里面什么都没有。
note_cn: 手帕上的折痕就是支撑，熨烫时折出的棱线要保留。
text_en:
The magician takes a folded handkerchief from his pocket— neat handkerchief which has been ironed. He spreads it upon the
table, and grasping the center, raises it slowly upward. When he has the handkerchief almost standing, he removes his hand, makes a mystic pass, and there the handkerchief remains. The obvious conclusion is that something is supporting it; but the magician lifts the handkerchief, spreads it out, and shows that it contains nothing. As a matter of fact, nothing is necessary to make the handkerchief stand in this peculiar position. It does so of its own accord, due to the creases, which support its slight weight.

effect_cn: 魔术师两手拉紧丝巾，忽然一松，丝巾像箭一样从手中飞出，飞出几英尺后被右手追上接住。
method_cn: 双手捏住丝巾对角的两端，把丝巾拉得笔直。
左手把丝巾拉得很紧，突然以一个几乎看不见的弹动松手。
右手在同一瞬间松开，丝巾便水平地飞射出去。
右手追上去，在丝巾飞行几英尺后抓住另一端。
练熟后，左右两个方向都能让丝巾飞出去并接住。
note_cn: 关键是两手几乎同时松开，丝巾必须保持水平，差一点就飞不起来。
text_en: The magician takes a silk handkerchief and stretches it between his hands. Suddenly the handkerchief leaves his hands and flies through the air like an arrow. It goes to the right and the right hand overtakes and catches it after it has traveled several feet. The handkerchief is held by diagonally opposite corners. The left hand draws it very tightly, and suddenly lets it go with an imperceptible snap. The right hand instantly releases it and the handkerchief sails through the air. The right hand follows it and catches it by the left hand corner. There is a certain knack necessary; once it is acquired, the trick works very easily, and the handkerchief can be made to fly in either direction. It is essential to release both hands at almost the same instant, the handkerchief being held horizontally. People who try to duplicate this feat will find it very difficult in fact they will almost invariably fail.

effect_cn: 两条丝巾的两角被系成一个看似很紧的双结，抓住上面一条也拉不散；可一旦抛向空中，结立刻消失，两条丝巾分开。
method_cn: 把两条丝巾的各一个角放在一起。
快速把两角扭一下，这个扭转就是所谓的结，并不是真正的打结。
在扭转的基础上再打一个单结，看起来就像双结。
双手抓住丝巾防止扭转松开，把结拉紧；单结加上扭转足以吊住下面那条。
把丝巾抛向空中或一抖，扭转松开，上面的单结也随即滑脱，两条丝巾分开。
note_cn: 拉紧时手不能松，否则扭转会提前散掉；抛起或抖动则让它立刻解开。
text_en:
There are various methods of making two silk handkerchiefs untie themselves; here is one that is new, effective, and certain. The two corners of two handkerchiefs are tied in what appears
be double knot. In fact the knot may be drawn tight by anyto a But when the handkerchiefs are tossed in the air, the knot one. immediately disappears. The knot, made rapidly, is nothing but a twist. The secfirst ond knot, which seems to make it a double knot, is a simple knot. The single knot would not hold the handkerchiefs single together, but because of the twist, it does hold them, and it can be pulled very tightly, provided that the hands hold the handkerkeep the twist from coming undone. The twist stops chiefs to the single knot, and the result is a tight-looking knot that is strong enough to support the lower handkerchief when the upper one is held alone. When the handkerchiefs are thrown in the air, or shaken, they instantly fall apart.

effect_cn: 魔术师把丝巾搭在拇指上，说闭着眼睛也能一瞬间打上结；手一动，丝巾上果然出现了一个结。
method_cn: 把丝巾横搭在左手拇指上，一端垂到拇指与左掌之间。
拿起丝巾自由的一端，从拇指下方绕上来，再向下折，用左拇指和食指指尖捏住，形成一个小圈。
右手抓住丝巾的下端，声明即使闭着眼也能把它一瞬间穿过圈。
快速做一个穿过圈的动作；实际上右手把下端绕过左拇指指尖，再笔直往回拉。
左手始终不松开丝巾，拇指上立刻形成结，还带着一个看起来像原来那个的圈。
note_cn: 左手全程不能松开，绕拇指和回拉要一气呵成。
text_en:
The magician takes a silk handkerchief and lays it across his thumb, the end going down between the thumb and the left palm. He takes the free end of the handkerchief and brings it up under the thumb, then he doubles down the free end, and holds between the tips of the left thumb and forefinger, making a Seizing the lower end of the handkerchief with his right hand,
he states that he will push it through the loop instantly, with his eyes shut. With a quick motion, he apparently does so, tying the handkerchief into a sudden knot. The end of the handkerchief is not pushed through the loop at all. Instead it is quickly swung around the tip of the left thumb and pulled straight back. The left hand must not release the handkerchief at all. A knot is immediately formed upon the left thumb, with a loop that appears to be the one originally there. This trick is surprisingly easy to perform and is quickly learned when tried.

effect_cn: 魔术师左腕缠上手帕，右腕压在上面，请人把手帕两端绕右腕打结；看上去两手被牢牢绑住，他一转身背对观众，瞬间就脱开了。
method_cn: 用手帕绕住左腕，再把右腕压在左腕上方。
请人把手帕两端从右腕上绕过去打结；右端应先搭在前面。
右腕放在交叉处，右手手指指向左肘，再把两端绕过右腕打结。
绑好后看起来是个结实的 8 字形束缚。
脱身时右手向右、左手向左一甩，让手指靠拢，手帕自然解开扭转。
反向做一遍，又能重新回到被绑的状态。
note_cn: 打结前手帕的交叉方向要对，否则甩不开。
text_en:
The magician takes a handkerchief and wraps it around his left wrist. He places his right wrist on top, and asks someone to draw the ends of the handkerchief around it, and tie them in a knot. The magician then appears to be tightly bound; but when he turns his back, he instantly escapes. When the ends of the handkerchief are brought up over the left wrist, the right end should be in front. The right wrist is laid upon the crossing, with the right fingers pointing to the left elbow. Then the ends are brought over the right wrist and are tied.
Everything looks secure; and the hands are held in a stout binding which is shaped exactly like a figure 8. To release, the magician simply swings his right hand to the right and his left to the left, so that the fingers come together. This untwists the handkerchief and makes an immediate release possible. A person can get back into this tie as easily as he got out, by reversing the movements. It can be done behind the back, if desired.

effect_cn: 双手手腕被一根绳子系住，中间留出一段；魔术师把手帕对折成圈，转身片刻后，手帕已经出现在两腕之间的绳子上。
method_cn: 用一段绳子把两个手腕分别系住，两腕之间留一段绳。
把两个对角系在一起，让手帕形成一个圈。
转身背对观众片刻。
把手帕沿手臂往上滑，从绕左腕的绳圈下方穿过去。
手帕便落到两腕之间的绳子上。
note_cn: 整个动作几秒钟就够，转身只是为了挡住穿绳的瞬间。
text_en:
The wrists are tied with a piece of cord, a length of string extending between them. The magician shows a handkerchief which is tied so that it forms a loop two diagonal corners being tied together. Turning his back for a moment, he passes the handkerchief on the length of string which is between his wrists. Method: Slide the handkerchief up the arm, drawing it under the loop of cord that encircles the left wrist. It will then fall on the string between the wrists. The whole operation takes but a few seconds.
Tricks with liquids are always effective; for they are easily seen, and always appear to be difficult. One of the first tricks I ever performed employed liquids, and I will explain it as the first item of this chapter.

effect_cn: 一杯装着墨水的玻璃杯，魔术师把一张扑克牌浸进去，下半截沾满墨汁；用手帕盖住杯子再揭开，墨水已变成清水。
method_cn: 玻璃杯里看似装墨，其实是杯内衬了一个黑色丝绸圆筒，圆筒上系一根黑线，线端的小纽扣挂在杯沿外。
拿一张双面牌，其中一面预先涂黑了下半截；浸杯时翻转牌面，让观众看到沾墨的那一面。
用手帕或大餐巾盖住杯子。
揭手帕时隔着布捏住杯沿外那颗纽扣，把黑绸衬筒连同手帕一起提走。
手帕卷起扔到一旁，杯中便只剩清水。
若用大玻璃容器，可事先在水里放金鱼，变色后能看到鱼在游。
note_cn: 纽扣要正好挂在杯沿外，揭盖时才能一捏就走。
text_en: A glass is exhibited, partly filled with ink. The magician dips a playing card in the ink, and brings it out, with its lower half covered with the fluid. Then he covers the glass with a napkin or a large handkerchief. When he removes the cloth, the ink has changed to water! Method: The interior of the glass is lined with a cylinder of black silk. A piece of black thread, with a small button on the end, is attached to the cylinder. The button dangles over the rim of the glass. When the magician removes the handkerchief he grips the button through the cloth, and thus carries the lining away. The handkerchief may then be rolled up and tossed aside. The inking of the card is accomplished by having a doublefaced card with one side of the card already blackened part way. The card is turned around when it is dipped in the "ink," and the reverse side is shown. If a large glass receptable is used, goldfish may be put in the water and they will be seen swimming there after the transformation.

effect_cn: 一杯清水，用手帕盖住再揭开，整杯水变成了墨水。
method_cn: 把一粒墨水药片藏在手帕的折缝里。
展示一杯清水，再用手帕盖住杯口。
隔着布让药片落进水里，它会在温水中迅速溶解。
揭开手帕，整杯水已经变成墨水。
note_cn: 药片要藏稳，落水前别让观众看到；温水溶解更快。
text_en: The change of a glass of water to a glass of ink is accomplished by an entirely different method. In this case, the magician uses an "ink tablet," which is hidden in the folds of the handkerchief. The tablet dissolves quickly in warm water and makes a glass of ink. Tablets that make an imitation ink are sold by dealers in magical apparatus; but more concentrated tablets, used for making real ink, may be purchased at stationery stores.*

effect_cn: 一杯清水用手帕盖住，揭开后变成一杯葡萄酒色的液体。
method_cn: 准备几粒高锰酸钾晶体。
展示一杯清水，用手帕盖住杯口。
盖手帕的同时把晶体丢进杯里。
隔着布把杯子倾斜一下，帮助晶体溶解，水便变成酒色。
note_cn: 这杯液体不能饮用。
text_en: A glass of water, covered with a handkerchief, may be transformed into a glass of "wine" as easily as into a glass of ink. To do this, obtain a few crystals of potassium permanganate and drop them into the glass when you cover it with a handkerchief. Tilting the glass under the handkerchief helps in the dissolution of the crystals, and a glassful of wine-colored liquid will result.*

effect_cn: 把一杯葡萄酒色的液体从一只杯子倒进另一只空杯，液体在倒入的瞬间变成了清水。
method_cn: 在一只杯中放水并溶入高锰酸钾，做成酒色液体。
另一只杯里预先放少量双氧水，因为无色，观众看不出来。
把酒色液体从第一只杯倒进第二只杯。
两种液体混合，颜色立刻褪去，看上去酒变成了水。
note_cn: 液体不能饮用，表演后不要让人尝。
text_en: The instantaneous transformation of wine to water may be effected by merely pouring the liquid from one glass into another. The "wine" is water in which potassium permanganate has been dissolved. The other glass contains a small quantity of hydrogen peroxide, which, being colorless, is not observed. As soon as the "wine" is poured into the "empty" glass, it changes to "water."*

effect_cn: 一只小高脚杯里盛着水，上面倒扣着第二只杯子；魔术师不用手碰上面那只杯，就把下面的水倒进上面的杯里，而且全程没让上杯落到桌面或地面。
method_cn: 把一只小高脚杯装约三分之一的水，第二只杯子倒扣在第一只上面。
把头尽量向前低，用牙齿咬住上面那只杯子杯脚较远的一侧。
再把头向后仰，杯子便稳稳地保持竖直。
拿起下面那只杯子，把水倒进嘴里衔着的杯子。
水量别太多：重量和倒水的难度都是问题。
note_cn: 水要少，咬住杯脚的位置要稳，不然杯子会滑。
text_en:
Take a small goblet about one-third full with water, or some other liquid. Set a second goblet upside down upon the first. * These liquids are not drinkable.
The trick is to pour the contents of the lower glass into the upper glass, without touching the upper glass with your hand, and without anyone else touching the upper glass. To make the problem still more difficult, the upper glass cannot be set on the table or on the floor until it has had the liquid poured into it! It sounds impossible, but it can be done. Bend your head well forward, so that you can grip the further side of the foot of the upper goblet between your teeth. Then bend your head well backwards, and you will be holding the goblet firmly in an upright position. Pick up the lower goblet and pour its contents into the goblet you are holding in your mouth. Be careful not to use too much liquid; the weight of it is something of a factor, as well as the difficulty in pouring.

effect_cn: 箱子上的一杯葡萄酒，盖上手帕再揭开，变成了绿色的薄荷利口酒；再盖上揭开，又变成一杯清水。
method_cn: 剪两片透明赛璐珞，一红一绿，尺寸刚好能放进小高脚杯。
杯里装满清水，把两片赛璐珞插进去；从两英尺外看，杯子就像盛着葡萄酒。
第一次用手帕从杯上掠过时，抽走红色赛璐珞片丢到箱子后面，再展示杯子，酒就变成绿色薄荷酒。
第二次同样抽走绿色片，杯子看起来就只剩清水。
若想要别的颜色，可再加一片黄色或琥珀色赛璐珞，留到最后抽走会变出另一种液体。
note_cn: 水的折射让颜色错觉更逼真，杯子要透明、水量要满。
text_en: The magician has a glass of wine, standing on a box. He covers it with a handkerchief, and when the cloth is removed, a green creme de menthe has replaced the wine. The handkerchief again covers the glass, and this time water is the resulting liquid. The water is drinkable. small goblet should be used. Obtain two pieces of transparent celluloid; one red, the other green, and cut them to fit the goblet. Fill the goblet with water, insert the flat pieces of celluloid, and from two feet away, the glass will appear to contain wine. The refraction of the water makes the illusion perfect. When the handkerchief is first drawn over the glass, remove the red celluloid and drop it behind the box. Then show the glass. The next time, take away the green celluloid, and drop it along with the other. If desired the green may be taken away first, leaving claret instead of creme de menthe. A yellow or amber colored celluloid may also be added; it will not affect the colors of the others, but if it is left to the last, it will produce another liquid.

effect_cn: 浅碗里盛水、水中落着硬币，魔术师不弄湿手指、也不移动碗，就把硬币全部取了出来。
method_cn: 浅碗里倒水，放进两三枚硬币。
在玻璃杯里塞一些松散的纸，点着火。
纸烧起来时，迅速把杯子倒扣在碗中央。
杯内空气冷却后把水吸进杯里，碗底露出硬币。
这时伸手把硬币取出来，手指不会沾水。
note_cn: 先说明碗不能移动；倒扣要快，火别太大。
text_en: Pour some water into a shallow bowl, then drop two or three coins into the water. The trick is to remove the coins without wetting the fingers. The bowl must not be removed from its present position. In fact, so many conditions may be imposed that the trick will seem absolutely impossible. There is a very ingenious method of accomplishing the desired result. Put some loose paper into a glass, and set fire to the paper. While it is blazing, quickly invert the glass in the center of the bowl. The water will be sucked up into the glass and you can remove the coins.

effect_cn: 平底杯装满水、盖上一张纸，倒过来水竟不流；更奇的是把纸抽走，水还悬在杯口，直到轻碰杯沿，水和一张透明圆片才一起落下。
method_cn: 准备一片结实的透明赛璐珞圆片，放在桌上，上面盖一张略湿的纸。
玻璃杯装满水，把纸连同圆片一起盖到杯口；倒转时用手压住纸。
把杯子倒过来，水不会流出来。
抽走纸，透明的圆片仍贴着杯口，看不见，看上去就像水凭空悬在杯中。
把杯子举到水壶或碗上方，用指尖碰一下圆片露出的边缘，水和圆片便一起落下去。
杯底侧面可预先钻一个小孔，用手指按住，直到最后松开，空气进入会自动放开圆片。
note_cn: 纸要微湿、杯口要平，圆片才贴得牢。
text_en:
A tumbler is filled with water, and a sheet of paper is placed over the mouth. Then the tumbler is inverted, but the water does not escape. This is a simple problem in physics, and many persons know that it can be accomplished, so not much surprise will be evidenced. But when you deliberately pull the paper from the mouth of the tumbler, and the water still remains there, a real mystery will be created! When the tumbler is held over a pitcher, or a bowl, the water suddenly leaves the glass and falls into the pitcher. stout disc of transparent celluloid is required for this trick; and the glass used should have a rather flat edge. The celluloid is lying on the table, under the piece of paper (which should be slightly moistened). When the glass is filled with water, the paper is laid over its mouth, and the celluloid is thus adjusted to the tumbler. When the glass is inverted, the water does not escape. The hand should be pressed against the paper during the inversion. When the paper is removed, the transparent celluloid is in-
visible, and the water alone appears to occupy the glass. At the proper moment, touch the projecting edge of the disc with the tip of your finger, and water and disc will drop into the pitcher. The glass may be specially prepared for this experiment, by having a tiny hole bored in the side of the bottom. In this case, a finger is kept over the air-hole until the last instant. When the finger is removed, the inrushing air will release the disc and finish the trick automatically.

effect_cn: 魔术师把手伸进一碗水里，抽出来时手竟然是干的。
method_cn: 把硬脂酸锌粉充分搓进整只手里。
粉抹匀后看不出痕迹。
把手迅速伸进水里，再立刻抽出。
手上的水被粉层隔开，手仍是干的。
note_cn: 爽身粉或石松粉效果都不够好，最好用硬脂酸锌。
text_en: The magician dips his hand into a bowl of water. When he removes the hand, it is still dry! This is due to a preparation applied to the hand. Talcum and lycopodium powders have been recommended, but neither is entirely satisfactory. The best substance is stearate of zinc. If this powder is thoroughly rubbed into the hand, its presence will not be detected; yet when the hand is thrust into the water, and instantly removed, it will be quite dry.

effect_cn: 一杯水用纸条封住，灯关掉、魔术师的双手被人握住；灯再亮时，杯里的水已经不见了。
method_cn: 用纸条把一杯水封住，使谁也无法就着杯子喝。
关灯，请人握住表演者的双手。
表演者用嘴够到内袋里的吸管，把水吸干。
再把吸管放回口袋，喊人开灯。
灯亮时，杯里的水已经消失。
note_cn: 吸管的动作要在黑暗里完成，双手被握住时只靠嘴。
text_en: This is a trick of pseudo-spiritistic nature. glass of water is covered with paper strips, so that no one can drink from it. The lights are turned out, and the performer's hands are held. When the lights come on again, the water is gone! The magician has a drinking straw in his inside coat pocket. He reaches with his mouth, obtains the straw and drinks the water. Then he drops the straw back in his pocket, and calls for the lights.

effect_cn: 魔术师从外套口袋里掏出一只盛满水的玻璃杯，水一点都没洒。
method_cn: 玻璃杯装满水，用一个橡胶盖片盖紧杯口，再用粗橡皮筋把盖片固定住。
把杯子竖着藏在外套口袋里。
表演时一只手隔着外套抓住杯子，让它保持竖直。
另一只手伸进口袋，把橡胶盖片揭下来。
随手把杯子从口袋里拿出来，动作自然随意。
note_cn: 全程不能让杯子倾斜，盖片揭下后更不能歪。
text_en: The production of a glass, filled with water, from the pocket, never fails to create amazement; yet the explanation is very simple. The glass is covered with a cap of sheet rubber. Special caps are manufactured for this purpose; if they are not obtainable, a sheet of rubber, such as one cut from a toy balloon, will fill the bill. In this case, a heavy rubber band should be used to hold the rubber cover in place. In performing the trick, grip the glass through the coat with one hand, and hold it upright. With the other hand, reach in, peel off the cover and produce the glass in a nonchalant manner.

effect_cn: 魔术师拿起一只装了大半杯水的杯子在空中挥转，杯子被倒过来又转回正位，竟一滴水都没有洒出来。
method_cn: 杯子装到约四分之三满，先在户外或浴缸上方练习。
把杯子平放在手掌上，手臂伸直绷紧。
手臂沿半圆形快速挥动，最后让杯子停在反手位置。
离心力会把水压在杯底，所以杯子翻过一整圈也不会洒。
若用特制杯：杯口有一层玻璃封住，杯脚中空，从杯脚灌入液体，再用小软木塞塞住；杯口凹处可先倒一点液体，假装杯太满倒掉，看上去就像普通杯子。
表演后要在别人细看之前把特制杯拿走。
note_cn: 关键是把手臂绷直、靠离心力，千万别用手腕去翻。
text_en:
This is a feat of dexterity that appears to be very difficult. The magician picks up a glass and swings it around in the air, turning it upside down, and finally bringing it right side up without spilling a drop of the liquid in the glass, which may be about three-quarters full. The trick should first be practised out of doors or over a bathtub. The glass is held flat on the palm of the hand. Then the arm is held stiff, and is swung in a semicircle, ending with the glass held in a backhand position. Once the knack is acquired, the trick may be performed with impunity, as the centrifugal force keeps the liquid from falling out. People who attempt to duplicate the feat seldom succeed as their nerve fails them and they unconsciously twist the wrist instead of holding the arm stiff. There is a certain type of trick glass, sold by novelty stores that can be used in this experiment. The glass is made like a goblet, but there is a layer of glass at the mouth, so that no liquid may be poured in or out. The stem, however, is hollow, and the glass
is filled through the stem, a small cork keeping the liquid in. If the goblet is filled with milk or grape juice, it has all the appearance of a normal glass; to add to the illusion, a litde of the liquid may be poured on top of the glass, which is concave. Pretending that the glass is too full, the magician pours out the little liquid that is on top, thus making the glass appear quite ordinary. He may then whirl the glass in the air, and catch it without spilling a drop. He should, of course, remove the glass before anyone happens to examine it closely.

effect_cn: 魔术师展示一只装满火柴的盒子，放到桌上；过一会儿拿起来一摇，哗啦作响，请人打开盒子，里面却空空如也。
method_cn: 表演前用一只空盒子换掉那只装满火柴的盒子。
袖子里另藏一只装了一半火柴的小盒子。
拿起桌上的空盒子摇晃时，声音其实来自袖子里的盒子。
观众听见响声，便以为手里的盒子仍然是满的。
请人打开盒子，里面什么都没有。
note_cn: 摇盒子的动作要自然，让声音和动作完全同步。
text_en: A box is shown full of matches, and is laid on the table. After a time the magician picks it up, and shakes it so the matches rattle. "Plenty ofmatches there," he remarks. "Take one out." Someone opens the box. It is empty! Before performing the trick the magician substitutes an empty box for the full one. Up his sleeve he has a pardy filled box of matches (preferably a half size box). When he shakes the empty box, the audience hears the sound of the matches in the hidden box and supposes the visible box is still full of matches.

effect_cn: 三个火柴盒在桌上倒来倒去，只有一个装着火柴，可无论观众怎么挑，拿到的总是空盒。
method_cn: 用三个火柴盒，其中一个装满火柴，其余两个是空的。
把满盒用橡皮筋固定在袖子里，桌上的三个盒子其实都是空的。
在桌上把三个空盒倒来倒去，让观众挑选。
需要让某个盒子听起来是满的时候，就摇它，声音其实来自袖子里的满盒。
观众凭声音追着满盒走，最后拿到的自然总是空盒。
note_cn: 摇盒子的时机要跟观众的目光配合，声音才能误导他们。
text_en:
A trick that rivals the famous "Three Card Monte" may be performed with match-boxes. Three boxes are used one of which contains matches. The magician mixes them around on the table and asks someone to pick up the full box. Somehow or other, the spectator always gets an empty box. This is due to an application of the method used in the preceding trick. A full box, held in place, up the magician's sleeve, by a rubber band, makes one of the empty boxes appear to be full when the magician shakes it. The spectators follow the box in which they hear the matches rattle. The trick can be worked with three empty boxes; but the audience supposes one is full, and
the magician keeps up the delusion by occasionally shaking a box.

effect_cn: 一张扑克牌被按进火柴盒顶上的缝里，像把整盒火柴从中间切开，可把盒子一推一拉，两端都还能看到火柴。
method_cn: 火柴盒的内屉预先横着隔成三段，中间一段的两侧剪掉。
两端各粘一块纸或卡纸，上面再粘火柴：一端露出火柴头，另一端露出火柴杆。
把内屉稍微拉开，看上去就像满满一盒火柴。
盒盖顶面与两侧事先开一道横缝，把扑克牌慢慢按进缝里，像在切开整盒火柴。
随后把内屉前后推拉，两端都能看到火柴；牌正好挡住内屉，不会露出中间的空腔。
把盒子连同牌一起收进口袋，或抽走牌扔给观众检查，口袋里可另备一个没处理过的盒子应付检查。
note_cn: 牌插入要慢，推拉内屉时别超过牌挡住的位置。
text_en: This is an up to date novelty in match tricks. match-box is shown with a crosswise slit in the middle of the top and the sides. The magician opens the box slightly, showing the heads of the matches; then he closes it and pushes a playing card down into the slit. To the surprise of everyone the card apparently cuts right through the matches to the bottom of the box. Then the magician pushes the drawer of the box back and forth, showing the heads at one end and the blanks at the other! Method The drawer of the box is previously divided into three sections, crosswise and the sides of the middle section are cut away. The end sections are provided with little blocks of paper or cardboard, which are glued in place, and on top of these are glued the ends of matches, heads at one end, blanks at the other. Thus if the drawer is opened slightly, it appears to be full of matches. The card is inserted slowly as though cutting through a box full of matches. Then the drawer may be pushed back and forth, showing matches at both ends. The card stops the progress of the drawer, so there is no danger of revealing the hollow center. The box should be pocketed with the card still through it; or the card may be withdrawn and tossed for examination while the box is pocketed. duplicate (unprepared) box can be kept in the pocket to be brought out later on.

effect_cn: 魔术师展示一个半开的火柴盒，里面是空的；把内屉合上再拉开，盒子里竟多出一层火柴。
method_cn: 火柴其实一直藏在盒里，被卡在内屉末端与盒盖内侧之间。
拉开内屉展示时，火柴卡在盖子里，看上去盒子是空的。
把内屉合上，合的时候手指按住盒口，免得火柴被推出来。
再拉开内屉，火柴已经落进内屉里，一整层火柴就出现了。
note_cn: 半高的火柴盒更适合这个魔术，火柴层显得更多。
text_en:
A match-box is shown with the drawer half opened. The box is empty. The drawer is closed and when it is reopened, a number of matches are within.
The matches are in the box all the time but they are wedged between the end of the drawer and the inside of the cover. Thus the box may be shown apparently empty. When the drawer is closed, (the fingers being held at the end to prevent the matches from pushing out), the matches will fall in the drawer. A whole layer of matches may be produced in this manner. Some match-boxes are sold which are only half the height of the usual match-box. They are especially suited for this trick, as the layer of matches makes a greater showing.

effect_cn: 满满一盒火柴立在桌上，魔术师右手把内屉推进去，左手伸到桌下再拿上来时，竟抓出一大把火柴，盒子却空了。
method_cn: 把一个火柴盒内屉的末端切下约三分之一。
把火柴剪成同样长度，粘在这截内屉里，做成一个假内屉。
拿一个空火柴盒，把假内屉粘在盒口一端，看起来就像满盒火柴拉出了一截。
把盒子立在桌上，左手扶住；右手拍打假内屉把它推进盒里，同时把假内屉藏在手指弯里带走。
观众看到的是真内屉的末端，以为盒子只是被关上了。
左手伸到桌下，取出事先藏好的散火柴；把空盒交给观众检查，同时把假内屉悄悄收进口袋。
note_cn: 拍打和内屉的掉包要在同一个动作里完成。
text_en: This is a very surprising trick with matches, and one that is quite new. A box of matches is stood on end, on the table, the drawer being part way open, showing the box filled with matches. Holding the box with his left hand, the magician strikes the open drawer with his right hand and drives it shut. Then he reaches under the table with the left hand and brings up all the matches. The drawer is opened, and found to be quite empty. For this trick you require a little contrivance which can be made very easily. Cut about one third off the end of a drawer of a match box. Cut a number of matches to the same size, and glue them in the portion of the drawer. Then take an empty match-box, and stick the imitation drawer on the end. To all appearances you have a full box of matches, which pushed part way open. Stand the box on the table; hold it with the left hand. Then strike the imitation drawer with the right hand, and carry it away in the bend of the fingers. The spectators see the end of the genuine drawer, and think you have merely driven the box shut. Reach under the table, and bring up a lot of loose matches, which you have concealed there. Then let the people examine the empty box while you quietly pocket the imitation drawer.

props: 侧面带砂纸的蓝头火柴盒
effect_cn: 魔术师把一盒火柴往外套袖子上一按，盒子就粘在袖子上不掉下来，还可以拿下来给观众检查。
method_cn: 选一种侧面贴有砂纸的蓝头火柴盒。
把盒子贴砂纸的一侧按在袖子上。
砂纸面会挂住衣料，盒子就粘在那里。
取下盒子交给观众检查，看不出任何机关。
note_cn: 要让贴砂纸的那一面对着袖子，衣料粗糙一些更易粘住。
text_en: This is an interesting little item in connection with match tricks. Taking a box of matches, you set it against your coat sleeve and it sticks there. The box may be examined. Use a box of blue-tipped matches, which has sandpaper on the sides. Place the side of the box against the sleeve and it will adhere there.

effect_cn: 魔术师把一只半开的满盒火柴推进左拳，再摊开左手，手里的火柴盒竟缩小成原来的一半。
method_cn: 大盒塞满火柴，合上时不发出响声；小盒只装到不满。
把大盒内屉拉开到接近全开，盒盖内有一块空位，正好藏进小盒。
让突出的内屉朝向观众，左手用拇指捏住盒子的里端，收进拳中。
右手盖住突出的内屉，把它往里推合，同时把小盒顶进左拳里。
右手握紧大盒并把它带走，藏在握起的右手中。
同时抬起左手，观众目光跟随，左手轻晃，听到火柴响、瞥见盒角，便以为大盒推进了左拳。
坐着时右手放低，让大盒落进膝上；站着时立即左转，晃小盒并扔到桌上，右手顺势把大盒收进口袋。
note_cn: 右拳不能松，大盒要在推合内屉的一瞬间被完全握住。
text_en:
The following trick requires a slight amount of skill, but it is worth the practice. You have a half-opened box of matches, which is filled. The left hand is closed in a fist, and the box is held in the end of the fist. The right hand shuts the drawer of the box and pushes the box into the left fist. But when the left fist is opened, the match-box is only one-half its original size! All you need is an ordinary match box and a half-size box such as can be purchased at many novelty or cigar stores. The large box should be tightly filled with matches so that they will not rattle when the box is closed, but the small box is not quite full. Push the drawer of the large box nearly open and you will find a large hiding place inside the cover where you can conceal the small box. Of course the protruding drawer of the large box is towards the audience. Then you are ready for business. Show the box, and grip the inner end in your left fist, by the thumb. Turn your right side towards your audience. Now the right hand is placed squarely over the protruding drawer, and it pushes the drawer shut, thus ejecting the small box into the left fist. The right hand firmly grips the large box and carries it away, the box being hidden in the closed right hand. At the same instant, the left hand is raised, the eyes follow it, and it is shaken slightly. The spectators hear the matches rattle,
and they catch a glimpse of the box in the left fist, so they think the large box has been pushed in there. If the magician is seated at a table, he should lower his right hand and let the large box fall in his lap. If he is standing, he should immediately turn his left side towards the audience, while shaking the little box and then throw the box on the table, while the right hand pockets the large box.

effect_cn: 魔术师展示空手，取出一根火柴划燃，竟从燃烧的火柴里拉出一长卷丝带。
method_cn: 把火柴盒内屉推出一半，把卷紧的丝带塞到内屉后面。
把火柴盒放在桌上，开口一端朝向观众，并展示双手空空。
左手拿起盒子，右手取出一根火柴。
右手把内屉推合，这个自然动作会把丝带顶进左手。
右手划燃火柴，左手靠近把火掐灭，假装从烟雾里拉出丝带。
note_cn: 丝带要卷紧、藏稳，推内屉的动作要自然得像随手关盒。
text_en: The magician takes a box of matches, after showing his hands empty. He removes a match and strikes it, and then produces a long coil of ribbon from the lighted match. To do this, push the drawer of the match-box halfway open and insert the coiled-up ribbon in back of the drawer. The matchbox is laid on the table with the open end towards the audience. The hands are shown empty. The left hand picks up the box, while the right hand extracts the match. The drawer of the box is then pushed shut a most natural procedure which ejects the ribbon into the left hand. The right hand lights the match, and the left approaches, extinguishes the match and pretends to draw the ribbon from the smoke.

effect_cn: 桌上六根火柴，要求摆出四个大小相同、不能折断也不能交叉的三角形。
method_cn: 先用三根火柴在桌面上摆成一个三角形。
另外三根分别从三角形的三个顶点向上搭起，形成一个三脚架。
每个侧面都是一个完整的三角形，共三个立面加一个底面，正好四个。
这些三角形同样大小，火柴没有折断也没有交叉。
note_cn: 四个三角形不全在桌面上，有一个是立起来的。
text_en: This is more of a puzzle than a trick but it is so perplexing that it deserves mention. Six matches are laid on the table, to be made into four triangles. All the triangles must be the same size and the matches must not be broken or crossed. The solution is to lay three matches in the form of a triangle and set the other three so they form a tripod, each leg starting from an apex of the triangle. Thus four perfect triangles are formed, but only one is on the horizontal plane.

effect_cn: 两手各捏一根火柴，两手一合，两根火柴竟然互相穿过、扣在一起，拉开再推回都分不开。
method_cn: 双手各用拇指和食指捏住一根火柴的两端。
把右手食指指尖沾湿，按在一根火柴头上，火柴就会粘在指尖。
两手靠拢的瞬间，右手食指微微抬起，火柴跟着升起，让左手那根火柴从下方穿过。
两手拉开时同样让火柴错开，看起来就像两根火柴互相穿透。
整个穿插过程中，双手要保持连续移动。
note_cn: 火柴必须在移动中交错，停住就容易被看出是抬手。
text_en:
Each hand holds a match, by the ends, between the thumb and forefinger. The hands are brought together, and the matches apparently pass through one another, becoming linked. They are drawn apart, and pushed back and forth.
Use sulphur matches for this trick. Moisten the tip of the right forefinger, and when it is pressed against the head of one match, the match will stick to it. When the hands are brought together, the right forefinger is raised for an instant; the match comes up with it, and permits the passage of the left hand match. The matches are drawn apart in the same manner. The hands should be kept in continuous motion during the "penetration."

effect_cn: 魔术师划燃一根火柴递给观众，观众却只拿到没有火的那一截，火还留在魔术师手里。
method_cn: 事先把一根火柴从中间折断。
划火柴时把两截并在一起拿，看起来像一根完整的火柴。
把火柴递向观众，观众自然抓住没有火的那一截断端。
魔术师拿着带火的一截走开，观众手里只剩一截火柴杆。
note_cn: 两截要并紧，火头那截朝向自己，观众才不会拿到火。
text_en: When a person wants a lighted match, try this little trick. You light a match and hold it out to him. Of course he takes the unlighted end. So you walk away, carrying the light, while he has nothing but the stump of a match. The match is previously broken in the center. Hold the two portions together when you light the match. Extend your hand and the person will take the broken end while you still have the light.

effect_cn: 安全火柴本来只能在盒子上划着，魔术师却在自己的鞋底上一下划燃了。
method_cn: 先取一个火柴盒，用盒子侧面的砂纸在脚背处的鞋底上摩擦。
砂纸上的引火物质会蹭到鞋底上。
表演时拿一根安全火柴，在鞋底蹭过的地方一划。
火柴就点燃了，看上去像是在鞋底上划着的。
note_cn: 要在脚背位置的鞋底上蹭，表演时把鞋底朝上才顺手。
text_en: Safety matches can only be struck on the box. Everyone knows that. Therefore they will be surprised to see you blissfully light a safety match on the sole of your shoe! This requires a little previous preparation. Take a match box and rub the side of it against the sole of your shoe, at the instep. Enough of the striking substance will be transferred so that you can light a match on your shoe.

effect_cn: 魔术师把两三根火柴一根根拿在手里，上下移动之间火柴接连消失，最后摊开手指，手里空空如也。
method_cn: 右手无名指上戴一枚戒指。
把无名指和小指弯向掌心。
拇指和食指、中指捏着火柴，把火柴往下推进戒指下面、手指背后。
手保持移动，火柴藏好后把五指张开给观众看。
一根接一根重复，火柴便一根根消失。
note_cn: 手不能停，藏火柴要在上下移动的节奏里完成。
text_en:
This is a very pretty trick with matches. Two or three matches are used. The right hand takes them one at a time, and, moving up and down, causes the matches to disappear, the hand being shown empty with the fingers wide apart.
Method: You must wear a finger ring on your third finger. Bend in the third and fourth fingers, while the thumb and first two fingers, which are holding the match, push it down in under the ring, and in back of the finger. The hand is kept in motion, and when the match is in place the fingers are spread wide apart.

effect_cn: 一根火柴竟能斜立在拇指背上，晃来晃去却不倒。
method_cn: 把火柴底端放在一只手的拇指关节上。
把拇指往内弯。
再伸直拇指，火柴便卡进皮肤的一道皱褶里。
轻轻移动手掌，火柴就能保持直立不倒。
note_cn: 让火柴卡在拇指关节的皱纹里，比平放更容易立住。
text_en: Here is a clever method of balancing a match on the back of the thumb. Set the bottom of the match upon the knuckle of one thumb and bend the thumb inward. Then extend your thumb and the match will be set in a wrinkle or crease in the skin. By moving the hand slightly it is an easy matter to keep the match in an upright position.

effect_cn: 火柴一划就着，可火苗刚烧起来就立刻熄灭了。
method_cn: 准备一些硅酸钠，也就是常见的水玻璃。
在火柴头下方涂上一小圈水玻璃，不需要涂太多。
晾干后，火柴划得着。
但火苗一烧到水玻璃那一段就会立刻熄灭。
note_cn: 水玻璃只涂头下窄窄一圈，涂太多会影响点着。
text_en: Matches that go out as soon as they are lighted always create considerable amusement. These matches are very easily prepared. Obtain some sodium silicate, which is commonly known as water glass, and paint the matches with it, just below the heads. Only a narrow strip needs to be painted around each match. The matches will light when they are struck, but will go out as soon as the flame encounters the water glass.

effect_cn: 四根火柴摆成一个十字，只移动其中一根，就让它们围成一个正方形。
method_cn: 把四根火柴摆成十字形。
问题：只移动一根火柴，让四根火柴围成一个正方形。
把其中一根火柴挪动约十六分之一英寸。
四根火柴的间隙就围成一个极小的正方形。
note_cn: 答案是一个极小的正方形，移动的距离要非常微细。
text_en:
This is a puzzle with matches but it is so novel that it is quite as interesting as the average match trick. Lay four matches in the form of a cross, as illustrated in Fig. i. The problem is to move one match and make the matches form the sides of a perfect square.
Solution: Move one match about a sixteenth of an inch, as shown in Fig. 2. Thus the matches will form the sides of a square, but it will be a very tiny square indeed! Nevertheless it fulfills the conditions of the problem to the letter.

effect_cn: 魔术师把手伸进口袋，取出来时手里已是一根点燃的火柴。
method_cn: 口袋里放一个空的火柴盒，盒边躺一根散火柴。
伸手进口袋取火柴时，顺势把火柴在盒侧砂纸上划着。
火柴离开口袋时火苗正好燃起，不会烧到手。
进阶版：把蜡烛放在外套内袋，烛芯位置换成一根蓝头火柴，右手按住口袋外侧固定火柴盒，左手取出蜡烛时在盒上划着。
note_cn: 火柴要在出袋的一瞬间划着，动作太快反而容易划空。
text_en:
Taking a lighted match from the pocket is a very surprising little trick. All that is necessary is to have an empty box of safety matches in the pocket, with a loose match lying beside it. In taking the match from your pocket, strike it on the box by merely sliding it out. There is no danger from the match as it comes clear of the pocket just as the flame breaks forth. A more elaborate trick is the "Lighted Candle From Pocket," which is performed in the same way. The candle is in the inside coat pocket, and instead of the wick it has a blue-tipped match in its end. While the right hand presses the outside of the pocket and holds the match-box steady, the left hand reaches in, obtains
the candle and strikes it on the box, immediately bringing it from the pocket. Wooden candles, made in imitation of the usual wax candle, are often used in this trick.
