The hand is obviously empty, but when he grasps in the air, he instantly catches half a dozen Chinese coins, which are tossed from hand to hand, and finally given for inspection. The coins are first stacked together. A thread, white or pink, is then run through their centers, and tied in a loop. The loop should be long enough so that when it is slipped over the right thumb the coins will hang out of sight behind the hand. With the coins in position, the palm of the hand may be shown quite empty, the thread being invisible at a distance of a few feet. Swing the hand upward, and tilt it slightly forward. The coins will fly over into the hand, where they are caught in the fist. The coins may be tossed from hand to hand without breaking the thread, or they may be "vanished" from the right hand. This is done by letting the coins lie on the palm of the hand. Then the left hand covers the coins, and the left fingers push them over and in back of the right hand, where they hang out of sight, while both palms are shown. Then the coins may be caught again, and this time, the string is broken when the coins are passed from hand to hand, so the coins may be given for inspection.

effect_cn: 戒指被绳子以古怪的方式穿住，两位观众同时一拉，魔术师松开手中的绳圈，戒指便落进他摊开的手掌。
method_cn: 把绳子结成圈，将一端穿过戒指中心，再把另一端穿过刚才形成的绳圈。
让两位观众分别捏住绳子的两端，你捏住中间的绳圈。
请他们慢慢拉紧，绳子会把戒指吊在三股绳的交汇处。
你把另一只手摊在戒指下方，喊一声「拉！」。
两人一拉，你就松开手中的绳圈，戒指顺势落进摊开的手掌里。
note_cn: 松绳圈的时机要跟观众拉绳同时，早或晚都会让戒指卡住。
text_en:
This experiment may be worked with a finger ring or a napkin ring. Take a circle of string and push one end through the center of the ring; then push the opposite end through the loop thus formed. A reference to the diagram will show how the string appears. Let two persons take hold of the string at the point marked X XandY and Y, while you hold the loop Z. When they pull the ends taut, the string will be held in three ways. Have your other hand below the ring and say, "Pull." As the persons pull on the loops, let go of the loop you are holding, and the ring will drop into your outstretched hand.
Under the classification of "Spirit Tricks" come those tricks which closely resemble so-called psychic phenomena. These tricks should be presented only for entertainment, to demonstrate an interesting phase of modern magic. Tricks of this type are very popular nowadays, and are wellsuited to the impromptu performer, because they are supposed to be performed in the midst of a circle, or in a private home. Therefore they are very useful to the amateur magician. The performance of such tricks and the fact that people can be mystified by them has no bearing upon the subject of psychic phenomena. That is a subject which must be carefully investigated by trained observers, and a detailed discussion of such matters is beyond the scope of this volume.

props: 一块与石板同色的黑色硬纸板 flap
effect_cn: 两块石板分别展示后叠在一起，再分开时，每块石板上都出现了一段信息。
method_cn: 两块石板上事先各写好一段信息，其中一块信息朝下放，另一块用黑色硬纸板做的 flap 盖住。
先展示盖着 flap 的那块，看上去是空白的，把它 flap 朝上放好。
把第二块石板叠上去，两块一起翻转过来。
拿走第一块、让它信息朝下放；flap 恰好盖住第二块上的信息，两面展出都看不出。
把第二块放到桌上，flap 自然落在桌上；再迅速把两块石板合在一起，让信息面朝内。
请人拿住石板，再分开时，两块上各显示一段信息。
note_cn: flap 要刚好盖住字迹、颜色与石板一致，落下时别让观众看见。
text_en:
Two slates are shown, one at a time, and are placed together. A message appears on each slate. A cardboard flap is used, painted black to match the slates. A message is on each slate, but one slate is lying with the message down and the other is covered with the flap. The magician shows the covered slate, and lays it flap side up. He sets the second slate upon it and turns them both over. Then he removes the first slate and lays it with the message down. The
now covers the message on the second slate, which may be flap shown on both sides. The second slate is laid on a table and the flap falls there. Then the two slates are quickly placed together, messages coming between. Someone holds them and when the they are taken apart, a message is seen on each slate.

props: 两块微型石板（约 2×1 英寸，硬纸板制）
effect_cn: 两块巴掌大的小石板两面都空白，被橡皮筋一捆；解开后其中一块上却出现了字迹，而且石板可以随便检查。
method_cn: 用几层彩色硬纸板做两块小石板（约 2×1 英寸），其中一块事先写好字迹，再用一块黑色硬纸板 flap 盖住。
先拿没有准备的那块，正反两面都展示。
再拿准备好的那块，flap 朝下放在左手掌上。
右手把它拿起来，叠到另一块石板上；这个动作把小小的 flap 留在左掌里。
左手立刻伸进口袋取橡皮筋，把两块石板捆住，flap 就悄悄留在了口袋里；也可用手帕擦拭石板时把 flap 带走。
note_cn: flap 要剪得和石板一样大，夹在手里时不能露出边。
text_en:
This an excellent effect that can be shown anywhere— a great advantage for a trick of this type. Two miniature slates are used. They are about two inches long by an inch across. They are shown blank on both sides; then they are placed together and encircled by a rubber band. When the slates are opened, writing is seen on one of them. After the message has appeared the slates stand a close examination. These slates can be made easily from cardboard, using several thicknesses of colored cardboard for the borders. But besides the slates, a "flap" is required, as in the case of the standard spirit slate trick. The flap is a loose piece of black cardboard which covers the message written on one of the slates, and makes the slate appear blank. With these miniature slates, anyone can dispose of the cardboard flap without difficulty. The unprepared slate is shown on both sides. Then the prepared slate is shown and is laid on the hand with the flap side down. The right hand picks it up and left places upon the unprepared slate. This action leaves the tiny flap behind in the left hand. The left hand immediately goes to the pocket and brings forth a rubber band to gird the slates. Thus the flap is secretly left in the pocket. Another system is to wipe off the slates with a handkerchief, taking the tiny flap away with the handkerchief. The flap simply drops in the cloth where it is easily concealed. The slates are not necessarily limited to the size mentioned;
they may be between three and four inches long and from two to three wide. Very neat slates may be made from black fibre, with red fibre borders. Standard slates are not, of course, made in so small a size.

effect_cn: 一块石板两面都示为空白，装进纸袋再取出时，石板上却出现了字迹，纸袋揉成一团扔掉也不露破绽。
method_cn: 事先在石板的一面写好字迹，用一张不透明的黑色薄纸盖住。
把石板两面都展示给观众，薄纸贴着有字迹的那一面。
用一点蜡或肥皂把薄纸粘住，别用太多，否则不好脱落。
把石板放进纸袋，手指顺势让薄纸脱落，留在袋底。
取出石板，字迹已经出现；把纸袋揉成一团扔掉，薄纸就藏在里面；也可用复写纸代替黑薄纸。
note_cn: 展示时薄纸要粘牢不露边，入袋后必须让它干净利落地脱落。
text_en: In this method, a message is obtained on a single slate, of fairly large size. It is shown blank on both sides and is placed in a paper bag. When it is removed, the message is on it; and the bag is crumpled and thrown away. A flap is used; but it is made of a sheet of black tissue paper, which is not transparent. A message is written on one side of the slate, and it is covered with the tissue paper flap. Both sides of the slate may then be shown; when the slate is put in the bag, the tissue paper falls off. When the slate is removed, there is the message, and the bag is easily rolled up and thrown away carrying the paper "flap". Care must be taken to keep the paper covering on the slate while the slate is being shown. A few dabs of wax or soap will help this; but too much adhesive should not be used, otherwise the paper cannot be pushed off easily. The fingers can help to remove the paper when the slate goes in the bag. Carbon paper makes an excellent substitute for black tissue.

effect_cn: 魔术师把一块布举在铃铛前面，铃铛竟自己响了起来，布后却什么也看不见。
method_cn: 铃铛柄上事先钻一个小孔，把一段黑线穿过去。
把黑线的两端松松地系在手帕的两个角上。
用手帕举在铃铛前，拉紧手帕的上缘，线便把铃铛提起来。
轻轻抖动手帕，被吊起的铃铛便叮当作响。
收手帕时把线从铃铛上褪下来，让线随手帕离开，铃铛便可交给观众检查。
note_cn: 线要细、系得松，收手帕时顺势解脱；也可在铃柄上做个小钩来挂线。
text_en:
The magician shows a small bell with a handle. He holds a cloth in front of the bell, and the bell mysteriously rings. The bell has a hole in the handle, through which runs a piece of black thread. The ends of the thread are attached to corners of the handkerchief. When the handkerchief is held in front of the bell, and the upper edge of the cloth is drawn taut, the bell will
be raised, and will begin to ring, when the magician shakes the cloth slighdy. The ends of the thread should be but loosely tied to the handkerchief so that when the magician withdraws the cloth he can detach the thread and let it run free of the bell. Another method is to have a tiny hook or projection on the bell handle. The thread engages this when the handkerchief is placed in position, and the bell is easily released later on.

effect_cn: 布后面铃铛自己响、桌上的小物件也像被无形的手掀翻抛起；魔术师自始至终只举着一块布。
method_cn: 在布的上右角别一根弯别针。
魔术师站在桌子左侧，把要用的物件摆在桌上。
右手举布挡在物件前面，左手展开，把布翻转展示另一面。
翻布的同时把布角上的别针挂到外套左肩上，左手仍拉着布，布面保持绷平。
右手腾出来，在布后敲响铃铛、掀翻或抛起桌上的物件。
右手迅速回到布角取回别针，再双手举布展示，前面的观众看不出右手曾离开。
note_cn: 挂针、取针要一气呵成，布要一直拉紧，动作一慢就会被看见。
text_en: This is another method of making bells ring behind a cloth; but besides the bell, articles are upset or tossed in the air by an unseen force. The trick must be worked quickly, as will be evident from the explanation. On the upper right corner of the cloth, there is a bent pin. The magician stands to the left of the table upon which the articles are placed. He stretches out his right hand holding the cloth before the objects. Then he shows the other side of the cloth by extending his left hand and bringing his right hand in against his left shoulder. This allows him to quickly hook the corner of the cloth on the left shoulder of his coat. The cloth remains taut because of the extended left hand; and the right hand is free to manipulate the objects behind the cloth. Then the right hand comes back to its corner, detaches the hook, and the cloth is shown held in both hands, as at the outset. The temporary release of the right hand cannot be observed from in front.

props: 几张写着不同名字的卡片
effect_cn: 观众从布袋里随意抽出一张写着人名的卡片，上面的名字却正是魔术师事先封在信封里的那一个。
method_cn: 用布缝一只袋子，中间加一道隔层，把它分成两个格子。
在一个格子里放几张写着同一个名字的卡片，另一个格子空着。
当众把写着各种名字的卡片从明格放进去，撑开袋口时别露出暗格。
把袋口转到暗格朝外，再请观众伸手进去抽一张。
抽出来的必然是那张写着你想要名字的卡片；随后拆开信封展示预言。
note_cn: 撑袋与转袋的动作要自然，不能让观众看到两个格子。
text_en:
In having messages appear upon slates, the magician must often decide upon something to write. For example, he can have
the audience choose the name of a great man, and then the name appears upon a slate. Or he can simply write something and seal it in an envelope; then he lets people select one of several cards with different names written thereon, and the chosen card will bear the name that the magician has written on the card in the envelope. But how is the proper card chosen? That is done by means of a small bag, in which the magician drops cards bearing different names. The bag is easily made at home. It is like two bags sewn together or better, an ordinary cloth bag with a cloth partition in the center. In one side are several cards all bearing the same name. When the magician holds the bag open, he spreads it so the secret side is not disclosed. The varying cards are dropped in, and the magician reopens the bag so that the secret pocket is now in view, and when anyone takes a card it must necessarily bear the desired name.

effect_cn: 观众把卡片随便插进书里决定了一页，翻开后读出第一行；信封里的卡片上写的正是这一行话。
method_cn: 先挑定书中某一页，把该页第一行抄在一张卡片上，封进信封。
把另一张卡片插进那一页，夹得露出一角，拿书时用手掌遮住。
请观众从书的另一端把卡片插进去，看起来是在随机选页。
趁把信封递给别人的时候，把书翻转过来，让自己卡片露出的一端朝上，再翻到那一页。
翻开书时暗中把观众插的卡片抽走，再请大家读出第一行。
note_cn: 书要封面朴素、不能太厚，翻书时手掌始终遮住露角的卡片。
text_en:
The magician brings out a book, and asks a person to insert a card anywhere he chooses, in the book, thus determining a certain page. sealed envelope is handed to a spectator and then the book is opened at the indicated page. A person is told to read the first line. The envelope is opened and inside is a card bearing the very words that the person has read! Method: The book used must have a plain cover. The magician chooses a page and writes its first line on a card which he seals in an envelope. Then he inserts a card at that particular page of the book, but when he carries the book, his hand hides the projecting card. spectator thrusts a card in at the opposite end of the book. While he is handing the envelope to a person, the magician calmly turns over the book, revealing the other end, with his own card
and he opens the book at the right page. The magician, of course, secretly removes the spectator's card during the opening of the book.

effect_cn: 大家围坐桌旁、双手轻放在桌面上，桌子竟像被无形力量托起，离开地面好几英尺。
method_cn: 用一张轻便的桌子，请几个人围坐四周，双手轻放在桌面上。
身体略向前压桌，同时把一只脚伸到一条桌腿下面。
一只手按在那条桌腿正上方的桌面上，与脚下的桌腿形成一个「夹子」。
悄悄抬起脚尖，桌子便被夹起来，看上去像自己升高。
把桌子往外一推，它就落回地面。
note_cn: 桌子越轻越好，手和脚要同步用力，抬升时身体不要后仰。
text_en: This is a simple method whereby a table may apparently be lifted several feet in the air. A light table must be used. People sit around the table and rest their hands lighdy upon it. The magician presses forward on the table and inserts his foot beneath one leg. He presses with one hand directly over the leg, thus forming a clamp. When he raises his toe, the table will rise mysteriously. When the magician pushes it away from him, it will fall. The foot and the hand act as a sort of clamp that holds the table firmly.

props: 一张轻便的桌子（桌面钉一枚小图钉）
effect_cn: 魔术师单手按在桌面上，抬手时整张桌子跟着被提起好几英尺；即便桌面盖着手帕，桌子照样被吸起来。
method_cn: 桌面事先钉一枚小图钉；魔术师戴一枚带小凹槽的戒指，普通戒指也不引人怀疑。
把手掌按在桌上，让戒指的凹槽卡进图钉头。
抬手，桌子就被提离地面，可以升到好几英尺高。
盖上丝巾再试一次，戒指隔着丝巾仍能卡住图钉，桌子照样升起。
结束时用手掌的压力把图钉撬起，让丝巾盖住手；取丝巾时连戒指带图钉一起带走，不留痕迹。
note_cn: 图钉头与戒指凹槽要刚好吻合，抬桌时手掌要找好受力点。
text_en:
The magician places his hand upon a light table, and when he lifts his hand, up comes the table. It may be raised to a height of several feet. Then he places a handkerchief over the table; and puts his hand on it, but again the table comes up, although the presence of the silk handkerchief would seem to make any contact impossible. Method: There is a small tack on the top of the table. The magician wears a ring, which has a small slot in it.* The hand is placed on the table and the ring engages the tack. Lifting the table is then an easy matter. When the silk handkerchief is placed upon the table, it makes no difference. The ring engages the tack through the silk. At the finish, the magician pries out the tack with pressure of his hand, and lets the hand- * The ring may be a plain one, painted a flesh-color. An ordinary finger-ring, however, does not appear suspicious.
kerchief fall over his hand. In removing the handkerchief he takes the ring also, so no trace remains.

props: 一张报纸（一面预先反写字迹）
effect_cn: 魔术师把一块空白石板用报纸包起来，打开报纸时，石板上已经出现了信息。
method_cn: 事先在报纸的一面用复写的方法反着写好消息，写有字迹的一面始终朝下藏着。
当众展示空白石板，把报纸包在石板外面。
包的时候让有字迹的一面贴住石板，用力压一压。
压印之后，字迹就转印到石板上。
打开报纸，石板上已出现信息。
note_cn: 反写的字迹要预先压印清楚，包裹时用力要均匀。
text_en: The magician shows a blank slate and wraps it in a piece of newspaper. When the paper is opened, there is a message on the slate. Method: The message is written in reverse on one side of the sheet of paper. That side is kept out of sight. When the paper is wrapped over the slate, the magician presses it against the slate, and thus transposes the message to the slate.

props: 一只特制火柴盒（底部与抽屉一端各开小口）
effect_cn: 观众写好问题折起来放进火柴盒，魔术师把火柴盒贴在额头上，竟慢慢说出了纸上那个问题的答案。
method_cn: 事先在火柴盒底部和抽屉的同一端各开一个小口。
请观众写好问题、折好，从一个稍稍拉开的盒口丢进去。
合上盒子的瞬间，折纸便从底部的口子落进魔术师手里。
他坐到桌旁，一只手垂在桌下打开折纸偷看，另一只手把火柴盒举在额前。
答完问题后把纸折好，找机会塞回盒里。
note_cn: 开盒、合盒的动作要自然，纸要折得够小，才能顺利从洞里落下。
text_en: A person is invited to write a question, fold it, and put it in a match-box, which the magician lays on the table. He seats himself at the table, holds the match-box to his head, and slowly gives an answer to the written question. Method: The magician obtains possession of the question bj using a special match-box. A hole is cut in the bottom of the box and in the drawer, at one end. The box is opened slightly at the other end, and the question is dropped in. When the box is closed the question falls through the bottom into the magician's hand. He sits at the table, and with one hand beneath the table, opens the folded paper and reads it while he is holding the box to his forehead. Then he folds the paper again, and after he has answered the question, he finds an opportunity to push it back into the box.

effect_cn: 魔术师坐在两人中间，两手分别被两人握住；灯一灭，号角、铃铛、敲击声接连响起，灯亮时一切如旧。
method_cn: 请两位观众分坐两侧：一人抓住魔术师的右腕，他用左手抓住另一人的手腕。
关灯的一瞬间，他把两手迅速靠近，左手短暂松开左边那人的手腕，随即改用右手抓住它。
这样他的左手就空出来了。
左手在黑暗中吹号角、摇铃、敲出响声，声音全来自面前的桌上。
亮灯前再把左手换回去抓腕、右手接回右腕，姿势与开始时一模一样。
note_cn: 换手必须在黑暗最初几秒完成，抓腕的位置要事先摸准。
text_en:
The magician seats himself between two persons. He lets one person grip him by the right wrist, while with his left hand he
holds the wrist of the person on his left. Then he has the lights turned out. Immediately a horn is blown, a bell is rung, and raps are heard. The bell and horn are in front of the magician, but how can he operate them? Then the lights are turned on, and everything is seen as before. Method: Just as the lights are turned off, the magician draws his hands close together, and lets go of the person on the left for an instant, only to seize his wrist again. This time, however, he uses his right hand to take the person's wrist, leaving his left hand free to make the manifestations. Just before the lights are turned on he lets go with his right hand and grips the person's wrist with his left.

props: 一只金属铜锣或玻璃碗
effect_cn: 魔术师用手帕拎着一面铜锣，向「灵体」提问时，锣会按约定自己响一声或两声作答。
method_cn: 用手帕结成一个套，把铜锣或玻璃碗拎在手里。
手心里暗藏几粒小铅弹。
与观众约定：响一声表示「否」，响两声表示「是」。
每次想让锣响，就让一粒铅弹从手里落下，打在锣面上。
铅弹很小，观众看不见，只听见锣声作答。
note_cn: 铅弹要小而沉，落点选在锣面正中，声音才清脆可信。
text_en: The magician holds a metal gong in his hand, using a looped handkerchief as a handle by which to hold it; or he can use a glass bowl, with a handkerchief looped around the base. In reply to questions, the gong rings mysteriously once means "no"; twice means "yes". The magician has a quantity of small shot in his hand. Each time he wishes to make the gong ring, he lets one ball of shot fall from his hand. The shot is not seen, but it makes the gong ring.

props: 一本带索引标签的电话簿
可以挡在身后的屏风或门
effect_cn: 魔术师蒙着眼坐在屋角，观众随口报出人名，他略一凝神，就能慢慢说出对方的电话号码。
method_cn: 魔术师蒙上眼睛坐在屋角，助手坐在他身后有遮挡的位置。
助手带一本带索引标签的电话簿，随时准备查号。
观众报出一个自己熟悉的人名，全场都听得见。
助手立刻查出号码，低声告诉魔术师。
魔术师装作凝神，慢慢而笃定地把号码报出来。
note_cn: 助手翻书、耳语都不能被观众看见或听见，身后一定要有遮挡。
text_en:
The magician sits in a corner of the room, and blindfolds himself. Then he asks people to call out names of persons whose telephone numbers they know. As each name is called, the magician concentrates and slowly gives the telephone number. An assistant is used. The magician sits in front of a door or a screen, and the assistant is behind him with a phone book, with index tabs so that he can quickly find numbers as the names are
called. While the magician is "concentrating", the assistant looks up the number of a name that is called and whispers it to the magician who names it slowly and impressively.

effect_cn: 魔术师离场时观众写好问题折起；他回来后逐一触碰额头，翻开书念几行，就能把写下的问题一五一十答出来。
method_cn: 离场前请大家写好问题、折好，并安排一两位同伙混在观众中。
同伙假装写问题，实际留意别人写的内容和议论，把人名与问题记在自己纸上。
魔术师回到人群中，同伙找机会把纸片塞进他的口袋，或夹进他要用的书里。
魔术师逐个触碰额头，回到座位翻开书，凭着书页里的信息回答。
必要时用同伙「写的」问题打圆场，说自己答的正是它。
note_cn: 同伙要自然融入观众，传递纸片的时机不能让第三人看见。
text_en: The magician tells people that they can write questions and fold them up, while he is out of the room. Then he comes into the room and touches each person's forehead. This, he says, gives him their thoughts. He sits down, opens a book, and reads a few lines. Then he answers one of the questions. He repeats this, first reading and then answering questions until he has answered practically all of the written questions. Method: The magician has a confederate or two, if many people are present. The confederate pretends to write questions, but instead he watches what other people are writing, or listens to the other people talking over questions, and on his paper he writes the names of people and the questions they are asking. When the magician enters and walks among the people, the confederate secretly drops the information in the magician's pocket; or he can place it in the pages of the book the magician intends to use. When the magician opens the book he gains the necessary information. Of course he can also answer an imaginary question which the confederate will claim to be the one he wrote.

props: 硬币、戒指、别针等小物件
effect_cn: 助手蒙眼坐在房间另一头，魔术师逐一触碰桌上的小物件，助手便逐件说出他碰的是什么。
method_cn: 助手蒙眼坐在房间对面，两人事先约定一套顺序暗号。
请观众准备硬币、戒指、别针、手表等小物件摆在桌上。
魔术师按记住的顺序触碰物件，每碰一件就说「说出这个」。
助手按暗号顺序报出名称；若物件顺序有变，魔术师用「对了」表示重复、用「对」表示跳过下一件。
靠这套重复、跳过的暗号随时校正，观众看来就像真在读心。
note_cn: 暗号要在表演前练熟，两人要能自然地用一句话调整顺序。
text_en:
In this trick the magician employs a "medium" who is seated across the room, and is blindfolded. The magician states that he can send thoughts of various objects to the medium by picturing them. He asks persons to have the objects ready, such as coins, rings, pins, etc. Then he walks around touching the various objects, and as he touches each one, the medium names it.
pin, watch, shoe, glasses, book, match-box, etc. The magician touches these in the memorized order, so that as he says "Name this", the medium knows what to say. Various objects, such as books and match-boxes can be laying around where the magician can hold them up if they are not offered to him. If he wishes, the magician can say: "That's right", after the medium names an object such as a watch. That means "repeat", and the magician immediately holds up another watch. If he simply says "Right", the medium knows that he is going to eliminate the next object in the prearranged order. Thus if he touches a person's shoe, and the medium names it, the magician, if he sees no eyeglasses, will say "Right". So the next object he touches will be a book. The two persons who work the trick can best arrange their own system of rotation.

effect_cn: 灯一灭，被握着手的那位观众忽然感觉铁环落到自己手臂上；灯亮时铁环真的套在他腕上。
method_cn: 桌面上放一只大号手镯大小的金属环，请一位观众坐在旁边。
一只手关灯的同时，另一只手抓起铁环，迅速套到自己手腕上。
随即在黑暗里握住观众的手，说铁环马上会跳到对方手臂上。
过一会儿把手一倾，让铁环从自己手腕滑过两手，落到观众的手臂上。
开灯展示：铁环确确实实在观众的手臂上。
note_cn: 关灯后动作要快，滑环时两手要贴紧，别让环掉在地上。
text_en: A metal ring is laid upon the table. It is about the size of a large bracelet. The magician turns out the light with one hand and immediately grasps the person's hand with his other hand. Then he states that in a few seconds the ring will mysteriously leap on to the person's arm, although that would seem impossible, as the magician is holding the person's hand. Suddenly the person feels the ring. The magician turns on the light and there is the ring, on the person's arm! Method: As soon as he turns ofif the light the magician seizes the ring with his free hand and lets it slide on to his wrist. Then he seizes the person's hand, and a little while later he tilts his hand so that the ring slides off his wrist on to the person's arm, passing over both hands.

effect_cn: 魔术师把观众的问题慢慢写在石板上又擦掉，几分钟后把石板翻过来，上面竟写好了问题的答案。
method_cn: 先在石板上写几个字再擦掉，让观众看到石板是干净的。
请观众提一个问题；为了「看清」问题，他把问题一字一句慢慢写在石板上。
其实他写的是早已想好的答案，只是嘴上念着问题。
然后假装把字迹全部擦掉，把石板字面朝下放好，粉笔搁在旁边。
过几分钟翻过石板，答案赫然在目。
note_cn: 关键在擦的时候只擦掉部分、留下完整答案，表演要非常镇定。
text_en: This method of slate writing requires nerve; but when properly performed it is very mystifying. The magician writes a few words on a slate and then rubs them off. He asks for a question, and in order to visualize it, he writes it slowly word for word on the slate. Then he rubs it ofif again, and lays the slate on the table, with the chalk upon it. A few minutes later he turns over the slate and there is the answer to the question written on it! Method: When the magician slowly writes the question, he really writes a suitable answer, and only pretends to rub away the writing. He lays the slate with the writing side down, and of course when it is turned over the answer is found on it!

effect_cn: 两块石板用带子横向捆住，外面依次标上一、二、三、四；解开带子，石板中间出现了事先写好的信息。
method_cn: 事先在上方石板的正面沿长边用尖粉笔写好消息，字要小到能被捆石的带子完全盖住。
两块石板用带子交叉捆好，外面分别标上 1 和 2。
解开带子，把两块石板的内面展示并标上 3 和 4。
再把标 2 的那块朝上放，把另一块叠上去，让 1 贴着 2、3 和 4 朝外，然后用带子重新捆紧。
解开带子、取走带子后，被盖住的信息便显露出来。
note_cn: 字迹必须比带子窄、捆带时要完全压住，也可用两块硬纸板以墨水写消息。
text_en:
Two slates are bound with a piece of tape which runs crosswise about them. The surface of one slate is marked with a figure i; then the slates are turned over and the other is marked with a figure 2. The slates are untied, and the inner surfaces are shown, one being marked 3 and the other 4. Then the slates are tied together with the tape. When they are untied, a message is found between them, written on one of the slates. The message, or written word, is on the slate at the beginning. It is on the side of the upper slate marked 1. It is written lengthwise along the slate with a sharp chalk or slate pencil, and the letters are just small enough to be concealed by the ribbon which is around the slates. When the tied slates are shown and the outer surfaces are marked 1 and 2, no one supposes that the ribbon hides anything. When the slates are unbound, the side marked 1 is laid down on
the side 2 being up. Thus side 2 is seen; that slate is the table, turned over and the inner sides are marked 3 and 4. Then one laid with side 2 up; and the other slate is placed upon it, slate is so that side 1 comes over side 2, while 3 and 4 become the outsides of the slates. The slates are tied up in the tape, which is later removed and message found. The letters of the message appear much the is higher than the width of the ribbon. The may be performed with two slabs of cardboard, the trick message appearing in ink.

props: 一块黑色硬纸板或硅酸盐 flap
effect_cn: 三块石板正反两面都展示过，其中一块被淘汰放在一旁；剩下的两块合上再分开，中间竟出现了一段信息。
method_cn: 准备三块石板，其中一块的内面事先写好信息，并用一块与石板同色、比框略小的黑色硬纸板 flap 盖住。
当众把三块石板的正反两面都展示，请观众选一块。
若选中的不是藏 flap 的那块，就把选中的石板夹到左腋下；若正好选中 flap 那块，就说「我用这块，另外两块里你选哪块？」，让一块普通石板被夹到腋下。
把 flap 石板与普通石板合在一起、翻转一次，flap 便落到普通石板上。
把石板放到桌上，翻开上面那块，露出信息；flap 此时盖在空白石板上。
顺势把有信息的石板推给观众，再拿空白石板、从腋下取出第三块，把第三块盖到带 flap 的石板上翻一次，flap 便转到第三块上，随后把它夹回腋下。
最后把那块「干净」的石板交给观众检查，带着藏有 flap 的第三块自然收场。
note_cn: flap 要正好盖住信息、翻动时不能脱出，全程动作要流畅别停顿。
text_en:
This a stock item among magicians, but it is usually performed with two slates. The addition of the third slate is a great improvement. The magician shows both sides of three slates. Then he asks that one slate be chosen. This slate he discards, tucking it under arm. He numbers the other slates 1 and 2, and places his left them together with the numbers on the outside. When the slates taken apart, a message appears on the inner surface of one are The slate given for examination, and the other slate is slate. is also handed for inspection. Beside the slates, a black flap is used, made of silicate or of cardboard. It lies on one of the slates, and covers the message, which written previously. The flap is just the size of the slate minus the frame, so it hides the message perfectly. When the magician shows the three slates on both sides, he asks that one be selected. If it is not the flap slate, he puts the chosen slate under his left arm saying that that slate will be eliminated. If, however, the flap slate is chosen, he says: "I will use this slate, and one of the others. Which of the other two slates do you choose?"
Thus one of the two odd slates finds its way under the left arm. The flap slate and the unprepared slate are placed together and they are turned over, which lets the flap fall on the unprepared slate. The slates are laid on the table, and the upper slate is turned over, showing the message. The flap lies on the blank slate. Without hesitation, the magician pushes forward the slate with the message. Then he picks up the blank slate with his left hand, and with his right hand, takes the third slate from under his left arm. He sets the third slate on the slate that has the flap, and turns the two slates over, thus transferring the flap to the odd third slate, which is immediately replaced under the left arm. Then the second slate, rid of the flap, is laid on the table for inspection. "Getting rid of the flap" is considered the most difficult part of the slate trick. This method makes it very easy, and enables the magician to walk away with the flap on the innocent third slate leaving the two numbered slates in the possession of the audience.

effect_cn: 观众心里想好一位名人的「灵体名字」，再把它混进一列人名中写下；魔术师只看了看，就把他想的那一个名字挑了出来。
method_cn: 请观众想一个名人的名字，作为「灵体名字」。
请他在纸上写八到十个名字，把想好的名字混在其中。
动笔前让他心里先定好要写在这列名字的哪个位置。
他写的时候你站在旁边观察：写其他名字时他会停顿、回想。
写到预定位置时他一气呵成、毫不迟疑，那一个就是他想的名字；随后你握住他的手，直接点出它。
note_cn: 关键在耐心观察运笔的迟疑与流畅，别让人发现你在看笔迹。
text_en:
This is a trick that requires careful observation. After it has been tried a few times, it seldom fails to work. Tell a person to think of a spirit name of some celebrity, if he wishes. Then tell him that he is to write down a list of names on a sheet of paper, and somewhere in the list he must place the name upon which he is concentrating. Eight or ten names will be enough. Before beginning, he should determine mentally at what number he will write the chosen name. The person writes down the names, while you are looking on. When he has finished, you hold his hand and look at the list. Then you immediately pick out the spirit name of which he was thinking. Method: While the person is writing down the names, he will
when he comes to the point where he has intended to write the chosen name, he will write it without hesitation. Thus you can tell which name is the chosen one.

effect_cn: 观众闭着眼，感觉魔术师两根食指按在眼皮上；就在这时，一只看不见的手抚过他的头发、敲了敲他的额头，而魔术师的手分明都还在他眼皮上。
method_cn: 请观众坐好，把两根食指伸到他眼前，让他闭上眼。
把两根手指的指尖分别按在他的两片眼皮上，问他是否感觉到两根手指。
得到肯定回答后，说「我两手都占着，只好请一只灵手来帮忙」。
趁他闭眼，其实是用一只手的食指和中指分别按在两侧眼皮上，另一只手完全空着。
空着的手去抚头发、敲额头，做出「灵手」的触碰。
收手时让两根食指同时停在眼皮上，观众睁眼看到的仍是「两只手都用着」。
note_cn: 必须让观众始终感到两片眼皮上各有一根手指，换手那一瞬要非常轻。
text_en: The magician holds both his forefingers in front of a person's eyes, and tells the person to close his eyelids. Then the tips of the forefingers are set against the eyelids. "Can you feel both of my forefingers?" asks the magician. "Yes," is the reply. "Then," says the magician, "since both of my hands are occupied, I will call upon a spirit hand to aid me." At this instant an unknown hand brushes the person's hair, and taps his forehead. The magician immediately removes his hands and the spectator may open his eyes. But no one else is nearby. There seems to be no explanation of the spirit touch. This trick is done very artfully. As soon as the person shuts his eyes, the magician extends the first two fingers of one hand, spreads them and places one against each of the person's eyelids. This leaves the magician's other hand free to act as the spirit hand. When the fingers are removed from the eyelids, both hands are held with forefingers extended.

effect_cn: 送信者背对全场坐在角落，接收者蒙着眼把手指按在他太阳穴上，片刻之后就说出了他被告知的数字。
method_cn: 送信者在接收者离场时被告知一个数字。
送信者坐到角落，背对众人；接收者蒙眼进场。
接收者把两根食指的指尖轻轻按在送信者的太阳穴上。
送信者咬紧下颚，太阳穴便微微鼓动，一下一下地压在指尖上。
按停顿与次数传递每一位数字：例如 153 就是 1 下、停顿、5 下、停顿、3 下；十下代表 0。
接收者数清后报出数字。
note_cn: 下颚用力要小而匀、停顿要清楚，两人必须事先练熟节奏。
text_en:
This is an interesting experiment performed by two people. One acts as the transmitter of thoughts. He is told a number, while the receiving person is out of the room. Then the transmitter is seated in a corner, with his back towards the room. The receiver is brought in, blindfolded. He is allowed to place the tips of his forefingers upon the temples of the transmitter. few moments later the receiver announces the number!
There is no mind reading to it. The transmitter signals to the receiver by a very artful system. By simply tightening his lower jaw, the transmitter causes his temples to press slightly against the receiver's forefingers. In this manner the receiver is informed of the number. Suppose the number was 153. The transmitter would press his jaw once, signifying one; then after a slight interval, he would make five presses; then another interval, and three presses. Thus any number of moderate length can be "transmitted" quickly and undetectably. Ten presses signify zero.

effect_cn: 观众把写有名字的纸条装进信封并封口；魔术师把信封贴到额头上，立刻说出了里面的名字。
method_cn: 事先在信封正面切出一个隐蔽的 flap，切口要平整、不易看出。
把切口那一面朝下，请观众把写好名字的纸条字面朝下装进信封。
封好信封，把它举到额头前。
举的同时用大拇指轻轻掀起 flap，看一眼纸条上的名字。
放下信封，说出名字，并把封好的信封交给观众检查。
note_cn: 切口要平整、别让 flap 翘起；掀起只在抬手到额头的一瞬间完成。
text_en: A name is written on a slip of paper, which is put, written side down, into an envelope. The envelope is sealed. Holding the envelope to his forehead the magician instantly names the written name. Method: A flap is cut in the face of the envelope. This side of the envelope is down, so the cut is not seen. When the message is inside, the magician raises the envelope to his forehead. At the same time his thumb lifts up the flap and he sees the written name.

effect_cn: 观众在一叠信封里写好问题并封好；魔术师把信封贴到额头，竟能透过信封读出里面的名字和信息。
method_cn: 把几只信封粘成一叠，在中间挖出能容纳小铁盒的空腔。
铁盒里放一块浸满酒精的海绵，再用一只完整信封封住这叠道具的底部，使海绵不外露。
在道具叠上面摆一些真信封，连同纸条一起发给观众写名字。
收回时让写好字的纸条字面朝下、直接落在酒精海绵的正上方，再把信封压紧。
抽出最下面的问题信封贴到额头，酒精让纸透光，就能读出里面的字迹。
依次读出余下的问题，读完把信封斜靠在灯旁，酒精很快挥发、信封恢复不透明。
note_cn: 海绵湿度要够但不能渗湿信封，读完及时晾干，信封才能恢复原样。
text_en:
This is the most effective of all sealed envelope readings. Take a few envelopes and glue them together. Cut out a space in the center of the envelopes large enough to hold a small tobacco tin. The tin contains a sponge, saturated with alcohol. A number of genuine envelopes are places upon the dummy stack, and, of course the bottom envelope of the dummy pile is complete. Thus the hidden sponge cannot be seen. A number of envelopes are given out, with slips of paper. Names are written on these slips which must be inserted, writing
down, the envelopes. The magician gathers up the envelopes, and adds them to those he still has, so that the envelopes contain, questions come directly on top of the alcohol sponge. inothe The magician then draws out the lowermost of the question envelopes and holds it to his forehead. The alcohol renders il and the magician can read the name or message that is transparent This repeated with all the remaining questions The within. is envelopes \hould be laid on the table, leaning against a lamp, which will quickly dry the alcohol, and make the envelopes opaque once more.

effect_cn: 魔术师被绳子牢牢绑在椅子上、躲到屏风后面，众人离开后半分钟里铃铛大作、小东西不断飞过屏风；再去看时，他仍然被绑得和原来一样紧。
method_cn: 把魔术师的手腕用绳子绑好，交叉绳端并固定在椅子的横档上，请大家确认绑得很牢。
众人退到屏风外；魔术师从椅子上往下滑，先把一只手臂从头顶绕出来。
另一只手臂随即从绳子下面滑出，这样他就获得足够的活动空间。
伸手摇铃，把小物品一件件抛过屏风。
迅速把手臂穿回原来的绳套，再从椅子上下滑复原，让绳结看起来纹丝未动。
半分钟后请大家回来查看：绳索依旧绑得跟原来一样，只能判定是「看不见的力量」摇响了铃铛。
note_cn: 绳结的松紧要事先量好，复原要快，绝不能让绳圈有被移动过的痕迹。
text_en: The magician seated in a chair behind a screen. His arms ropes are tied about his wrists, and the ends of the are crossed, cords are fastened to the chair rungs. As soon as everyone has left him alone, bells, placed beside the magician, begin to ring. Articles are tossed over the screen. But when the magician invites people back to see a half-minute later, before. He must be untied to be him, he is tied as securely as released. The magician does not escape from the ties at all, but he does himself sufficiently to ring the bells and throw things from release behind the screen. By sliding down in the chair, the magician can one arm over his head, and can then slip under the raise arm. Thus he partially free. After ringing the bells he other is back into the ropes just as he was before. As the ropes have slides not been tampered with, the inference is that some unseen force, and not the magician, rang the bells. The magician can also tie a ring on the string, as an additional (See "Ring Tied on String," Chapter XIX.) effect.

effect_cn: 魔术师脱下外套、右手插进马甲口袋，一只手臂不能动，却把搭在臂上的绳圈从身上完整取了下来。
method_cn: 脱下外套，把一长圈绳子搭在手臂上。
把右手插进右侧马甲口袋，整只手臂不再拿出来。
用左手抓住绳圈，从马甲右袖孔往里拉。
把绳圈从头顶套过去，再从左侧袖孔推出，让左臂穿进绳圈。
此时绳子绕在身体上、藏在马甲里面；左手从马甲下伸上去抓住绳子，往下拉，让绳子从脚下脱出。
note_cn: 右手一定要插马甲口袋而不是裤兜，否则绳子会缠成一团。
text_en: Take off your coat, and hang a long loop of string over your arm. Then put your right hand in your right vest pocket. The problem is to remove the string without taking the hand from the pocket. To do it, take hold of the loop with your left hand and pull it up through the right armhole of your vest. Slide the loop over your head, push it through the left armhole and put your left arm through it. The string will then be around your body, beneath your vest. Reach up under the vest with the left arm; get hold of the string and pull it down your body. Then step out of it. If some one else attempts the trick, he will probably get all tangled up, especially if he makes the common mistake of putting his right hand in his trousers pocket instead of in the vest pocket.

effect_cn: 细绳穿过一根吸管，吸管在中间被剪断、拉开，里面的细绳却完好无损。
method_cn: 事先把一小段吸管弯好，藏在右手手指之间。
把细绳穿进一根真吸管，并在中间弯折吸管。
右手靠上来，把那一小段接在吸管中间，捏住接缝，看上去像是一根完整的吸管。
用剪刀剪掉那段假吸管，同时双手一合，把真吸管从中间折断。
把两段吸管向两边抽走，亮出完好无损的细绳。
note_cn: 假吸管和真吸管的弯折角度要一致，接缝捏在手里别让人看出。
text_en:
A string is pushed through a drinking straw, and the straw is bent in the center. The magician cuts the center of the straw, and then draws the pieces away, showing the string as good as ever! Method: Have a tiny section of a straw bent and concealed between the fingers of the right hand. Insert the string in the genuine straw and bend the straw. Bring up your right hand and add the section, holding the join
appears to be the center of the straw. With scissors, cut off the fake section, and bring the hands together, to break the real straw. Draw the two sections apart, and reveal the string uncut.

effect_cn: 绳子穿过剪刀手柄系成长环，观众捏住绳结。魔术师声称不动绳结也能把剪刀取下，结果他翻起剪刀把绳子剪断了。
method_cn: 把绳子穿过剪刀的一个手柄，将绳子系成一个长环，请一位观众捏住绳结。
宣称不打开绳结，只靠摆弄剪刀就能让剪刀脱离绳子。
慢慢转动、翻弄剪刀，做出寻找巧劲的样子。
突然把剪刀翻过来，用刀刃把绳环剪断。
剪刀就这样从绳子上「取」了下来。
note_cn: 这是靠揭底出笑果的小戏法，动手前要说得一本正经，剪断后才显出幽默。
text_en: A string is run through one of the handles of a pair of scissors. The string is tied in a loop and the knot is held by a spectator. The magician states that he will remove the scissors from the string without untying the knot or without doing anything but manipulate the scissors. There is a catch to this one. The loop is long. The magician can manipulate the scissors, and he does it by turning up the scissors and cutting the string!

effect_cn: 冰块浮在杯中，谁都套不住它；魔术师把线放在冰上、撒一点盐，再轻轻一拉，冰块就被线提了出来。
method_cn: 在玻璃杯里倒水，放入一块冰，让它浮在水面。
把细线一端打一个松环，请观众试着套住冰块提起来，他们总会失败。
轮到你时，把线环浸湿，平放在冰块表面。
在冰上撒一小撮盐。
等几秒钟，冰面融化后又重新冻住，把线冻在里面。
捏住线的另一端轻轻提起，冰块便随线出杯。
note_cn: 盐要少，等冰面重新冻住再提线，急不得。
text_en: Float an ice cube in a glass of water, take a string and tie a loop in one end. Then invite people to snare the ice cube with the string and lift the cube from the glass. The more they try, the more they will fail, because looping the ice cube is just about impossible. But when your turn comes, you can lift the ice with the string by working it your own special way Simply let the wet loop rest on the ice cube. Sprinkle a little salt on the ice. The surface will melt rapidly, then freeze again with the string imbedded in it. Lift the string carefully by the free end and you can draw the ice cube out of the glass.

effect_cn: 绳子系在瓷杯把手上悬着杯子，魔术师把绳子从中段剪成两截，杯子却仍然吊在绳子上。
method_cn: 把长绳系在瓷杯把手上，让杯子悬空吊着。
宣称自己能把绳子从正中间剪断，而杯子依然不会掉。
请一位观众捏住绳子，让杯子自然垂着。
在绳子中段打一个结，把结拉紧收成一个环。
在环的中间剪一刀。
绳子确实断成两段，但断口两侧被结连在一起，杯子照样吊着。
note_cn: 结要拉紧成环，剪的正是环心，两段绳才断而不断。
text_en:
long string is tied to the handle of a china cup so that the cup can be dangled by the string. The magician states that he can
cut the string in the center, actually dividing it into two pieces, yet the string will still support the cup. This can be done while the cup is dangling from the string. This sounds impossible, so the magician does it. He lets someone else hold the string with the hanging cup. Then he takes the center of the string and ties a loop in it, pulling the knot quite tight. Next, the magician cuts the center of the loop and the trick is thereby accomplished. The string has actually been cut in two, but it still supports the cup, thanks to the helpful knot!

effect_cn: 绳环挂在右手拇指与食指上，看似缠得错综复杂，左手一拉，整根绳子竟毫无阻碍地被抽走。
method_cn: 左手拇指与食指横向张开，形成一个 V 形。
用左手把绳环挂到右手的拇指和食指上。
左手从 V 形中间伸进去，把横着的那股绳往下拉，右手拇指与食指上便各形成一个小环。
左手再把垂下的那个环（即原来横着的那股）从 V 形中拉上来。
右手拇指与食指指尖相触成圈，看起来把绳环全部套住了。
左手始终不放开长环，只需把它从右手拇指和食指上整体拉过去，整根绳子便脱离右手。
note_cn: 全程左手不能松环，右手指尖相触要自然，快慢配合才毫无破绽。
text_en: The magician hangs a loop of string over his right thumb and forefinger, places the tips of thumb and forefinger together, and suddenly draws the string completely clear with his left hand, though it appears to be intricately looped on the right. The necessary maneuvers are very simple, but extremely deceptive. Extend the left thumb and forefinger horizontally, keeping them spread to form a V. With the left hand hang the loop on the right thumb and forefinger. Now with the left hand, reach up into the V and pull the crossstring clear down, thus forming separate loops on the rightthumb and forefinger. With the left hand, draw the dangling loop (the original cross-string) up through the V. Then press the tips of the right thumb and forefinger together, forming a circle, which seems to snare the loops completely. But the left hand, never releasing the long loop, has only to draw it over the right thumb and forefinger. The entire string will be carried free of the right hand.

effect_cn: 方糖丢进水杯先沉到底，片刻之后却自己浮上水面，像被水推回来一样。
method_cn: 把方糖在火棉胶（collodion）液体里蘸一下，取出晾干，外表看不出变化。
杯子里倒水，把处理过的方糖丢进去。
糖会慢慢溶化，但火棉胶薄膜保持着方糖的外形。
糖溶掉后壳内变轻，糖壳便浮上水面。
note_cn: 火棉胶要涂满整个糖块，晾干后再用，壳一破就浮不起来。
text_en: This is an interesting experiment with a lump of sugar. The lump is dropped in a cup of liquid, and of course it sinks to the bottom. But, a few moments later, the sugar suddenly rises to the surface of the liquid and floats there! The lump of sugar is an ordinary cube of sugar, which has first been dipped in liquid collodion. When the lump is dry, it appears unchanged. When it is dropped into liquid, the sugar melts; but the collodion preserves the shape of the lump and up it comes to the top.

effect_cn: 别人怎么点都点不着的方糖，魔术师一划火柴，糖块便冒出蓝色的火苗。
method_cn: 先请观众用火柴去点方糖，糖只会被熏黑，烧不起来。
事先把方糖的一角在香烟灰或雪茄灰里悄悄蘸一下。
再用火柴点燃蘸过灰的那一角。
糖块便燃起细小的蓝色火焰。
note_cn: 灰要蘸在角上、动作要隐蔽，点燃时让火苗先接触蘸灰处。
text_en: Ask a person to set fire to a lump of sugar. He will be unable to do so. The flame of the match will merely blacken the sugar. But when you apply a match to a lump, the sugar burns with a tiny blue flame. Sugar contains alcohol, and it will burn provided the combustion is once started. To do this, secretly dip the corner of the lump into cigarette or cigar ashes; then apply the match, and the sugar will burn.

effect_cn: 魔术师从勺里含一口糖，一张嘴，糖竟化作一团干燥的糖云喷向空中。
method_cn: 把干燥的糖装进一个大胶囊，胶囊两端各扎几个小孔。
表演时用勺子取一口糖送进嘴里，胶囊混在糖中一起含入。
松散的白糖在口中溶化。
把胶囊夹在双唇之间，用力向胶囊吹气。
糖粉从孔中喷出，形成一团糖云。
note_cn: 胶囊要夹稳在唇间，吹气短促有力，糖云才散得开。
text_en:
This trick has been attributed to the Hindu fakirs. A mouthful of sugar is taken from a spoon, and suddenly it is blown
forth in a dry cloud. This is particularly effective when colored sugars are used, as two or three clouds may be blown. The dry sugar is contained in a large capsule, which has pinholes at the ends. It is taken into the mouth with the spoonful of sugar. The loose sugar dissolves, of course; but the capsule is held between the lips, and by blowing through it, the cloud of sugar is formed.

effect_cn: 观众在方糖上写一个字母，糖被丢进水里，片刻后同一字母却清楚印在观众自己的掌心上。
method_cn: 请观众在方糖上写一个字母或数字，写完让字迹朝下放着。
魔术师不看糖块，拿起它之前先把右手拇指肚悄悄沾湿，可借杯壁蹭一下。
拿糖时用拇指压住写字的那一面，字迹便沾到指尖。
把糖丢进装水的杯子。
让观众握拳，魔术师双手包住其手、把自己的拳头握拢，同时拇指压住对方掌心。
观众张开手，掌心就出现那个字母的印痕。
note_cn: 拇指微湿即可印上字迹，握拳时用力要轻而准，别留下水痕。
text_en: This is a very interesting problem in mystery. A person is requested to write an initial or a figure on a lump of sugar, and to lay the lump with the letter down. The magician takes the lump of sugar, and without looking at it, drops it in a glass of water. He tells the person to close his fist, then holds the glass of water above the spectator's clenched hand. After the sugar is partly dissolved, the magician tells the spectator to open his fist and there on the palm of the hand, is the imprint of the letter on the sugar, perfectly reproduced! Now for the secret, which is quite artful. While the spectator is writing the initial, the magician secretly moistens the ball of his right thumb; this can often be done by merely rubbing the thumb along the outside of the glass. Just a bit of dampness is required. In picking up the lump of sugar, the magician presses his thumb against the initial side; then he drops the sugar in the glass. The imprint of the letter remains on the magician's thumb. With both of his hands, the magician grasps the spectator's hand and closes it into a fist. In so doing, the magician's thumb presses against the person's palm, and thus leaves the imprint of the initial.

effect_cn: 四块方糖摆成方形，盖上双手后，糖块一块接一块地从一处挪到另一处，最后聚成一堆，又一块块散回四角。
method_cn: 桌上摆四块方糖 A、B、C、D 成方形，左手掌心暗藏一块备用方糖，用拇指根压住。
右手盖住 A，左手盖住 D；晃动手指后，右手把 A 偷藏在掌心，左手把糖留在 D 处。
抬起双手（不亮掌心），A 消失，D 处变成两块。
左手再盖 B，右手去 D；晃指后左手把 B 藏起，右手把 A 留在 D 处。
右手空手盖 C，左手盖住 D 处的三块；抬手时右手拿起 C，左手把第四块留在 D。
反向重复：左手盖住四块并藏起一块，右手在 C 处放下糖，再把糖依次送回 B、A 各角。
最后一块在抬右手前由左手丢进大腿或口袋，双手再亮出空空的手心。
note_cn: 每个动作都要紧接着上一个，抬双手时不亮掌心，观众就看不出糖在掌中。
text_en:
This is one of the finest of all impromptu tricks it is admirably suited to the dinner table, and it can be learned without a great deal of practice. The magician lays four lumps of sugar on the table, so that they form the corners of a square. He covers two lumps of sugar, one with each hand, and wiggles his ringers. When he lifts his hands, two lumps are beneath the left, while the lump of sugar has gone from the right! Without hesitating, the magician places one hand over a single lump, and the other hand over the two lumps. Again the single lump passes, and three lumps appear together! The last single lump is covered, and all four lumps appear together! The process is immediately reversed. The four lumps are covered with one hand, and the other hand is placed at one of the empty corners of the imaginary square. When the hands are lifted, one lump is back at the corner, and only three remain in the group. This is repeated, until there is a lump at every corner. Then the hands are shown empty and the sugar may be examined. Method: We will call the lumps of sugar A, B, C, and D. Besides them, there is an extra lump of sugar which is hidden in the left palm. It is held there by pressure at the base of the thumb, and with a little practice it can be retained with ease. The right hand arranges the visible lumps thus:
Everything is ready for action. Each movement must follow quickly after the one before. The right hand is placed over lump A; the left over D. The fingers are wiggled, and the right hand "palms'* A, while the left hand leaves its lump with D. The hands are raised (without showing the palms) and lump A has disappeared, two lumps being at D. The left hand immediately covers B, while the right goes to D. The fingers are wiggled, and are lifted, the left palm gripping lump B, while the right hand leaves the lump that it carried from A. The empty right hand now covers C, while the left hand covers the three lumps at D. When the hands are lifted, the right hand picks up C, and the left hand leaves the fourth lump at D. The process is immediately reversed. The left hand covers the four lumps and picks up one, while the right hand deposits a lump at C. The left hand goes to B, and leaves its lump there while the right hand is covering the three lumps and removing one from D. Then the right hand goes to A and leaves the lump there while the left picks up one of the two lumps at D. The left hand is lifted an instant before the right; and as the eyes of the spectators naturally go to the right hand, the left hand drops the odd lump of sugar in the lap or in the pocket.

effect_cn: 一杯水压着方糖，魔术师往下一压，糖块竟像穿过桌面一样消失，杯下只剩一团空糖纸。
method_cn: 事先从糖纸里取出方糖，把空糖纸重新包好、捏回原状，放回糖罐。
上台把这块「方糖」（实为空糖纸）立在餐桌上，上面压一杯水。
右手盖住杯口，左手伸到桌子底下。
右手猛地将杯子压向桌面，左手立刻从桌下伸出，把真方糖丢到桌上。
抬起杯子，桌面下露出压皱的空糖纸，摊开给观众看，里面没有糖。
note_cn: 空糖纸足以托住一杯水，放杯时右手手指轻轻扶稳，让观众相信重量全压在糖块上。
text_en:
Taking a wrapped lump of sugar, the magician stands it on the dinner table and sets a glass of water on top of the sugar lump. Placing his right hand over the mouth of the glass, he puts his left hand beneath the table and suddenly drives the glass down upon the table with his right hand. The left hand immediately emerges from beneath and tosses the lump of sugar on the table. Apparently the solid sugar lump has been driven right through
the table. As proof of same, the magician lifts the glass and beneath found the crumpled sugar wrapper, which can be it is opened and shown entirely devoid of sugar. This novel trick depends upon an unsuspected fact; namely, that an empty sugar wrapper is strong enough to support the weight of a glass of water. Beforehand, the magician removes a lump from wrapper and places the latter— all closed again— its in the sugar bowl. This is the "lump" that he uses in the trick. The tips of the right fingers can steady the glass lightly when upon the empty wrapper, care being taken to convince the it is set spectators that the full weight is actually supported by the sup* posedly wrapped lump. In his lap, the performer has the actual lump of sugar and it is brought up by the left hand after the glass has "driven" it through the table.

effect_cn: 一把餐刀刀尖朝下立在摊开的手掌上，像被磁铁吸住一样稳稳不掉。
method_cn: 选一把带沉重手柄、刀身与手柄交界处有凸起的餐刀。
刀尖朝下，抵在左手手指上。
让手柄与刀身交界的凸起压在左手小指根部的关节上。
手掌不要完全竖立，而是微微后仰。
手柄的重量压在手指上，刀便稳稳立在掌上。
note_cn: 关键是凸起正好卡在小指关节、手掌略后仰，位置找对刀就不掉。
text_en: table knife is placed against the palm of the hand. It remains there, as though magnetized to the hand, which is held in a vertical position, with the fingers pointing straight forward. To do this, you need the proper kind of a knife and you must study the correct position. Set the knife point downward against the fingers of the left hand. The knife must have a heavy handle, with a bulge where the blade starts; and this bulge, or projection, rests upon the joint of the left little finger. The hand is not quite vertical; it is tilted backward imperceptibly. The weight of the handle rests against the fingers, and the knife sets firmly in position, although its situation seems precarious.

effect_cn: 汤匙稳稳搭在指尖上，魔术师一声令下，它竟自己翻了个身。
method_cn: 挑一把手柄上有一处隆起的汤匙。
把汤匙放在指尖上，让隆起朝下。
汤匙实际处于平衡状态，稍加练习就能让它不倒。
喊口令时，把手掌极轻微地一倾。
汤匙失去平衡翻过来，看起来就像自己翻身。
note_cn: 倾斜幅度越小越好，观众才不会看出是你动了手。
text_en: A spoon is placed upon the tips of the fingers, and it remains there for a short time. At the performer's command, the spoon suddenly turns over! The spoon has a hump in the handle; and it is set on the fingers so that the hump is downward. The spoon is actually balanced there, but it is not difficult to keep it from turning over. When the hand is tilted imperceptibly, the spoon loses its balance, and turns over apparently of its own accord!

effect_cn: 吹灭蜡烛后，魔术师把还燃着的火柴悬在烛芯上方，火苗竟一跃而下，把蜡烛重新点亮。
method_cn: 用烛火点燃一根火柴，然后吹灭蜡烛。
吹灭后留意烛芯上升起的一缕细烟。
把火柴的火苗对准这股烟。
火苗会沿着烟柱一路「走」下去，把烛芯重新点燃。
note_cn: 要趁烟刚升起时下手、火苗正对烟柱；熄了几分钟也常能再点着，距离可达数英寸。
text_en: This trick can be performed anywhere; but when there are candles on the table, it makes a good dinner-table trick. The magician lights a match from the candle flame. Then he blows out the candle. A moment later he holds the match above the candle-wick, and to the surprise of everyone, a portion of the flame leaves the match and jumps to the candle, where it immediately lights the wick! The secret lies in watching the curl of thin smoke that goes up from the candle immediately after it has been blown out. Set the match flame so that it encounters this slender stream of smoke, and the flame will travel down to the wick in a most astonishing fashion. Sometimes a candle may be reignited this way several minutes after it has been extinguished; and the flame will often travel a distance of several inches.

effect_cn: 往餐巾环里倒满盐，盖上一块硬纸板，再拿起餐巾环，盐竟然不见了。
method_cn: 事先剪一块与桌布同色的圆纸片，粘在餐巾环的底部。
把餐巾环放在桌上，往里倒盐。
把硬纸板盖在环上。
连纸板一起拿起餐巾环，盐被纸板托在环里，看不见。
顺势把餐巾环连同盐一起装进口袋。
note_cn: 纸片要与桌布同色并粘牢，倒盐时别让盐粒漏到环外。
text_en: A napkin ring is laid upon the table, and salt is poured into small piece of cardboard is laid over the ring, and the ring is lifted. The salt is gone! Method: Take a circular piece of white paper and glue it to the bottom of the napkin ring. This paper matches the table-cloth and will not be detected. When salt is poured in and the ring lifted, the salt comes along. The piece of cardboard hides the salt in the ring. The ring should be pocketed, with the salt.

effect_cn: 葡萄籽丢进姜汁汽水便沉到杯底；魔术师一声令下，籽自己升上水面，命令它下沉又沉下去，反复听令升降。
method_cn: 把葡萄籽丢进一杯姜汁汽水里，它会自然沉到杯底。
等汽水里的小气泡聚在籽周围时，发令让它升起来。
籽浮到水面后气泡散逸，再发令让它沉下去。
观察气泡聚散把握时机，反复发令升降。
note_cn: 全靠观察气泡聚散来掐准发令时机，观众看不出真正原因。
text_en:
grape seed is dropped into a glass of ginger-ale. It sinks to the bottom of the liquid. At the magician's command, the seed rises to the top of the
glass, and remains there until he tells it to sink. Down it goes again, and comes up when it is told to rise. This is a very curious and interesting experiment. It is caused by the air-bubbles in the ginger-ale. The seed naturally sinks, but as soon as a few bubbles cluster around it, it comes to the top. There the air-bubbles escape, and down goes the seed, only to rise again in a few moments. The performer must time his commands when he has observed the bubbles forming or disappearing; yet the average onlooker will not detect the cause of the peculiar behavior of the seed.

effect_cn: 橙子放在餐巾下面，掀开餐巾，桌上却出现一个苹果。
method_cn: 把橙子切成四瓣，小心剥下橙皮。
把四块橙皮固定在苹果上，做得整齐就没人会怀疑它不是真橙子。
把这只假橙子放好，用餐巾盖住。
手伸到餐巾下迅速取走橙皮，把它们藏在餐巾褶皱里带走。
掀开餐巾，桌上只剩苹果。
note_cn: 橙皮要贴得严丝合缝，取皮时餐巾褶皱得够厚，才能藏住四块皮。
text_en: Changing an orange to an apple is not a difficult trick if you know the secret. The orange is placed beneath a napkin, and when the cloth is removed, there is the apple instead! Method: Cut an orange into quarters and carefully remove the peel. Fix them around an apple, and if you do a neat job, no one will suspect that the fruit is not a genuine orange. When the supposed orange has been covered with the napkin, reach beneath and quickly remove the peels, carrying them away in the folds of the napkin, leaving the apple there instead.

effect_cn: 用一条餐巾把餐刀裹住，卷起再展开，餐刀已经不见了。
method_cn: 用餐巾松松地卷住餐刀，让刀柄朝向桌子边缘。
把餐巾稍稍抬起倾斜，餐刀便悄悄滑出，落进你的大腿上。
腿上先垫好另一条餐巾，免得餐刀掉到地上发出声响。
把餐巾卷紧再慢慢展开，餐刀已经消失。
note_cn: 餐巾要卷得松、倾斜角度要小，腿上的第二条餐巾是消音的关键。
text_en: A table knife is wrapped in a napkin. The napkin is rolled up and then unrolled. The knife is gone! Method Roll the napkin around the knife, and have the handle of the knife toward the edge of the table. The napkin is rolled loosely, and in tilting it up, the knife slides out, unobserved into the lap. Another napkin should be on the lap to keep the knili from foiling to the floor.

effect_cn: 魔术师双手捧起桌上的餐刀，做出把刀吞下去的姿势，刀却不见了。
method_cn: 把餐刀平行桌边放好。
双手指尖相对合在刀上，重复两三次同样的位置。
最后双手合拢做出把刀捧起的样子，同时把刀滑到桌边让它落到腿上。
双手立刻举到嘴边，观众的目光都跟着手走，以为刀还在手里。
note_cn: 双手要自然地反复做同一动作，最后一滑要轻，别让刀碰出声。
text_en: A knife is placed on the table, parallel to the edge. The magician picks up the knife with both hands, and appears to swallow it. The knife is gone! This is done in picking up the knife. The hands are placed upon it, finger tips to finger tips. This position is taken two or three times, and finally the hands appear to scoop up the knife; but as they do so, they slide it to the edge of the table and let it fall into the lap. The hands are immediately raised to the mouth. If this is done neatly, all eyes will follow the hands, thinking the knife is still there.

effect_cn: 桌上摆着五把餐刀，魔术师只用其中一把就把其余四把一起挑离了桌面。
method_cn: 把五把餐刀摆在桌上，刀柄朝向自己。
按图 1 的手法把四把刀交错排列，让刀身彼此交叠。
用第五把刀的刀身横穿这四把刀，卡住交叠处。
捏住第五把刀的刀柄往上提，四把刀便被一起撑起来。
note_cn: 原文此条只有一句提示并依赖原书 Fig. 1 的插图，具体交叠方式需对照插图。
text_en: Five knives are laid upon the table. The object is to raise four of them with the other knife. This sounds impossible; but the magician can do it. It is very easily accomplished by following the illustration. (See Fig. i.)

effect_cn: 三个玻璃杯作桥墩，魔术师把三把餐刀架成一座三向的桥，悬在桌上不掉。
method_cn: 把三个平底杯倒扣在桌上，摆成三角形作桥墩。
三把刀的刀身相互交叉卡住，形成三角形的桥面。
三个刀柄分别搁在三个杯底上，桥便架稳了。
按图 2 调整交叠角度，直到整座桥能承住自身重量。
note_cn: 刀身交叠要卡稳、刀柄落点要对称，架好后先轻轻试承重。
text_en: Using three tumblers as bases, the magician states that he can form a three-way bridge, with three knives, each one coming from its base an inverted glass. This is accomplished in the manner shown in Fig. 2. The blades of the knives are interlocked, and the handles rest upon the tumblers. Note: There are various other tricks which appear in different chapters that are suited for use as "Table Tricks." They have been placed in their proper groups, and will be easily recognized by the reader.

effect_cn: 蜡烛放在瓶子另一侧，魔术师对着瓶子吹气，蜡烛竟被吹灭了，仿佛气是穿过瓶子过去的。
method_cn: 点燃蜡烛，放在一只圆瓶的一侧。
对着瓶子吹气，气流被瓶身分开，却在瓶子另一侧重新汇合。
汇合的气流正好吹灭蜡烛。
用两三个瓶子或一个瓶子加一只杯子演示，效果相同。
note_cn: 必须用圆瓶，吹气要压低、正对瓶身，让气流绕过瓶子在烛火处合拢。
text_en: A candle is lighted and is set on one side of a bottle. The magician blows against the bottle, and the candle is extinguished. He has, apparently, blown through the solid bottle! A round bottle must be used. When the magician blows against it, the air currents are divided; but they rejoin on the other side to extinguish the candle. Two or three bottles or a bottle and a glass may be used. The result will always be the same.

effect_cn: 切开橙子的一端，魔术师从里面抽出一长串彩色纸带，仿佛橙子里藏着一整卷彩带。
method_cn: 事先把彩带穿在一根大针上，再把彩带卷绕在针上。
左手在桌下握住这卷彩带，针尖朝向掌心内侧。
右手拿起橙子，交到左手时把它往针上压，让针从橙子中心穿进去。
切橙子时抓住针并把它往外抽，彩带便被带出来。
针可以顺手藏在右手里，继续抽彩带直到整卷抽完。
抚平彩带时把针褪下来，让它悄悄落到地上。
note_cn: 针穿过橙子中心时别让橙子歪，抽彩带要匀，最后褪针动作要自然。
text_en:
This is a very effective dinner-table trick which should be performed with a small orange. You cut open the end of the orange, and produce a long coil of colored ribbon. The ribbon actually comes from the orange; but it is not there at the beginning of the trick. It is threaded to a large needle, and is then coiled about the needle. The coil of ribbon is held in the left hand, with the point of the needle extending in from the palm, and the left hand is held beneath the table.
The right hand picks up the orange and in transferring it to the left hand, presses it down on the needle, which goes up through the center of the orange. In cutting into the orange, get hold of the needle and draw it out, bringing the ribbon along. The needle is easily concealed in the right hand as it pulls out the ribbon. Keep on pulling until the whole coil comes out; then, in smoothing the ribbon, slide the needle off and let it fall to the floor.

effect_cn: 魔术师宣称能用一根吸管把一只酒瓶提起来，结果瓶子真的离了桌面。
method_cn: 把吸管弯折，形成一长一短两段。
把弯折处塞进瓶口，短段弹开，卡在瓶口内侧。
短段像杠杆一样卡住瓶口边缘。
捏住长段提起，瓶子就被带起来。
note_cn: 短段要卡在瓶口内侧卡稳，提起时保持垂直，斜了就会滑脱。
text_en: Here the magician offers to lift a bottle with a straw! It is a remarkable task, indeed; but it is easy of accomplishment. The straw is bent so as to make a short section, and it is pushed into the bottle, at the bend. The short section springs out and acts as a lever or catch by which the bottle is lifted when the straw is raised.

effect_cn: 小刀放在手帕中央、一并放进玻璃杯，手帕一抽，杯里空了，刀也不见了。
method_cn: 展开小刀给观众看，然后合上刀身。
把刀放在手帕中央，注意用刀身夹住一些布。
这样刀就挂在了手帕上，再把它放进玻璃杯。
迅速抽走手帕并收进口袋，刀便被一起带走，杯子看起来空了。
note_cn: 合刀时一定要夹住手帕布，抽得越快越干净，动作要连贯不犹豫。
text_en: A pen-knife is shown and opened. It is placed in the center of a handkerchief and set in a glass, after the blade has been closed. The handkerchief is whisked away, and the glass is empty. When the knife is closed, it is lying on the handkerchief, and the magician takes care to catch some of the cloth in the blade. In this manner the knife is attached to the handkerchief, so when it is quickly whisked away and pocketed, the knife comes with it. Practically all the tricks in the chapters on "Sugar Tricks" and "Tumbler Tricks" are intended for the dinner table, but as there are many of them, they are treated in a separate chapter.

effect_cn: 拇指套戴在右手食指上，左手把它取下，摊开左手时拇指套却不见了。
method_cn: 拇指套原本戴在右手的中指上，其余手指弯曲把它掩住。
右手摆向左手时，暗中把中指弯回、把食指伸出。
左手立刻合拢包住食指，做出把拇指套取走的样子。
摊开左手，拇指套自然不见了；还可以从左手手肘处把拇指套变出来。
note_cn: 换指要在右手移动的瞬间完成，两手动作要同时，快慢一致。
text_en: A thimble is placed on the finger tip of the right hand and is removed by the left hand. When the left hand is opened, the thimble has disappeared. The thimble is originally on the second finger of the right hand, while the other fingers are bent in. When the right hand is swung over to the left, the second finger is bent in, and the forefinger is extended in its place. The left hand immediately closes around the forefinger and pretends to draw away the thimble. The forefinger is seen without the thimble; so everyone supposes that the thimble is in the left hand. But when the hand is opened the thimble is gone. The thimble may be drawn from the left elbow, on the tip of the second finger.

effect_cn: 右手食指戴红拇指套、中指戴蓝拇指套；蓝拇指套被取下放进左手，摊开左手却变成了红拇指套。
method_cn: 红拇指套戴在右手食指上，蓝拇指套戴在中指上。
展示蓝拇指套，做出把它取下放进左手的样子。
右手移动时暗中交换两根手指的位置。
摊开左手，里面出现的是红拇指套。
note_cn: 换指要在右手晃动时完成，左手合拢的时机要卡准。
text_en: This is a variation of the preceding trick. red thimble is placed on the tip of the right forefinger and a blue one on the tip of the second finger. The blue thimble is shown and is apparently placed in the left hand. But again the fingers change positions, during the motion of the right hand, and when the left hand is opened, a red thimble is there instead of a blue.

effect_cn: 拇指套明明戴在右手上，双手一挥，拇指套跳到了左手上，再一挥又跳回右手。
method_cn: 取一只薄金属拇指套，从顶到底锯成两半。
一半套在右手食指的正面，另一半套在左手食指的背面。
压住半截拇指套的底边，把它们牢牢卡在指尖上。
摊开双手、掌心朝观众时，右手只露出半截，左手看不见。
挥手时把手背转向观众，左手那半截出现，右手那半截被藏住。
再一挥手转回掌心朝前，拇指套又回到右手。
note_cn: 半截拇指套要卡紧指尖，翻手时手腕转动要干脆，两手动作同步。
text_en: A thimble is shown on the tip of the second finger of the right hand. The left hand is also shown, but it has no thimble. The hands are waved, and the thimble jumps from the right hand to the left, and back again. Take a thin metal thimble and saw it or cut it in half, from top to bottom. Put one portion on the front of the right second finger, and the other portion on the back of the left second finger. By pressing the bottom edges of the half-thimbles, the magician can clamp them firmly to the finger tips. Now, when the palms of the hands are shown, there will be a thimble on the tip of the right second finger; but none will be in view on the left. In waving the hands, turn the backs towards the spectators, and the left-hand thimble will come into view while the righthand thimble will be out of sight. Another wave of the hands brings the palms front and the thimble is back on the right.

effect_cn: 一张纸两面展示后卷成纸锥，右手食指伸进去，出来时指尖上竟戴着拇指套。
method_cn: 拇指套事先戴在右手食指上。
右手食指从下方、右手拇指从上方夹住纸的一端。
左手抓住纸的另一端往上折，盖住右手拇指，拇指随即松开下面一角，让纸弹起。
右手食指立刻从左手捏住的那一端下面伸上来，右手拇指压在上面。
这样纸的两面都展示过了，却看不出拇指套。
左手把纸卷成纸锥包住右手食指，食指抽出，拇指套留在锥里。
亮示手指后小心地伸进锥中，出来时就戴上了拇指套。
note_cn: 关键是借翻纸遮住拇指和拇指套，卷锥要包紧，食指抽出时拇指套才留在里面。
text_en:
A small sheet of paper is shown on both sides. It is rolled into a cone. The right forefinger is inserted in the cone, and comes out bearing a thimble. The thimble is originally on the right forefinger. The paper is held at one end by the right forefinger, beneath, and the right thumb, above. The left hand grips the other end of the paper, and folds it over so that it covers the right thumb, which then releases the under end so that it springs forward. The right forefinger immediately comes up beneath the end held by the left hand, and the right thumb is set on top. Thus both sides of the paper are exhibited without revealing the thimble. The left hand rolls the paper in a cone around the right fore-
finger, which is withdrawn, leaving the thimble in the cone. The finger is shown, and is carefully inserted in the cone, emerging with the thimble. \J RELEASE END*B \*o'/

effect_cn: 拇指套顶在手帕下面，用力一挤，拇指套竟穿透手帕露出半截；再一推，拇指套回到原处，手帕完好无损。
method_cn: 准备两个拇指套，一大一小，大拇指套能松松地套住小拇指套。
把大拇指套的尖端剪掉，剪到粗糙部分的底部。
大拇指套套在小拇指套上，短距离看仍像一只普通拇指套。
展示拇指套，把它暂时放进左拳，其实把大拇指套的假尖端留在左手里。
右手食指戴上真拇指套，伸到布下，把假尖端套上食指。
此时展示手帕，看起来拇指套穿透了手帕。
用左拳盖住右食指，取下假尖端，再抽走手帕亮出拇指套。
把拇指套推进左拳并把假尖端留在上面，之后可双手空空地收尾。
note_cn: 剪口要在粗糙底部、假尖端套上后看不出破绽，挤手帕的力度要稳。
text_en:
The magician borrows a handkerchief and places a thimble beneath it, holding the thimble on the tip of his forefinger. He squeezes the handkerchief, and the thimble goes half way through it, so that both sides of the cloth may be shown, with the thimble extending through. Then the thimble is pushed back, and the handkerchief is returned, uninjured. Two thimbles are required for the trick. One must fit loosely over the other. The tip of the larger thimble is cut off, just at the bottom of the rough part. When this thimble is placed on the smaller thimble, the thimble appears quite ordinary, at a short distance.
In working, show the thimble, and place it temporarily in the left Then take the thimble on the right forefinger, leaving fist. the false tip in the left hand. Place the right hand under the cloth, with the forefinger extended, and insert the forefinger into the left picking up the false tip. The handkerchief can then be shown fist, with the thimble apparently half way through it! Then place the left fist over the right forefinger and remove the false tip. Withdraw the handkerchief and show the thimble. Push the thimble into the left fist, and leave the false tip on it, so the hands may be shown empty, except for the thimble. It is an easy matter to dispose of the false tip after this.

effect_cn: 拇指套套在竖起的食指上，手帕蒙住之后，另一只手从前方一按，拇指套竟穿过手帕露在布外。
method_cn: 拇指套套在右手食指上，食指竖起，手帕罩在手上。
右手手背朝观众，左手从伸出的手指前方靠近，手背也朝观众。
布下伸着的其实是换出来的中指，食指已暗中换下。
左手从手帕前方盖住时，食指从布边下抬头，从布后伸起。
左拳合拢时同时握住食指和中指，并捏住拇指套。
左手稍稍一提，把拇指套套到中指的布外面。
食指立刻弯下，左手移开，拇指套就穿过了手帕露在外面。
左手取下拇指套，手帕交观众检查，右手亮出空手。
note_cn: 换指和移拇指套要同时完成，左拳盖住的瞬间别让布起皱穿帮。
text_en: This is a good trick to work in connection with the previous item, as only the thimble itself is used, and it apparently passes right through the handkerchief. The thimble is set on the tip of the forefinger, which is held upright, and a handkerchief is set over it. The back of the right hand towards the audience and the left hand approaches in front of the extended finger, with the back of the left hand also towards the audience. Now, the finger which is extended under the cloth is in reality the second finger, which has been raised instead of the forefinger. So as soon as the left hand covers in front of the handkerchief, the forefinger is raised up under the hem, and comes up in back of the handkerchief. As the left fist is closed, it encircles both the forefinger and the second finger, and grips the thimble. The left hand is raised slightly, to set the thimble on the second finger, through the cloth. The forefinger is immediately bent down. Then the left hand is removed, and there is the thimble through the handkerchief. The left hand takes oft the thimble. Then the handkerchief is given for examination, and the right hand is shown empty.

effect_cn: 拇指套放在水碗里能像小船一样浮着，一推就进水沉下；请别人一试却总是沉，换回魔术师又浮起来。
method_cn: 准备两个拇指套：一个厚重的镀镍或银拇指套，一个轻的铝拇指套，外观要相近。
轻的能浮水，重的会沉。
事先把另一个拇指套藏进用来擦干拇指套的手帕褶皱里。
擦拇指套时暗中把两个拇指套互换，让人看不出。
于是你可以随意让拇指套浮起或沉下。
也可用两个轻拇指套，在其中一个内壁滴几滴焊锡加重。
note_cn: 两个拇指套外观要相近，擦干时的换手动作要自然，沉浮节奏别太快。
text_en: The magician demonstrates that a thimble will float— like a little boat when he places it in a dish of water. A little push, however, and the thimble fills with water and sinks. It is dried and someone else is asked to make it float. By this time the thimble sinks immediately! When the magician takes it again, it floats! Method: Two thimbles are used, one a heavy nickel-plated or silver thimble; the other a light one, preferably of aluminum. These thimbles must look very much alike. The light one will float, the heavy one will not. One thimble is concealed in the folds of the handkerchief that is used to dry the thimble. The act of drying enables the magician to secredy exchange one thimble for the other in an indetectible manner; thus he can make the thimble sink or float as he chooses. Two light thimbles can be used, a few drops of solder being placed within one, to make it too heavy to float.

effect_cn: 拇指套戴在右手食指上，用手帕包住手指再取出拇指套套回去；抓住四角一拽，手帕拉走，拇指套却仍戴在食指上。
method_cn: 准备两个拇指套，一个能轻松套进另一个，把它们当成一只拇指套戴在右手食指上展示。
把丝手帕罩在右手食指上。
左手从布下取出较大的拇指套，套在丝手帕外面。
这样大拇指套罩住了小拇指套，但中间隔着布。
抓住手帕四角猛地一拽。
手帕被拉走，小拇指套仍留在食指上。
把借来的手帕丢进外套口袋，让拇指套落进口袋里。
note_cn: 外拇指套要顺着丝帕滑上，拽手帕时动作要快，拇指套才像被布带走。
text_en:
The magician shows one thimble on his right forefinger. Otherwise his hands are empty. He places a silk handkerchief over his forefinger, and reaching beneath the cloth with his left hand, brings out the thimble and sets it on his right forefinger, but with the cloth between the thimble and the finger. Taking the handkerchief by all four corners, the magician yanks it with his left hand, and the handkerchief comes away, leaving the thimble still on the right forefinger! The effect of this is most startling. It is accomplished by the use of two thimbles; one fits easily inside the other and they are shown as one on the tip of the right forefinger.
The cloth is spread over the right forefinger and the left hand brings the larger thimble out from beneath and sets it on top of the silk handkerchief. Thus the larger thimble covers the smaller, but with the cloth between. When the handkerchief is snatched away, the large thimble comes with it, but the smaller thimble is revealed on the right forefinger. The action is instantaneous and surprising. The handkerchief is dropped in the coat pocket where the thimble falls from it.

effect_cn: 两只拇指套口对口一碰就紧紧吸在一起，像有磁力一样，随后展示两只拇指套完全普通。
method_cn: 准备一个小海绵橡胶球，直径比拇指套口稍大。
把球浅浅地放进一只拇指套里，用手指挡住不露。
两只拇指套口对口时，把另一只拇指套压到球上。
橡胶球卡住两只拇指套，它们便紧紧吸在一起。
分开拇指套后立刻戴到双手食指上展示。
海绵球被压进拇指套尖端里，拇指套看起来完全普通。
note_cn: 用大号拇指套，球要塞得够深，分开后马上戴到手指上才不露。
text_en: Two thimbles are placed mouth to mouth. The upper thimble is held and the lower one adheres to it in a mysterious fashion. The thimbles are later shown to be quite ordinary. Method: A little ball of spongy rubber is required. It is slightly greater in diameter than the opening of the thimble. The ball is placed in one thimble, to a very slight degree, but it kept hidden by the fingers. When the thimbles are placed mouth to mouth, the second thimble is forced over the ball, and the ball holds both firmly together. When the thimbles are taken apart, they are immediately placed on the forefingers for exhibition. The ball of spongy rubber compresses and is forced up into the tip of one thimble, so the thimbles appear quite ordinary. Large thimbles should be used.

effect_cn: 魔术师背过身去，观众把纸球扣在一只拇指套下并打乱拇指套，他回身立刻指出纸球在哪只拇指套下。
method_cn: 用纸揉成一个小球，揉的时候把一根短头发卷进去，让一端露出一点。
把纸球放在桌上，没人会注意到那根头发。
请观众趁魔术师背对时用任意一只拇指套扣住纸球，并打乱三只拇指套的位置。
回身查看拇指套，找出边缘露出一小截头发的那一只。
指出它，纸球就在下面。
note_cn: 头发要短而硬、只露一点即可，打乱时让观众没法一直盯着拇指套边缘。
text_en:
A tiny ball of paper is laid on the table, and is covered with one of three thimbles. The magician requests the spectators to cover the ball with any one thimble, while his back is turned, and then to mix the thimbles around on the table. This done; and the magician immediately points out the thimble which covers the paper ball!
There is no preparation about the thimbles. But in making the little ball, a short hair is rolled up in it, so that one end of the hair projects a short distance. When the paper ball is on the table, no one will notice the presence of the hair. But when the thimbles are set on the table, the magician can instantly name the location of the paper ball by pointing out the thimble which has a bit of hair extending from beneath it.

effect_cn: 三只拇指套分别扣住红、白、蓝三个纸球并被打乱，魔术师却能一一指出每只球的位置。
method_cn: 做三个小纸球：红球里横穿一根长发、两边各露出一截；白球里塞一根头发、只露一端；蓝球不做处理。
请观众扣住纸球并打乱拇指套。
看拇指套两侧各有头发的是红球。
只有一侧露出头发的是白球。
两侧都看不到头发的那只下面就是蓝球。
note_cn: 头发要用胶粘牢、别在打乱时松脱，三根的长度差距要看得出来。
text_en:
This trick is similar to the last; except that three tissue-paper balls are used red, white, and blue. The magician can point out the location of each ball, when the balls have been covered by thimbles. The red ball has a long hair, the paper being wrapped around the center. Thus two hairs will project from each side of the thimble covering the red ball. One hair projects from the thimble covering the white ball; while the blue ball is unprepared and nothing reveals its presence. The balls can be carefully made, and glued so that the hairs will not come loose.
There are many interesting tricks in which drinking glasses are used, and some of them have been chosen for this chapter. They make excellent tricks for the dinner table, but they can be performed in other places as well.

effect_cn: 杯子已装到杯口齐平，魔术师又小心加进一点水，水面竟鼓出杯口边缘而不流下来。
method_cn: 把杯子倒水到杯口齐平，让所有人都承认杯子已经满了。
另取一个杯子或水壶，极缓慢地把水一点点加进满杯。
只要动作够慢，满杯还能再容纳少量水。
从侧面看，水面会在杯口中央鼓起一个小小的水丘。
这就是水面高出杯口却不溢出的原因：表面张力把它托住。
note_cn: 杯口千万不能沾湿，水要沿杯壁缓缓加入，水面才鼓得起来。
text_en: How can a glass be more than full? Very easily, as you will learn when you try this trick. Take a glass and fill it to the brim, until everyone admits that it is quite full. Then take another glass or a pitcher and very carefully pour a little bit of water into the full glass. If you do this slowly, the full glass will receive a small quantity of water. Then if you look at the full glass from the side, you will observe that it is actually more than full. The water will be piled up in the center of the glass and will form a tiny hump which is quite visible. That is, the water will be above the brim of the glass! Care must be taken that the brim of the glass does not become at all wet.

effect_cn: 魔术师说往第一杯里再倒一杯水，结果结束时第一杯里的水反而比开始时更少。
method_cn: 把第一只杯子倒水到接近杯口。
第二只杯子里装些水。
把第二杯的水猛力泼进第一杯。
冲击力把第一杯里的水溅出去一些。
结果第一杯里的水反而比开始时少。
整个戏法在托盘上进行，省得弄湿桌面。
note_cn: 杯口越满、泼得越猛效果越明显，一定要用托盘接水。
text_en:
The performer states that he will pour a quantity of water into a glass. Then he will pour in some water from another glass; but
with this strange result there will be less water in the first glass when he is through than there was when he started! To accomplish this seeming impossibility, fill the first glass almost to the brim. Then put some water in the second glass, and dash it into the nearly-filled first glass. You will actually transfer the contents of the second glass into the first; but the force of the water will dash out water from the first glass and it will contain less water than when you started. The trick should be performed on a tray.

effect_cn: 魔术师把一口烟从一个杯子倒进另一个杯子，烟在杯里像液体一样流动、堆积。
method_cn: 把两只玻璃杯都弄湿。
慢慢、轻轻地把一口雪茄烟吹进一只杯子里。
烟会沉在杯底并充满整只杯子。
小心地把烟从一只杯子倒进另一只，动作要非常慢而稳。
室内不能有风，否则烟会被吹散。
note_cn: 杯子必须湿、动作要慢，避开一切气流，烟才能像液体一样累积。
text_en: The trick of pouring smoke from one glass to another is quite surprising; in fact, if it is done well, the smoke will act almost as a liquid. The glasses should both be wet. Then puff some cigar smoke into one glass, very slowly and gently. The smoke will settle and will fill the glass. Carefully pour the smoke from one glass to another, doing it very slowly and easily. Be sure to avoid all drafts, and you will discover that the trick is not at all difficult.

effect_cn: 魔术师把一只玻璃杯推下桌沿，杯子翻落在地却完好无损。
method_cn: 在地上铺一个枕头练习。
把杯子慢慢推到桌边，让它翻倒落下。
杯子在下落中翻转，杯口边缘先着地。
边缘着地吸收了冲击力，杯子便不会像侧面着地那样碎裂。
不要用精致的薄玻璃杯，要选厚实的便宜杯子。
note_cn: 一定要让杯子翻成杯口先着地，落地处垫枕头练习，薄杯不可用。
text_en: The magician pushes a tumbler off the edge of table. It falls to the floor, but it does not break! Practice this with a pillow. Push the glass slowly to the edge of the table and let it topple off. It will turn over in falling, and will strike on the rim. This absorbs the force of the blow, and the glass will not break as it probably would if it struck the floor on its side. Of course a delicate glass should not be used. A cheap and fairly thick glass is the kind to do this trick with.

effect_cn: 观众把物件藏进口袋后，魔术师倒扣玻璃杯，让每个人依次用食指碰杯底，随后就指出是谁拿了物件。
method_cn: 小物件放在桌上，魔术师离开房间，由某位观众把它藏进口袋。
魔术师回来，把一只玻璃杯倒扣在桌上。
请每个人依次用食指碰一下杯底。
同伙知道东西在谁手里，等那人碰过之后自己再碰杯底。
魔术师只要记住同伙之前最后碰杯底的人是谁，就能指出藏物件的人。
note_cn: 全程不说一句话，同伙要最后下手，顺序不能乱。
text_en: tumbler is used in this trick but its sole purpose is to draw attention from the true secret. An object is laid on the table. The magician leaves the room, and someone pockets the object. When he comes back, the magician inverts a tumbler on the table and asks each person to touch the bottom of the glass with his or her forefinger. When everyone has done so, the magician looks at the glass and names the person who has the object. A confederate helps the magician. Not a word is spoken. The confederate, however, knows who took the object, and he waits until that person has touched the glass. Then the confederate touches the glass. The magician knows that the person who touched the glass just before is the one who holds the object.

effect_cn: 魔术师宣称能用一只手同时举起六只玻璃杯，并当场做到。
method_cn: 把五只杯子围成一圈，第六只放在圈心。
四只手指各伸进一只杯子，拇指伸进第五只。
往上提起的同时把五只杯子向内压紧。
五只杯子的压力把中间的第六只夹住，六只杯子便一起被提起。
note_cn: 提起时要边提边夹紧，五只杯子围得越圆越稳。
text_en: The magician states that he can lift six glasses at once, with one hand. That sounds very difficult, and everyone wants a demonstration. The method is this: arrange five glasses in a circle with the sixth glass in the center. Put a finger in each of four glasses and the thumb in the fifth. Then lift, and as you do so, press the glasses together. The pressure of the five glasses will hold the sixth, and you can lift them all at once.

effect_cn: 桌上铺着手帕，上面放着一杯水；魔术师抓住手帕猛地一抽，杯子却稳稳立在原处。
method_cn: 桌上铺开手帕，把一杯水放在手帕上。
抓住手帕的一端，猛地向正前方一抽。
动作要快而稳，把手帕平直地抽出来。
杯里水的重量使杯子稳定，杯子便纹丝不动。
note_cn: 抽手帕要果断、走直线，犹豫就会带倒杯子。
text_en:
Set a glass of water on the table, with a handkerchief spread out beneath it. Seize the handkerchief, give it a sudden pull, and it will come away, leaving the glass of water standing there.
This trick is not difficult; but it must be performed boldly. Pull the handkerchief straight out, with a quick, steady jerk. The weight of the water in the glass makes the trick easier, as. it holds the glass steady.

effect_cn: 玻璃杯倒扣在桌上，魔术师把手掌按上去一抬，杯子像被磁铁吸住一样跟着手起来。
method_cn: 选一只杯底内凹的玻璃杯。
把杯底弄湿，掌心按上去并略微一转。
掌心与杯底之间形成吸力，手就能把杯子提起来。
另一种做法是在杯中烧一小片纸，再把掌心平压在杯口上。
杯内空气受热后冷却收缩，杯子便被手掌吸住提起。
note_cn: 杯底要内凹、贴合要严，湿杯或烧纸法都要趁热压紧。
text_en: The magician takes a glass and turns it over on the table. He places his hand upon it, and lifts. The glass comes with his hand, as though magnetized. The glass used in the trick should have a depressed bottom. Moisten the bottom of the glass, and set the palm against it, giving the palm a twist. The suction created will enable the hand to lift the glass. Any glass may be lifted by burning a small piece of paper in it, and then pressing the palm flat upon the brim. This makes it possible to lift the glass with the palm.

effect_cn: 玻璃杯倒扣在一个小装置上，杯里的纸十字指针会随着魔术师的意思转动。
method_cn: 把纸片剪成十字形，在每条臂的中央稍微折一下。
把缝衣针插在软木塞上，让针尖朝上立起。
把有一臂略尖的纸十字平衡地架在针尖上。
用玻璃杯把这个小装置倒扣罩住。
用手帕摩擦玻璃杯外侧，指针便会转动。
快速绕着杯子摩擦，指针还会转起来。
note_cn: 纸十字要平衡得能自由转动，摩擦要干脆，杯口别碰桌面。
text_en: tumbler plays a very important part in this trick. A small piece of paper is cut in the form of a cross, and is folded slightly in the center of each arm. needle is placed in a cork, which is stood upright, and the paper cross, which has one arm slightly pointed, is balanced on the needle. tumbler is inverted over the small contrivance, and the object is to make the pointer turn in any desired direction. To do this, rub the outside of the glass with a handkerchief, and you can make the pointer turn. It can be made to revolve by rubbing the handkerchief rapidly around the outside of the glass.

effect_cn: 硬币放在倒扣的杯顶上，观众用两根火柴把硬币夹了起来，却仍算没完成。
method_cn: 把玻璃杯倒扣，硬币放在杯底上。
交给观众两根火柴，说：用这两根火柴把硬币从杯顶夹起来是不可能的。
观众轻松夹起硬币，得意地举起。
你指出他是从杯底、也就是桌面一侧夹起的，不符合从杯顶夹起的条件。
note_cn: 一定要在观众动手前把条件说清楚，揭底时语气要轻松。
text_en:
The magician turns a tumbler upside down and lays a coin upon it. He hands a person two matches, and states that it will
be impossible for the person to pick up the coin with the two matches and lift it from the top of the tumbler. The feat looks so easy that the person immediately accepts the challenge. He picks up the coin with the two matches and triumphantly lifts it from the glass. Then the magician quietly informs him that he has picked up the coin, but he took it from the bottom of the tumbler, and not from the top. Hence he has failed to fulfill the necessary conditions of the trick.

effect_cn: 魔术师单手端盘，把玻璃杯立在盘沿上摇摇欲坠，最后杯子滑落又被接住。
method_cn: 右手握住盘子右侧，四指在盘子前面。
右拇指留在盘子后面并向上竖起。
左手把玻璃杯放在盘子上，让杯底一半搭在盘面、一半搭在竖起的拇指上。
拇指与盘面共同支撑杯底，平衡便很容易。
稍微倾斜盘子让杯子滑落，再用手接住。
note_cn: 拇指要竖稳，杯子重心的支撑点落在盘面与拇指之间，正面看才显得惊险。
text_en: This appears to be an extraordinary feat of juggling. plate is held in the right hand and the left hand sets a glass on top of the plate. The glass balances there, until it finally topples off and is caught. The spectators think this trick is difficult, because they see it from in front. The right hand grips the plate on the right side, with the fingers in front. The right thumb is free in back of the plate, and it is extended upward. Thus the glass is set so its base is partly on the plate and partly on the extended thumb, which makes the balancing a simple matter.

effect_cn: 一杯水斜着立在桌面与桌布之间，不会倒下。
method_cn: 玻璃杯装半杯水，试着让它斜立在水平与垂直之间。
事先在桌布下面放一根火柴。
把杯子底边抵住藏在桌布下的火柴，杯子就斜立住了。
收尾时把火柴取走：可以故意洒几滴水，再拿餐巾垫到桌布下吸水，趁机带走火柴。
也可以在火柴上系一根线，一拉线就把火柴拉走。
